PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer identifier

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Structured error message

REQUESTER_EPM.description:
Requester's full $EPM (Entity Profile) FlatBuffer, re-sent per grant for
freshness. Verified in-module to bind the requester's xpub identity to its
authenticated ed25519 signing key (cross-curve attestation).

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source published the value without stating how it was obtained.

MEASURED.description: Direct physical measurement: radar range measurement, laboratory weigh-in, photometric observation, tape measure on the flight article.

OPERATOR_STATED.description: Published by the operator, manufacturer or launch provider for this specific object.

ESTIMATED.description: The source's own estimate, stated as an estimate.

DERIVED.description: Computed by the record's publisher from other values that each carry their own provenance in this same record.

MODEL_DERIVED.description: Measured off 3D-asset geometry. A MODEL_DERIVED value describes the model, not the flight article, and is never presented as a physical measurement.

INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY.description: Taken from the bus design or from a sibling object in the same family because no per-object value exists. Always an approximation.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source states no aspect convention. Characteristic cross-sections published by catalogue-level object databases use this value.

OPPProvenance.description:
Provenance for exactly one physical value.

This table is the mechanism by which the never-invent-data law is enforced
in the IDL rather than in prose: no physical quantity in an $OPP can be
expressed without one of these attached, so a value with no admissible
source cannot be encoded at all. Unknown values are ABSENT. They are never
zero, never a placeholder, and never carried forward from a different
object.

SOURCE.description:
Publisher of the value, named as the publisher names itself — a space
agency's object database, a public satellite catalogue, a third-party
satellite reference site, or the operator itself.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the record this value was read from, such
as that database's object id. Verbatim, never normalized.

SOURCE_URL.description: Deep link to the exact source record when the source publishes one.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) of the
instant the value describes: the epoch at which the property held. A
design or as-built value that does not change over time omits EPOCH.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
this record retrieved the value from SOURCE.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: The source's own revision, edition or publication marker, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source published the value without stating how it was obtained.

MEASURED.description: Direct physical measurement: radar range measurement, laboratory weigh-in, photometric observation, tape measure on the flight article.

OPERATOR_STATED.description: Published by the operator, manufacturer or launch provider for this specific object.

ESTIMATED.description: The source's own estimate, stated as an estimate.

DERIVED.description: Computed by the record's publisher from other values that each carry their own provenance in this same record.

MODEL_DERIVED.description: Measured off 3D-asset geometry. A MODEL_DERIVED value describes the model, not the flight article, and is never presented as a physical measurement.

INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY.description: Taken from the bus design or from a sibling object in the same family because no per-object value exists. Always an approximation.

LICENSE.description: Terms under which SOURCE permits redistribution of the value, verbatim.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution string the source requires be displayed with the value.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact source
payload bytes the value was parsed from.

NOTES.description: Free text qualifying the value, such as the source's own caveat.

OPPQuantity.description:
One scalar physical quantity, its unit and its own provenance.

PROVENANCE is required: an OPPQuantity that exists names where it came from.
Presence of the table is the signal that a value exists, so VALUE zero is a
real zero (0 dBsm is 1 m2) and an unknown quantity omits the whole table.

UNITS.description:
Unit symbol verbatim, never silently converted: "kg", "m", "m2", "m2/kg",
"kg/m2", "dBsm", "W", "mag". A converted value states the unit it was
converted to and records the conversion in PROVENANCE.NOTES with
PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty in UNITS. Zero means the source stated no uncertainty;
a genuine stated sigma is never exactly zero.

OPPRadarCrossSection.description:
Radar cross-section as reported for one band, polarization and aspect
convention. Radar cross-section is band- and aspect-dependent, so an $OPP
carries a list of these and never a single scalar. A source publishing
minimum, average and maximum cross-sections becomes three entries with
ASPECT MINIMUM, AVERAGE and MAXIMUM sharing one SOURCE.

BAND.description:
Radar band designation verbatim from the source: "UHF", "L", "S", "C",
"X", "Ku". Empty when the source states no band.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Centre frequency [megahertz] when the source states one. Zero means
unstated.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization verbatim from the source: "HH", "VV", "HV", "RCRC". Empty
when the source states none.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source states no aspect convention. Characteristic cross-sections published by catalogue-level object databases use this value.

CROSS_SECTION.description:
The cross-section itself. UNITS is "m2" or "dBsm" as the source published
it; the two are never mixed within one entry and never silently converted.

SIZE_CLASS.description:
Size bucket verbatim when a source publishes a bucket instead of a number,
such as a public catalogue's "SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE". A bucket is never
turned into a number.

SENSOR.description: Sensor or facility that produced the measurement, when stated.

OPPMass.description:
Mass breakdown. Each component is independently sourced; a wet mass and a
dry mass may legitimately come from different publishers and epochs.

WET.description: Mass with propellant, at the stated epoch [kg].

LAUNCH.description: Mass at separation from the launch vehicle [kg].

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant mass at the stated epoch [kg].

PAYLOAD.description: Payload mass carried by the bus [kg].

CURRENT.description: Best current estimate of mass at the record's epoch [kg].

OPPDimensions.description:
Physical envelope. Every extent is a sourced quantity. Extents measured off
3D-asset geometry carry PROVENANCE.METHOD MODEL_DERIVED and describe the
model, not the flight article.

BODY_X.description: Extents along the object's own body axes [m].

HEIGHT.description: Envelope terms as an object database publishes them [m].

SHAPE.description:
Gross geometric shape verbatim from the source, such as a shape string
of the form "Box + 1 Pan" or "Cyl". Never parsed into geometry.

SHAPE_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of SHAPE. Present whenever SHAPE is nonempty.

OPPAreas.description: Projected areas and the ratios derived from them.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_AVERAGE.description: Average projected cross-sectional area over all aspects [m2].

AREA_TO_MASS_RATIO.description:
Area-to-mass ratio [m2/kg], only when a source publishes one directly or
the publisher derives it with PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

OPPSurface.description:
One exterior surface of the object: what it is made of, how large it is and
how it interacts with light.

$PNL carries the articulated panel model used for solar-radiation-pressure
propagation; an $OPP surface is the sourced material inventory. When both
exist, PANEL_ID joins this surface to its $PNL panel. GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME and
GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX join it to the exact glTF material in the asset variant
named by OPP.ASSET.

ID.description: Stable identifier for this surface within the record.

MATERIAL.description:
Material name verbatim from the source, in whatever designation the
source uses: a multi-layer-insulation film, a photovoltaic cell
chemistry, an alloy temper designation. Empty when unstated.

COUNT.description:
How many identical surfaces this entry represents, such as two solar-array
wings.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of MATERIAL, MATERIAL_CLASS, KIND and COUNT. Every dimensioned
field below carries its own.

AREA.description: Area of one surface, not of COUNT surfaces [m2].

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly, dimensionless.

DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected diffusely, dimensionless.

PANEL_ID.description:
Join key to the $PNL panel representing this surface; holds that record's
PNLPanel.PANEL_ID verbatim. Empty when no $PNL panel exists.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
Name of the glTF material that renders this surface, verbatim, in the
variant named by OPP.ASSET.VARIANT_ID. Empty when the surface is not
represented in the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX.description:
Zero-based index into the glTF materials array of that same variant.
Negative one means no glTF material corresponds to this surface.

OPPAssetRef.description:
Binding to the exact 3D asset bytes this record accompanies.

Every field is copied verbatim from the $VAM that governs the asset, so an
$OPP is valid for exactly one reviewed variant. Different bytes are a
different asset: mint a new $OPP and set SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID rather than
repointing an existing one.

VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact $VAM bytes.

VARIANT_ID.description: $VAMVariant.ID verbatim: the specific glTF or GLB this record describes.

ASSET_SHA256.description:
$VAMVariant.BYTE_SHA256 verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
encoding SHA-256 of the exact asset file bytes.

GEOMETRY_MATCHES_PHYSICAL.description:
True only when the asset geometry was authored or rescaled to the physical
dimensions in this record. False, the default, means the asset is
representative and its geometry is not a source of physical dimensions.

METERS_PER_ASSET_UNIT.description:
Metres per asset unit for the named variant. Restates
$VAMTransform.METERS_PER_SOURCE_UNIT for consumers that read only $OPP.

OPP.description:
Object Physical Properties - the sourced physical description of one space
object and, when one exists, of the exact 3D asset that represents it.

Division of labour with the neighbouring standards. $CAT is catalogue
identity and orbit, and its RCS, SIZE and MASS scalars are unattributed
convenience fields carried from the catalogue publisher. $BUS is the bus
DESIGN, shared by every object built on it. $VAM is the asset manifest: the
bytes, the licence, the review and the geometry metrics. $PNL is the
articulated panel model consumed by solar-radiation-pressure propagation.
$OPP is the per-object physical truth in which EVERY value names its own
source, epoch and method. $OPP never restates orbital elements and never
duplicates bus-design values; a per-object value that came from the bus
design is stated here with METHOD INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY so a consumer can see
that it is an approximation.

Joins. NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID join to $CAT. BUS_ID joins to $BUS.
ASSET joins to the exact reviewed $VAM variant. ENTITY_ID is the stable
non-catalogue key shared with $VAM for objects that have no catalogue entry.

Never-invent law, enforced by the shape rather than by prose: a physical
quantity exists only as an OPPQuantity and OPPQuantity.PROVENANCE is
required, so there is no encoding for a mass, dimension, area or
cross-section that does not name where it came from. Unknown values are
absent. A consumer that finds a field missing has learned that no admissible
source published it.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 record-format version, not a content revision.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID verbatim. Zero when the object has no catalogue number.

OBJECT_NAME.description: $CAT.OBJECT_NAME verbatim, for display only. Never a join key.

ENTITY_ID.description:
Stable non-catalogue entity key, such as an asset catalogue entity path.
MUST equal ASSET.ENTITY_ID when ASSET is present.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the $BUS record describing this object's bus design; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. Empty when the bus is unknown or has no
$BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY.description:
Bus or platform family name verbatim from BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.SOURCE,
for objects whose family is known but has no $BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of BUS_FAMILY. Present whenever BUS_FAMILY is nonempty.

MANUFACTURER.description: Manufacturer or prime contractor as stated by MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.

MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of MANUFACTURER. Present whenever MANUFACTURER is nonempty.

RADAR_CROSS_SECTIONS.description:
One entry per band, polarization and aspect the sources publish. Empty
means no source published a radar cross-section for this object.

VISUAL_MAGNITUDE.description:
Visual magnitude, UNITS "mag", with the observing conditions in
PROVENANCE.NOTES.

ASSET.description:
Binding to the exact reviewed 3D asset this record accompanies. Absent for
an object with no asset; the physical values remain valid without it.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted while building this record, including sources that
yielded no value. Lets a consumer distinguish "not looked for" from
"looked for and not published".

CREATED_AT.description:

the record was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded $OPP bytes.

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

R_PERIAPSIS.description: Radius of periapsis (km). Preferred for hyperbolic orbits.

Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).

Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).

Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for position/velocity coefficients.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

Fit span in seconds used to generate each polynomial segment.
Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

CARTESIAN_PV.description: Cartesian position and velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT).

CARTESIAN_PVA.description: Cartesian position, velocity, and acceleration (9 components).

POLYNOMIAL_POS.description: Polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position (and optionally velocity). Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.

POLYNOMIAL_OE.description: Polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements. Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomial representation.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomial representation.

TRAJ_TYPE_DESCRIPTION.description:
Legacy trajectory type string for backward compatibility and extended types
(e.g., "PROPAGATED", "ESTIMATED", "FILTERED").

STATE_STEP_SIZE.description: Time interval between state vectors in seconds (required for time-series data).

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = METADATA.START_TIME + (i * STATE_STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular).
Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for X, Y, Z position (and optionally velocity).
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.description:
Polynomial orbital element records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_OE. Each record covers a time segment
with polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

TXSProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for ONE source's report of ONE facility, emission, or
scheduled transmission.

Every source consulted gets its own entry, including sources that returned
nothing, so a consumer can tell "not looked for" from "looked for and
returned nothing". Source identity is DATA: PROVIDER_ID and AUTHORITY carry
verbatim what that source states about itself.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the consulted source, unique
within the publisher's own source registry. Never a display name and
never a URL.

AUTHORITY.description:
The authority under which that source publishes, verbatim as the source
states it: a spectrum regulator, an international coordination register,
a licensee, a monitoring service, or an observer compilation. Never
inferred by the publisher.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or request parameters used, so the same rows can
be recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed record whose terms are unstated. A source that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This source's own row, record, licence or file identifier, verbatim.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority this particular source speaks with about position.
Published per source because a record may merge a regulator lane with a
community lane; the record-level POSITION_AUTHORITY states which class the
PUBLISHED coordinate came from.

Position this source reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This source's report materially contributed to the published record.
False marks a source that was consulted and either returned nothing or
was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TXSConsensus.description:
How one facility's independent source reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

Agreement is CORROBORATION and is never authority: five compilations that
copied one another agree perfectly and establish nothing. Read this table
beside POSITION_AUTHORITY, never instead of it.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Sources queried for this facility, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

PROVIDERS_DISAGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell OUTSIDE that threshold and were not
reconciled. Non-zero is the machine-readable form of a contested
position and is published alongside POSITION_DISPUTED.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single source.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
source's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

RFLObstruction.description:
One obstacle interaction on one sample's path. SPARSE: entries exist only
where an interaction was computed, so a clear path is never encoded as a
row of zeroes.

This is the join that makes an arbitrary 3D object a first-class part of
the link budget: MATERIAL_ID names the `$RFS` record whose permittivity,
conductivity, penetration loss and roughness produced LOSS_DB, and
GEOMETRY_REF_ID names the exact mesh, face set, panel or analytic shape
inside it that was hit.

no material is an unattributed number: a metal panel and a plasterboard
wall of the same size do entirely different things to a link.

INTERFERER.description: An interferer degrading the wanted signal.

RELAY.description: An intermediate relay in a multi-hop chain.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` — the band specification.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the emitter is on orbit. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the emitter is a terrestrial site.

ID_BEAM.description: Beam and channel within the emitter.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Carrier centre frequency, megahertz — the `$RFB` convention.

EIRP_DBW.description: EIRP toward boresight used in the evaluation, dBW.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization, defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly because `rfPolarization`
ordinal 0 is LHCP.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Emitter position at EPOCH, when the geometry is instantaneous. Geodetic
degrees and metres. Absent means "join it from the source record" — a
stale copied position is worse than none.

CONTRIBUTION_WEIGHT.description: Weight of this emitter's contribution to a union or aggregate [0-1].

CVPReceiverRef.description:
A receiver the coverage was evaluated FOR. Coverage is never absolute: a
-110 dBW contour means one thing for a 60 cm terminal and another for a
12 m dish, so the assumed receiver is part of the record.

SPACECRAFT.description: On-orbit object; joins `$CAT` by NORAD_CAT_ID / OBJECT_ID.

GEODETIC_TRACKING_STATION.description: Geodetic tracking station; joins `$GST` by STATION_ID.

RELAY_PAYLOAD.description: A relay payload acting as an intermediate endpoint of a multi-hop chain.

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum elevation the receiver can work at, degrees.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this receiver belongs to, matching
`$RFL.RFLLink.RECEIVER_GROUP_ID`.

CVPObstacleRef.description:
A 3D obstacle that shaped this coverage boundary. A footprint clipped by
buildings, a spacecraft structure or terrain is a claim about those
objects; publishing the obstacle set with its `$RFS` materials is what
makes the clipped boundary reproducible.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface. Absent means the obstacle was treated
as an opaque blocker with no material physics — which a consumer is
entitled to know.

VAM_ID.description: `$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT` identity when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

INTERACTION.description: How the obstacle acted on the field.

LINE_OF_SIGHT_BLOCKAGE.description: The obstacle blocked line of sight; no energy was propagated through it.

TRANSMISSION.description: Energy passed through the obstacle and paid its penetration loss.

REFLECTION.description: Energy reached the receiver by reflecting off the obstacle.

DIFFRACTION.description: Energy reached the receiver by diffracting around an edge.

SCATTERING.description: Energy reached the receiver by rough-surface scattering.

FRESNEL_INTRUSION.description: The obstacle intruded into the Fresnel zone without blocking the direct ray.

LATITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres.

CVPUncertainty.description:
How wrong this geometry can be. A contour with no uncertainty is a drawing,
not a measurement.

HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M.description:
1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty of the boundary, metres. Applies
to every vertex unless VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M is present.

LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the level the contour was drawn at, in
LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY_UNITS.

CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence the stated uncertainties correspond to [0-1], e.g. 0.68.

EXTRACTION_TOLERANCE.description: Tolerance the contour extractor converged to, in the metric's units.

SIMPLIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Simplification tolerance applied to the rings, metres. A simplified ring
is not the computed boundary and MUST say so.

METHOD.description:
How the uncertainty was established (e.g. "grid resolution bound",
"Monte Carlo over emitter state covariance").

MEASURED.description: Values recorded by instrumentation on a real link.

MODELED.description: Values produced by propagation and RF models.

HYBRID.description: Modelled geometry reconciled against measured RF terms, or vice versa.

SOURCE.description: Producing system, dataset or campaign. Required.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Propagator that produced the emitter geometry. A MODELED or HYBRID
product MUST name it.

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced the rings.

MODELS.description:
Per-term model bindings for the metric that was contoured, reusing the
`$RFL` binding so a footprint and the samples behind it cite the same
models.

CONTOUR_ALGORITHM.description:
Algorithm that turned the sampled field into rings (e.g. "marching
squares", "alpha shape", "H3 cell union").

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description: Environment and terrain datasets the evaluation used.

OBSTACLE_DATASET.description: Dataset the 3D obstacles and their materials were drawn from.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms computed and retrieved.

LICENSE.description: Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS.

COVERAGE_ID.description: Stable identifier of this geometry product.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$RFL` samples
and `$ACI` intervals of the same study.

THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.description: The boundary where the metric meets THRESHOLD_VALUE.

ISO_METRIC_CONTOUR.description: A set of iso-level contours; POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES carries each level.

FOOTPRINT.description: The instantaneous beam or antenna footprint on the surface.

HORIZON_MASK.description: The horizon or terrain mask boundary for one endpoint.

INTERFERENCE_ZONE.description: The region in which a stated interference criterion is exceeded.

UNION_COVERAGE.description: The union of many contributing footprints or contours.

INTERSECTION_COVERAGE.description: The intersection of many contributing footprints or contours.

GAP_REGION.description: The region NOT covered — a gap, stated as geometry rather than left to be inferred by subtracting a coverage polygon from the globe.

KEEP_OUT_ZONE.description: A region a transmitter is prohibited from illuminating.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS.description: Loss caused by an obstacle with stated `$RFS` material properties.

SYMBOL_ENERGY_TO_NOISE_DENSITY.description: Energy per transmitted symbol divided by noise spectral density.

BLOCK_ERROR_RATE.description: Error probability for a decoded transport block or frame.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY.description: Delivered information bits per second per hertz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE.description: Data rate delivered by the selected modulation and coding entry.

ACM_MARGIN.description: Margin above the threshold of the selected adaptive entry.

METRIC_UNITS.description: Units of the metric and of POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: The threshold the boundary was drawn at, for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.

EPOCH.description:
Instantaneous epoch, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM.
Set for FOOTPRINT and other instantaneous products; NaN for aggregates.

INTERVAL_START.description:
Interval this geometry holds over, same encoding. Set for aggregated
products (union over a window, availability contour); NaN for
instantaneous ones. A product that states neither EPOCH nor an interval
is untethered in time and MUST be refused.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale all epochs in this record are expressed in. Defaults to UTC
explicitly: `timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

GENERATION.description:
Monotonic generation of this coverage product within its COVERAGE_ID
lineage. A streaming producer increments it per emission; a consumer
holding a higher generation MUST NOT be overwritten by a lower one.

SUPERSEDES_COVERAGE_ID.description: COVERAGE_ID this record replaces, when the lineage was re-identified.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

VERTEX_ALTITUDE_M.description:
Vertex altitudes, metres above ALTITUDE_REFERENCE. Absent when the
geometry lies on the reference surface.

TERRAIN.description: Draped on terrain from the dataset named in CVPProvenance.TERRAIN_DATASET.

FIXED_ALTITUDE.description: A constant altitude plane; the value is in FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.

FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.description: The constant altitude, metres, when ALTITUDE_REFERENCE is FIXED_ALTITUDE.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals the vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description: Polygon each ring belongs to. Same length as RING_COUNT.

RING_ROLES.description: Role of each ring. Same length as RING_COUNT.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1 and is published
so an empty coverage field (zero polygons, zero rings) is representable
and distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.description:
Metric value each polygon is drawn at, in METRIC_UNITS. Same length as
POLYGON_COUNT. Carried for ISO_METRIC_CONTOUR; for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR
every entry equals THRESHOLD_VALUE.

POLYGON_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTIES.description: 1-sigma uncertainty of each polygon's level, same units and length.

POLYGON_AREA_KM2.description: Surface area enclosed by each polygon, square kilometres.

VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Per-vertex 1-sigma horizontal uncertainty, metres. Same length as the
vertex arrays. Absent means CVPUncertainty.HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M governs
the whole boundary.

GRID_SCHEME.description:
Grid the field was sampled on before contouring, e.g. "H3" or
"GEODETIC_LATLON". A contour is never finer than the grid behind it.

GRID_RESOLUTION.description: Grid resolution in the scheme's own convention (H3 resolution 0-15).

GRID_SPACING_DEG.description: Grid spacing in degrees, for a geodetic lat/lon grid.

CVG_COVERAGE_ID.description:
`$CVG.COVERAGE_ID` of the figure-of-merit grid this geometry was
contoured from, when one was published.

RFL_ID.description:
`$RFL.RFL_ID` of the sample set the field was evaluated from, when one
was published.

ACI_ID.description:
`$ACI.ACI_ID` of the interval set an availability or gap product was
aggregated from, when one was published.

CONTRIBUTING_EMITTERS.description:
Emitters that contributed. Required: coverage with no stated emitter is
an unattributable claim about the sky.

RECEIVER_SET_ID.description: Identifier of the receiver set this coverage is stated for.

RECEIVERS.description: The receivers themselves, when the set is enumerable.

CONTRIBUTING_OBSTACLES.description:
3D obstacles that clipped or shaped the boundary, each naming the `$RFS`
material that produced its effect.

OBSTACLE_SET_ID.description:
Identifier of the obstacle set used, when it is published as a set rather
than enumerated here.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT.description: The condition that bounds the boundary — why the contour is where it is.

OBSTACLE_BLOCKAGE.description: A 3D obstacle intersected the path. The material that did it is named in RFLObstruction.MATERIAL_ID (`$RFS`).

MATERIAL_PENETRATION.description: The path passed THROUGH an obstacle and paid its penetration loss.

OTHER.description: The producer states a binding condition this enum cannot express. The verbatim description MUST be preserved in LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description, required when LIMITING_CONSTRAINT is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`.

RCS.description: Radar cross section (m^2).

TARGET_INDEX.description: Index of target in input array.

ORIENT_W.description: Sensor orientation as quaternion (W, X, Y, Z).

RADAR.description: Radar-specific config when CATEGORY == RADAR.

SENSOR_ORIENT_W.description: Sensor orientation as quaternion (W, X, Y, Z).

INPUT_OFFSET.description: Input buffer offset where targetState[] starts.

TARGET_COUNT.description: Number of targets in the input buffer.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset where detectionResult[] is written.

EPOCH.description: Current time as a Julian date.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in arena where detectionResult[] starts.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Error message when ERROR_CODE != 0.

SDRSingleInput.description:
Compact single-frame detection input used by pluggable sensor models that
do not drive arena-backed batches.

RCS.description: Radar cross section (m^2).

EPOCH.description: Epoch of drift measurement (ISO 8601)

START_TIME.description: History start time (ISO 8601)

MEAN_LONGITUDE.description: Current mean longitude in degrees East

SLOT_CENTER.description: Longitude slot center in degrees East (if station-keeping)

LOS_OCCLUSION.description: Geometric line-of-sight occlusion only; propagation on visible cells.

DIFFRACTION_ASSISTED.description: Knife-edge diffraction assists shadowed cells (ITU-R P.526-15).

SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE.description: Adds a single specular ground-bounce contribution.

FREE_SPACE.description: Free-space path loss. Holds ordinal 0 and is the default.

CUSTOM.description: A model this enum cannot express; the solver names it out of band.

OK.description: Solve completed; every layer is present for every cell.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite where a value is required, or dimensionally inconsistent.

REFUSED.description: The solver does not implement the requested physics. ERROR_MESSAGE names the gap; NO layers are carried. A refusal is never a fallback.

TRSRequest.description:
One terrain raster solve request.

FRAMES. The analysis frame is a local East-North-Up (ENU) frame: local X
is east, Y is north, Z is up. Both grids share the same analysis-frame
bounds, anchored at (MIN_EAST_M, MIN_NORTH_M). Per-cell geodetic
coordinates are carried explicitly in GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD /
GRID_LATITUDE_RAD so a solver recomputes exact per-cell Earth-fixed
geometry instead of interpolating it.

PROFILE_WIDTH.description:
Obstruction profile field width, cells. The profile is a FINER field
than the output raster; the line-of-sight march samples it.

SOLVER_TIER.description:
Fidelity tier requested. A solver that does not implement the tier
REFUSES; it never silently downgrades.

LOS_OCCLUSION.description: Geometric line-of-sight occlusion only; propagation on visible cells.

DIFFRACTION_ASSISTED.description: Knife-edge diffraction assists shadowed cells (ITU-R P.526-15).

SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE.description: Adds a single specular ground-bounce contribution.

PROPAGATION_MODEL.description:
Propagation model requested for the per-cell loss term. A solver that
does not implement the model REFUSES; it never silently substitutes.

FREE_SPACE.description: Free-space path loss. Holds ordinal 0 and is the default.

CUSTOM.description: A model this enum cannot express; the solver names it out of band.

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_MASK.description:
Atmospheric attenuation terms requested, as a bitmask: 0 none,
bit 0 (1) gaseous absorption, bit 1 (2) rain attenuation, bit 2 (4)
cloud/fog attenuation. A solver that does not implement a requested
term REFUSES.

THREAD_COUNT_HINT.description:
Parallelism hint. 0 or 1 means sequential. A solver MUST produce
byte-identical layers at any value — cells are independent and a thread
writes only its own indices; determinism is part of this contract.

MIN_EAST_M.description: Analysis-frame east coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

MIN_NORTH_M.description: Analysis-frame north coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

PROFILE_SPACING_M.description: Profile sample spacing, meters; sets the line-of-sight march stride.

MINIMUM_STEP_M.description:
Minimum march step, meters. NaN means caller left it unset and the
solver applies its own documented default.

TX_LOCAL_X_M.description:
Emitter position in the analysis ENU frame, meters (X east, Y north,
Z up).

TX_ECEF_X_M.description:
Emitter Earth-centered Earth-fixed position, meters — carried so the
solver computes exact per-cell range rather than a small-angle
approximation.

TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M.description: Emitter height above the reference ellipsoid, meters.

TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Terrain surface height under the emitter, meters above the ellipsoid.
Emitter height above ground = TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M −
TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.

INVERSE_ENU_TRANSFORM.description:
Column-major 4x4 inverse of the analysis ENU frame transform (the
matrix that takes Earth-fixed points INTO the analysis frame). Exactly
16 entries.

TARGET_HEIGHT_M.description: Receiver height above ground at every cell, meters.

BANDWIDTH_HZ.description:
Noise bandwidth, hertz. NaN means caller left it unset and the solver
applies its own documented default.

TX_POWER_W.description: Transmit power, watts. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Transmit line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

RX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Receive line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_NOISE_FIGURE_DB.description: Receiver noise figure, dB. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

EFFECTIVE_EARTH_RADIUS_FACTOR.description:
Effective Earth radius factor (k-factor) for curvature correction.
NaN means no curvature term is applied — NOT a default of 4/3.

GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic longitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GRID_LATITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic latitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GROUND_HEIGHTS_M.description:
Terrain height at every output cell, meters above the ellipsoid,
row-major, GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_HEIGHTS_M.description:
COMPOSITE obstruction surface (terrain plus structures) at every
profile cell, meters above the ellipsoid, row-major,
PROFILE_WIDTH * PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_SURFACE_Z_M.description:
The same composite surface expressed as analysis-frame Z, meters —
the frame the line-of-sight test runs in. PROFILE_WIDTH *
PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

TRSResult.description:
One terrain raster solve result. On STATUS = OK every layer below is
present with exactly GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT row-major entries. On any
other STATUS the result carries NO layers — never a partial raster.

OK.description: Solve completed; every layer is present for every cell.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite where a value is required, or dimensionally inconsistent.

REFUSED.description: The solver does not implement the requested physics. ERROR_MESSAGE names the gap; NO layers are carried. A refusal is never a fallback.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description:
On REFUSED or INVALID_INPUT: names the exact gap or defect. Empty on
OK.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Output raster dimensions the layers are stated for, echoed from the
request.

VISIBLE_MASK.description:
1 where the geometric ray from the emitter clears the obstruction
surface, else 0.

PATH_CLASS.description:
Path classification of every cell from the dominant-edge diffraction
parameter — see trsPathClass.

PATH_LOSS_DB.description: Total path loss including every applied term, dB (positive).

EXCESS_LOSS_DB.description: Loss above free space — what the terrain cost the cell, dB.

DIFFRACTION_PARAMETER.description:
ITU-R P.526-15 eq. (29) diffraction parameter v of the dominant edge.
Exactly -10.0 where no finite v exists (an unobstructed, Fresnel-clear
path) — the layer's stated no-finite-v encoding, carried verbatim so
the FlatBuffer and aligned-binary forms stay byte-comparable.

REFLECTION_CONTRIBUTION_DB.description:
Specular ground-bounce contribution, dB. All zeros outside the
SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE tier.

TRACE_ID.description:
Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when
present.

PASS_DURATION.description: Duration of the observation pass in seconds

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the BUS record describing this object's satellite bus; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. MANUFACTURER, DIM_X/DIM_Y/DIM_Z, DRY_MASS
and WET_MASS are properties of the bus design and live on BUS — they are

PPEPositionRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position
(and optionally velocity). Coefficients are stored per axis.

To evaluate position at time t within this record's validity window:
1. Compute normalized time: tau = (t - EPOCH_MID) / EPOCH_HALF_SPAN
where tau is in [-1, +1].
2. Evaluate the polynomial basis of degree (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1) using
the coefficients for each axis.

Velocity coefficients, if present, follow the same evaluation procedure.
If HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS is false, velocity can be obtained by
analytically differentiating the position polynomial.

EPOCH_MID.description:
Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).
Together with EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, defines the time interval:
[EPOCH_MID - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN]

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description:
Half-span of the validity window in seconds.
The full span is 2 * EPOCH_HALF_SPAN seconds centered on EPOCH_MID.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Number of polynomial coefficients per axis.
The polynomial degree is (NUM_COEFFICIENTS - 1).
Typical values: 8-32 for high-fidelity ephemeris fits.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POS_COEFF_X.description:
Position coefficients for X-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS. Ordered c0, c1, ..., c_{N-1}.

POS_COEFF_Y.description:
Position coefficients for Y-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

POS_COEFF_Z.description:
Position coefficients for Z-axis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

HAS_VELOCITY_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Whether explicit velocity coefficients are provided.
If false, velocity should be derived by differentiating the position polynomial.

VEL_COEFF_X.description:
Velocity coefficients for X-axis (km/s). Optional.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS if present.

MAX_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: Maximum position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

RMS_POSITION_RESIDUAL.description: RMS position fit residual over this segment (km). Optional quality metric.

PPEOrbitalElementRecord.description:
A single time-segment record of polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements.

The six classical elements are:
1. SMA or R_PERIAPSIS (size/shape) — see SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE
2. Eccentricity (dimensionless)
3. Inclination (degrees)
4. Right Ascension of Ascending Node / RAAN (degrees)
5. Argument of Periapsis (degrees)
6. Anomaly (degrees) — see ANOMALY_TYPE

Evaluation follows the same normalized-time procedure as PPEPositionRecord.

EPOCH_MID.description: Midpoint epoch of this record's validity window (ISO 8601 UTC or TDB).

EPOCH_HALF_SPAN.description: Half-span of the validity window in seconds.

NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description: Number of polynomial coefficients per element.

BASIS_TYPE.description: Polynomial basis type for interpreting the coefficient arrays.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

SIZE_SHAPE_TYPE.description: Parameterization of the first orbital element (SMA vs R_PERIAPSIS).

SMA.description: Semi-major axis (km). Standard for elliptical orbits.

R_PERIAPSIS.description: Radius of periapsis (km). Preferred for hyperbolic orbits.

ANOMALY_TYPE.description: Anomaly type for the sixth orbital element.

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: Mean anomaly (linear in time for Keplerian motion).

ECCENTRIC_ANOMALY.description: Eccentric anomaly (auxiliary angle in the Kepler equation).

COEFF_SIZE_SHAPE.description:
Coefficients for SMA or radius of periapsis (km).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ECCENTRICITY.description:
Coefficients for eccentricity (dimensionless).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_INCLINATION.description:
Coefficients for inclination (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_RAAN.description:
Coefficients for RAAN (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ARG_PERIAPSIS.description:
Coefficients for argument of periapsis (degrees).
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

COEFF_ANOMALY.description:
Coefficients for anomaly (degrees). See ANOMALY_TYPE for interpretation.
Length must equal NUM_COEFFICIENTS.

MAX_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description:
Maximum element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.
Units depend on the element (km for SMA, degrees for angles, dimensionless for ecc).

RMS_ELEMENT_RESIDUAL.description: RMS element fit residual over this segment. Optional quality metric.

PPE.description:
Polynomial Ephemeris — top-level message containing metadata and
one or more polynomial coefficient records for a single space object.

A PPE message may contain position records, orbital element records, or both.
Records should be ordered chronologically by EPOCH_MID and should collectively
cover the time span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME] without gaps.

CENTER_NAME.description: Origin of the reference frame (e.g., EARTH, MOON, MARS).

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame for position/velocity coefficients.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used for all epochs in this message.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

START_TIME.description: Start of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

STOP_TIME.description: End of the total time span covered by this ephemeris (ISO 8601).

DEFAULT_BASIS_TYPE.description:
Default polynomial basis type for all records in this message.
Individual records may override this with their own BASIS_TYPE field.

CHEBYSHEV.description: Chebyshev polynomials of the first kind T_n(x). Most common for ephemeris fitting due to minimax approximation properties.

LEGENDRE.description: Legendre polynomials P_n(x). Orthogonal on [-1, 1] with unit weight function.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomials. Matches both function values and derivatives at nodes.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomials. Exact interpolation through specified nodes.

POWER_SERIES.description: Standard power series (monomial basis): c0 + c1*x + c2*x^2 + ...

POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Array of position polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

ORBITAL_ELEMENT_RECORDS.description:
Array of orbital element polynomial records.
Each record covers a time segment; together they span [START_TIME, STOP_TIME].

EPHEMERIS_SOURCE.description:
Generating ephemeris source, verbatim as the generator names itself
(e.g., a planetary ephemeris series designation, a numerical propagator
name and version, or an in-house tool identifier).

NOMINAL_SEGMENT_SPAN.description:

Informational; actual spans are in individual records.

NOMINAL_NUM_COEFFICIENTS.description:
Nominal number of coefficients per segment.
Informational; actual counts are in individual records.

INTERPOLATION.description:
Recommended interpolation method for ephemeris data.
Supported methods: Hermite, Linear, Lagrange, Chebyshev.
When set to "Chebyshev", parsers should use POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS
for high-fidelity polynomial interpolation instead of interpolating across
discrete state vectors.

INTERPOLATION_DEGREE.description: Recommended interpolation degree for ephemeris data

STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between ephemeris states in seconds.
If > 0: Use compact EPHEMERIS_DATA array (times are implicit).
If 0 or omitted: Use EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES with explicit epochs.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector in EPHEMERIS_DATA array.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0. Default is 6.

EPHEMERIS_DATA.description:
Compact ephemeris data as row-major array of doubles.
Only used when STEP_SIZE > 0.
Layout: [x0,y0,z0,xdot0,ydot0,zdot0, x1,y1,z1,xdot1,ydot1,zdot1, ...]
Units: position in km, velocity in km/s, acceleration in km/s²
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.
Number of states = length(EPHEMERIS_DATA) / STATE_VECTOR_SIZE

EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES.description:
Array of ephemeris data lines with explicit epochs.
Only used when STEP_SIZE == 0 or omitted (non-uniform time steps).
Each line contains its own EPOCH timestamp.

POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.description:
Optional polynomial position records for high-fidelity interpolation.
Used when INTERPOLATION is "Chebyshev". Each record covers a time segment with
polynomial coefficients for continuous position (and optionally velocity) evaluation.
See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

TRAJ_TYPE.description:
Trajectory state representation type.
Determines how orbit state data is parameterized in this message.
For CARTESIAN_PV/CARTESIAN_PVA, use STATE_DATA array.
For POLYNOMIAL_POS/POLYNOMIAL_OE, use the corresponding polynomial record arrays.

CARTESIAN_PV.description: Cartesian position and velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT).

CARTESIAN_PVA.description: Cartesian position, velocity, and acceleration (9 components).

POLYNOMIAL_POS.description: Polynomial coefficients for Cartesian position (and optionally velocity). Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_POSITION_RECORDS.

POLYNOMIAL_OE.description: Polynomial coefficients for classical orbital elements. Associated data in POLYNOMIAL_OE_RECORDS.

HERMITE.description: Hermite interpolating polynomial representation.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange interpolating polynomial representation.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description:
Number of components per state vector.
6 = position + velocity (X, Y, Z, X_DOT, Y_DOT, Z_DOT)
9 = position + velocity + acceleration (adds X_DDOT, Y_DDOT, Z_DDOT)

STATE_DATA.description:
State data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [X0, Y0, Z0, X_DOT0, Y_DOT0, Z_DOT0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = METADATA.START_TIME + (i * STATE_STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
Covariance data as flat array (21 elements per epoch for 6x6 lower triangular).
Time alignment matches STATE_DATA epochs.

Polynomial position records.
Used when TRAJ_TYPE is POLYNOMIAL_POS. Each record covers a time segment

See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

See PPE schema for record structure and evaluation procedure.

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description: Signature encoding format (e.g., "compact", "raw-ed25519")

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.

IQC.description:
RF IQ Capture Metadata.

The description of ONE raw, un-demodulated complex-baseband recording held
in a public archive — a hosted IQ-capture repository, a crowdsourced
signal-identification catalog, an institutional dataset repository, an
SDR project's capture database, a general-purpose research data archive —
normalized onto the SigMF v1 core namespace, which is the only metadata
vocabulary these archive classes share.

$IQC is a POINTER RECORD. It exists so a capture is discoverable, joinable
and verifiable without anyone mirroring its payload: the samples stay where
their publisher put them and `PAYLOADS` says where that is, how large it
is, and what it hashes to. `iqcCustody.PINNED` is a deliberate per-capture
decision for small high-value recordings, never a default.

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE AND NAMED IN EVERY FIELD. SigMF publishes frequency and
sample rate in HERTZ, so every frequency and rate field here is `_HZ` and
carries the Hz value unconverted. This standard deliberately does NOT
follow $RFB's MHz convention — silently rescaling a SigMF value on ingest
is the exact defect the suffix exists to prevent. A consumer joining $IQC
to $RFB divides by 1e6 at the join, explicitly.

LICENCE IS NEVER ASSUMED. An empty `LICENSE` means the terms are UNKNOWN.
It does not mean public domain, it does not mean permissive, and it does
not authorize redistribution. Crowdsourced catalogs and hosted repositories
both carry third-party recordings, so licence is per RECORDING, never per
archive.

Division of labour: $RFO = a sensor's astrometric/RF observation of a
tracked object (azimuth, elevation, range); $RFE = the parametric emitter
description; $RFB = the emitter's band specification in MHz; $IQC = the
archived baseband recording itself. $DPM remains the manifest under which
THIS network publishes a shard of $IQC records; it does not describe an
upstream third party's capture.

SOURCE_NAME.description:
Name of the archive that publishes the capture, carried verbatim as that

FREQ_UPPER_EDGE_HZ.description: Highest occupied frequency across the recording, HERTZ.

SAMPLE_OFFSET.description:

METADATA_ONLY.description:

TRAILING_BYTES.description:

CAPTURE_START.description:

CAPTURE_STOP.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of the recording, when stated or exactly derivable.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No capability class stated. The publisher did not classify the unit. A consumer MUST render an UNSPECIFIED unit as ungrouped and MUST NOT infer a class from the unit's name, description or tags. Display name: "Unspecified".

PROPAGATION.description: Advancing an object's state forward or backward in time under a force model, and interpolating between computed states. Display name: "Propagation".

ORBIT_DETERMINATION.description: Estimating an object's state or model parameters by fitting to observations or ephemerides. Display name: "Orbit Determination".

MANEUVER_PLANNING.description: Planning, targeting and optimizing trajectory changes, including station-keeping, transfers and collision-avoidance maneuvers. Display name: "Maneuver Planning".

CONJUNCTION_ASSESSMENT.description: Screening for close approaches between objects and quantifying collision probability and miss distance. Display name: "Conjunction Assessment".

REENTRY_AND_BREAKUP.description: Atmospheric reentry, decay prediction, fragmentation and debris-cloud evolution. Display name: "Reentry & Breakup".

ATTITUDE_AND_POINTING.description: Attitude determination and control, body orientation, and pointing or slew planning. Display name: "Attitude & Pointing".

REFERENCE_FRAMES_AND_TIME.description: Coordinate frame realization and transformation, time scale conversion, and earth-orientation parameter handling. Display name: "Reference Frames & Time".

SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE.description: Sensor modelling and tasking, field-of-regard and access computation, and area or target coverage figures of merit. Display name: "Sensors & Coverage".

TRACKING_AND_OBSERVATION.description: Producing, correlating or associating observations of tracked objects, and maintaining tracks from them. Display name: "Tracking & Observation".

RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS.description: Radio-frequency link modelling, emitter and band characterization, signal capture handling, and communications planning. Display name: "RF & Communications".

ELECTRONIC_WARFARE.description: Interference, jamming, spoofing and countermeasure modelling. Display name: "Electronic Warfare".

SPACE_ENVIRONMENT.description: Atmospheric density, gravity field, magnetic field, radiation, solar and geomagnetic activity, and ionospheric modelling. Display name: "Space Environment".

DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST.description: Acquiring bytes from upstream providers and parsing or exporting them across canonical record formats. Display name: "Data Sources & Ingest".

DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY.description: Validating records for integrity, physical plausibility, continuity and schema conformance, and scoring data quality. Display name: "Data Validation & Quality".

CATALOG_AND_IDENTITY.description: Object catalogue curation, cross-identifier resolution, bus and physical property association, and entity identity. Display name: "Catalog & Identity".

VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING.description: Rendering, scene composition, shading and interactive display of space data. Display name: "Visualization & Rendering".

GROUND_SEGMENT_AND_HARDWARE.description: Ground station operation and control of physical equipment, including antenna rotators, radios and other hardware interfaces. Display name: "Ground Segment & Hardware".

MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS.description: Mission and constellation design, trade studies, performance analysis and report generation. Display name: "Mission Design & Analysis".

FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION.description: Composition of other units into a graph. The unit of distribution is a flow of modules, not a leaf algorithm. Display name: "Flows & Composition".

DATA_STORAGE_AND_QUERY.description: Persisting, indexing and querying records; storage engines and query surfaces. Display name: "Data Storage & Query".

SECURITY_AND_IDENTITY.description: Key custody, signing and verification, authentication, authorization and access control. Display name: "Security & Identity".

COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING.description: Listing, purchase, subscription, entitlement and license enforcement for distributed units. Display name: "Commerce & Licensing".

NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Node runtime, artifact delivery, registry, publication and peer transport plumbing. Display name: "Node Infrastructure".

FOUNDATION_AND_MATH.description: Foundational mathematics and general-purpose utility libraries consumed by other units rather than run on their own. Display name: "Foundation & Math".

UsageBased.description: Usage-based billing settled after metered delivery

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this listing is shelved under, using the
same vocabulary and semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY and
APP.PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Before this field existed a listing carried no
capability category at all — only DATA_TYPES and TAGS — so a storefront
shelf and a library shelf were grouped by two unrelated systems. A
consumer MUST group listings by this field and MUST NOT re-derive a
category from DATA_TYPES, TAGS or TITLE, none of which are a controlled
vocabulary.

Distinct from LISTING_KIND, which is the delivery kind (data stream vs
module artifact), and from ACCESS_TYPE, which is the commercial access
model. UNSPECIFIED means the provider did not classify the listing; a
consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.
