ATTITUDE_COMPONENTS.description:
Number of components per attitude state.
7 = quaternion + angular rates (Q1, Q2, Q3, QC, RATE_X, RATE_Y, RATE_Z)
4 = quaternion only (Q1, Q2, Q3, QC)

ATTITUDE_DATA.description:
Attitude data as row-major array of doubles.
Layout: [Q1_0, Q2_0, Q3_0, QC_0, RATE_X_0, RATE_Y_0, RATE_Z_0, Q1_1, ...]
Time reconstruction: epoch[i] = START_TIME + (i * STEP_SIZE)
Length must be divisible by ATTITUDE_COMPONENTS.

SOURCE_ID.description: Reference to source imagery (e.g., SKI, GDI, EOO)

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

EXCEEDANCE_PERCENT.description:
Percent of time a loss value is exceeded, in descending or ascending
order as stated by PROVENANCE. Every curve below has this length.

XPD_DB.description: Cross-polarization discrimination at each exceedance percentage, dB.

WORST_MONTH_EXCEEDANCE_PERCENT.description: Exceedance percentage used for the worst-month summary.

AVAILABILITY_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the analysis window meeting the stated link requirement.

OUTAGE_MINUTES_PER_YEAR.description: Annualized minutes not meeting the stated link requirement.

WORST_MONTH_OUTAGE_MINUTES.description: Worst-month outage minutes for the analysis window's month length.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

APPModuleRef.description:
One member WASM module of the app. References module identity; never
embeds the module artifact itself (delivery is the module-bundle lane).

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this module. Required, unique within
the manifest.

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin identifier of the module as published in its plugin listing.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) WASM bytes. This is
the identity capability policies and signature policies key on.

VERSION.description: Module version expected by the app.

ROLE.description: Free-text launcher hint, for example primary, worker, or ui-host.

MAX_WALL_CLOCK_MS.description:
Per-invocation wall-clock budget override in milliseconds. Zero means
the host runtime default applies.

MAX_COST_UNITS.description:
Per-invocation execution-cost (fuel) budget override. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

MAX_MEMORY_PAGES.description:
Linear-memory ceiling override in 64 KiB WASM pages. Zero means the
host runtime default applies.

RUNTIME_TARGET.description:
Where this module is instantiated. PAGE or BOTH means the module also
loads in the browser: the page resolves its bytes by CONTENT_HASH over
IPFS and instantiates it through the SAME isomorphic module-sdk harness
ABI the SDN nodes use (manifest + plugin_invoke_stream) — never through
a bespoke page-only loader. Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only behavior of manifests written before this field existed.

NODE.description: Loads only in the desktop/server node runtime.

PAGE.description: Loads in the page through the isomorphic JS harness.

BOTH.description: Loads in both hosts from the same content-addressed bytes and ABI.

APPDataRef.description:
One SDS record type the app produces and/or consumes. Names an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code; the app manifest
defines no data schemas of its own.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this data binding. Required, unique
within the manifest.

SDS_TYPE.description: Existing SDS schema code, for example OMM, CDM, or EPM. Required.

DIRECTION.description: Data flow relative to the app.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
member module responsible for this data binding.

APPSourceRef.description: One upstream data source the app depends on.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this source. Required, unique within
the manifest.

MODULE.description: REF is an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — one member module is itself the source for another.

EXTERNAL_API.description: REF is a URL or endpoint identifier outside the app.

DATASET.description: REF is a dataset or catalog identifier.

REF.description:
Source identifier: an APPModuleRef.ID when KIND is MODULE, otherwise a
URL or dataset identifier. Required.

APPUIPage.description:
One UI page of the app. Exactly one of the two delivery mechanisms must
be populated: inline CONTENT (with ENCODING describing its string form),
or MODULE_ID plus URL for a page served by a member module. Inline pages
must be fully self-contained — CSS and JS inlined, all assets embedded
as data URIs, zero external requests.

ID.description:
App-local stable reference for this page. Required, unique within the
manifest.

TITLE.description: Display title. Falls back to the app NAME when empty.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable summary. Falls back to the app DESCRIPTION when empty.

ICON.description: Launcher icon identifier or inline data URI.

COLOR.description: Launcher accent color, CSS color syntax.

TEXT_COLOR.description: Launcher text color, CSS color syntax.

CONTENT.description:
Inlined, self-contained page in the string form declared by ENCODING.
Empty when the page is module-served via MODULE_ID and URL.

ENCODING.description: String form of CONTENT.

UTF8.description: CONTENT is the literal page text, UTF-8.

BASE64.description: CONTENT is RFC 4648 standard base64 (with padding) of the page bytes.

BASE64_GZIP.description: CONTENT is base64 of the gzip-compressed page bytes.

BASE64_BROTLI.description: CONTENT is base64 of the Brotli-compressed page bytes.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the decoded page bytes, for example text/html.

CONTENT_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the decoded
page bytes, so a launcher can verify inline content after decoding.

ENTRY.description:
True for the page the launcher opens first. Exactly one page in an
app must set this when UI is present.

MODULE_ID.description:
When module-served, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same
manifest — the member module that serves this page.

URL.description:
When module-served, the path or entrypoint the module serves the page
at.

APPDataflow.description:
One unit of the page's data contract: a named flow describing what data
enters or leaves the running page, the SDS standard it carries, how it is
transported, and — when applicable — the loaded module method port bound
to it. Standards-only rule: every flow payload is an SDS record (a
canonical size-prefixed FlatBuffer) or a CID pointing at one; this table
defines no data shapes of its own, it only references an existing
spacedatastandards.org schema by its established code. Locators are
content-addressed and IPFS-first.

NAME.description:
App-local stable name for this flow. Required, unique within the
manifest.

DIRECTION.description: Which way the payload crosses the page boundary at runtime.

TO_PAGE.description: Data is delivered into the page for display or module input.

FROM_PAGE.description: Data is emitted by the page (a module output or user action) for publication or upstream consumption.

BIDIRECTIONAL.description: Data crosses in both directions over the same channel.

SDS_SCHEMA.description:
Existing SDS schema code carried by this flow, for example OMM, OEM, or
PNM. Required. Mirrors APPDataRef.SDS_TYPE but named for the standard
the flow carries; the app defines no schema of its own.

TRANSPORT.description:
Transport that moves the payload. Defaults to IPFS_CID per the
content-addressed, IPFS-first rule.

IPFS_CID.description: LOCATOR is a CID; the page fetches the SDS record bytes by content through the serving node's IPFS gateway.

PUBSUB_TOPIC.description: LOCATOR is a gossip topic name; live SDS records arrive on the topic via the node's pubsub bus.

GATEWAY_ROUTE.description: LOCATOR is a same-origin HTTP route template served by the node that serves the page (used for request-scoped queries and streaming).

LOCATOR.description:
Where to fetch or reach the payload, interpreted per TRANSPORT: a CID
for IPFS_CID, a gossip topic name for PUBSUB_TOPIC, or a same-origin
route template for GATEWAY_ROUTE.

MODULE_ID.description:
When present, must equal an APPModuleRef.ID in the same manifest — the
loaded module that produces or consumes this flow. Binds the flow to a
specific module method port together with METHOD_ID and PORT_ID.

METHOD_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGMethodManifest.METHOD_ID on MODULE_ID that
this flow is bound to.

PORT_ID.description:
When present, the PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID on METHOD_ID that this
flow is bound to.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
String/compression form of the payload as it crosses the channel,
reusing the page content-encoding vocabulary. For flows carrying
canonical SDS FlatBuffer bytes (or a CID string), UTF8 denotes the raw
bytes/string with no extra wrapper; BASE64, BASE64_GZIP, and
BASE64_BROTLI denote a base64 text wrapper (optionally compressed)
applied when the channel is text-only.

UTF8.description: CONTENT is the literal page text, UTF-8.

BASE64.description: CONTENT is RFC 4648 standard base64 (with padding) of the page bytes.

BASE64_GZIP.description: CONTENT is base64 of the gzip-compressed page bytes.

BASE64_BROTLI.description: CONTENT is base64 of the Brotli-compressed page bytes.

APP.description: Application Package Manifest — one launchable app.

ID.description: Stable app identity, unique per publisher. Required.

MODULES.description:
Member WASM modules. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID and every
MODULE-kind REF elsewhere in the manifest must resolve into this list.

DATA.description: SDS record types produced and consumed.

SOURCES.description: Upstream sources depended on.

UI.description: UI pages. Exactly one entry page when nonempty.

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was last updated.

DATAFLOW.description:
The page's declarative data contract: what data enters and leaves the
running page and how. Referential integrity: every MODULE_ID here must
resolve into MODULES, and each MODULE_ID/METHOD_ID/PORT_ID triple must
name a method port advertised by that module's PLG manifest.

RUNTIME_CLASS.description:
App-wide runtime class, reusing appRuntimeTarget. Lets a pulled manifest
self-describe where the app as a whole is meant to run, instead of that
classification being supplied externally at install time. This is the
app-level DEFAULT/DECLARATION only: an individual APPModuleRef.
RUNTIME_TARGET still governs where that specific member module loads and
may specialize away from RUNTIME_CLASS (for example a NODE-class app
with one PAGE-capable module). Defaults to NODE to preserve the prior
node-only assumption of manifests written before this field existed.

NODE.description: Loads only in the desktop/server node runtime.

PAGE.description: Loads in the page through the isomorphic JS harness.

BOTH.description: Loads in both hosts from the same content-addressed bytes and ABI.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this app is shelved under, using the same
vocabulary and the same semantics as PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY, so a storefront
or library shelf holds apps and modules together without translating
between two classification schemes. RUNTIME_CLASS says WHERE an app runs;
PRIMARY_CATEGORY says WHAT IT DOES. They are independent: a NODE-class app
and a PAGE-class app can share a category.
UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not classify the app; a consumer
renders it ungrouped and never infers a class.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No capability class stated. The publisher did not classify the unit. A consumer MUST render an UNSPECIFIED unit as ungrouped and MUST NOT infer a class from the unit's name, description or tags. Display name: "Unspecified".

PROPAGATION.description: Advancing an object's state forward or backward in time under a force model, and interpolating between computed states. Display name: "Propagation".

ORBIT_DETERMINATION.description: Estimating an object's state or model parameters by fitting to observations or ephemerides. Display name: "Orbit Determination".

MANEUVER_PLANNING.description: Planning, targeting and optimizing trajectory changes, including station-keeping, transfers and collision-avoidance maneuvers. Display name: "Maneuver Planning".

CONJUNCTION_ASSESSMENT.description: Screening for close approaches between objects and quantifying collision probability and miss distance. Display name: "Conjunction Assessment".

REENTRY_AND_BREAKUP.description: Atmospheric reentry, decay prediction, fragmentation and debris-cloud evolution. Display name: "Reentry & Breakup".

ATTITUDE_AND_POINTING.description: Attitude determination and control, body orientation, and pointing or slew planning. Display name: "Attitude & Pointing".

REFERENCE_FRAMES_AND_TIME.description: Coordinate frame realization and transformation, time scale conversion, and earth-orientation parameter handling. Display name: "Reference Frames & Time".

SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE.description: Sensor modelling and tasking, field-of-regard and access computation, and area or target coverage figures of merit. Display name: "Sensors & Coverage".

TRACKING_AND_OBSERVATION.description: Producing, correlating or associating observations of tracked objects, and maintaining tracks from them. Display name: "Tracking & Observation".

RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS.description: Radio-frequency link modelling, emitter and band characterization, signal capture handling, and communications planning. Display name: "RF & Communications".

ELECTRONIC_WARFARE.description: Interference, jamming, spoofing and countermeasure modelling. Display name: "Electronic Warfare".

SPACE_ENVIRONMENT.description: Atmospheric density, gravity field, magnetic field, radiation, solar and geomagnetic activity, and ionospheric modelling. Display name: "Space Environment".

DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST.description: Acquiring bytes from upstream providers and parsing or exporting them across canonical record formats. Display name: "Data Sources & Ingest".

DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY.description: Validating records for integrity, physical plausibility, continuity and schema conformance, and scoring data quality. Display name: "Data Validation & Quality".

CATALOG_AND_IDENTITY.description: Object catalogue curation, cross-identifier resolution, bus and physical property association, and entity identity. Display name: "Catalog & Identity".

VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING.description: Rendering, scene composition, shading and interactive display of space data. Display name: "Visualization & Rendering".

GROUND_SEGMENT_AND_HARDWARE.description: Ground station operation and control of physical equipment, including antenna rotators, radios and other hardware interfaces. Display name: "Ground Segment & Hardware".

MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS.description: Mission and constellation design, trade studies, performance analysis and report generation. Display name: "Mission Design & Analysis".

FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION.description: Composition of other units into a graph. The unit of distribution is a flow of modules, not a leaf algorithm. Display name: "Flows & Composition".

DATA_STORAGE_AND_QUERY.description: Persisting, indexing and querying records; storage engines and query surfaces. Display name: "Data Storage & Query".

SECURITY_AND_IDENTITY.description: Key custody, signing and verification, authentication, authorization and access control. Display name: "Security & Identity".

COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING.description: Listing, purchase, subscription, entitlement and license enforcement for distributed units. Display name: "Commerce & Licensing".

NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Node runtime, artifact delivery, registry, publication and peer transport plumbing. Display name: "Node Infrastructure".

FOUNDATION_AND_MATH.description: Foundational mathematics and general-purpose utility libraries consumed by other units rather than run on their own. Display name: "Foundation & Math".

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this app belongs to, for browse, filter and
per-category counting. An app MAY carry several. If nonempty it MUST
include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat.

EPOCH.description: Observation epoch (ISO 8601)

CIRA_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.1 COSPAR International Reference Atmosphere Known years: 1965, 1972, 1986, 1990

GITM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.3 Global Ionosphere-Thermosphere Model GITM has no specific year versions defined

GOST.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.4 GOST atmospheric density model Known version: 2004 (GOST R 25645.166-2004)

GRAM_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.5 Global Reference Atmospheric Model Known version: 2016

HP.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.6 Harris-Priester empirical model Known version: 1962

JAC_HASDM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.7 Jacchia atmosphere model with HASDM correction overlay Based on Jacchia 1970 with HASDM (DCA) overlay

JAC_GILL.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.8 Jacchia-Gill bi-polynomial interpolation Interpolates Jacchia 1971

JB08.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.9 Jacchia-Bowman empirical model Known versions: 2006 (JB2006), 2008 (JB2008)

JR71.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.10 Jacchia-Roberts analytic model Known version: 1971

JXX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.11 Jacchia static diffusion models Known years: 1970, 1971, 1977

MET_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.12 Marshall Engineering Thermosphere Known version: 2007

MSIS_86.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.13 MSIS empirical model Known version: 1986

MSISE_90.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.14 MSISE empirical model with exosphere extension Known version: 1990

NRLMSIS00E.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.15 NRLMSISE empirical model Known version: 2000 (NRLMSISE-00E)

TIECGM.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.16 Thermosphere-Ionosphere Electrodynamic General Circulation Model Based on TIME-GCM, no version specified

USSA_XX.description: OID: 1.3.112.4.57.9.17 U.S. Standard Atmosphere Known versions: 1962, 1976

YEAR.description: Four-digit year identifying the model version (e.g., 1970, 2008, 2020)

AVLProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one airspace volume.

Required on every record: a redistributed volume whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is DATA;
the standard names no dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the aeronautical dataset
this volume was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
volume was decoded from — the edition boundary (e.g. an AIRAC cycle
effective date), not the fetch.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source dataset's own identifier for this volume, verbatim. The
join key back to the source; never re-minted by the publisher.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description: RFC 3339 UTC date the source last modified this volume, as it states.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this volume record. Never the source's
own identifier, which rides verbatim in SOURCE.NATIVE_ID.

DESIGNATOR.description: Published designator of the volume, verbatim (e.g. an area designator).

NAME.description: Published display name of the volume, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no class, or a class this enum does not model.

CONTROLLED.description: A controlled airspace volume not otherwise classified below.

RESTRICTED.description: Restricted area: entry restricted per published conditions.

DANGER.description: Danger area: activities hazardous to flight may exist.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

FLOOR_VALUE.description:
Lower vertical limit, metres in FLOOR_DATUM (flight-level number when
FLOOR_DATUM is FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when SURFACE). NaN when unpublished.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No datum stated. A consumer MUST refuse a boundary whose value is present but whose datum is UNSPECIFIED rather than guess a reference.

FLIGHT_LEVEL.description: Flight level: the value is the flight level number (hundreds of feet on the standard atmosphere), not metres.

SURFACE.description: The ground or water surface itself; the boundary value is NaN.

UNLIMITED.description: No upper limit; the boundary value is NaN. A datum member, never a sentinel altitude.

CEILING_VALUE.description:
Upper vertical limit, metres in CEILING_DATUM (flight-level number
when FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when UNLIMITED). NaN when unpublished.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No datum stated. A consumer MUST refuse a boundary whose value is present but whose datum is UNSPECIFIED rather than guess a reference.

FLIGHT_LEVEL.description: Flight level: the value is the flight level number (hundreds of feet on the standard atmosphere), not metres.

SURFACE.description: The ground or water surface itself; the boundary value is NaN.

UNLIMITED.description: No upper limit; the boundary value is NaN. A datum member, never a sentinel altitude.

EFFECTIVE_FROM.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume becomes effective.

EFFECTIVE_TO.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume ceases. Absent for
a volume with no published end.

TIME_OF_ACTIVITY.description:
Activity schedule verbatim as the source publishes it (NOTAM-style
text). Never parsed into structure by the publisher: schedule grammar
is source-specific and coercion would invent activations.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description:
Polygon each ring belongs to. One entry per ring, so its length is
RING_OFFSETS length - 1.

RING_ROLES.description:
Role of each ring. One entry per ring, so its length is RING_OFFSETS
length - 1.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1, published so
an empty geometry is distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

ARC_DENSIFIED.description:
The source's arc or circle boundary segments were densified into the
vertices above by the ingest.

DENSIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Maximum deviation, metres, between a densified chord and the published
arc. Required knowledge when ARC_DENSIFIED; NaN otherwise.

BEMProvenance.description: Provenance of a deployed-beam descriptor or hop schedule.

BEMHopSlot.description: One time slice of a periodic beam-hopping plan.

BEAM_ID.description:
Beam activated in this slot. May name this BEM.ID or another beam in a
coordinated schedule.

BEMHopSchedule.description: Periodic beam-hopping schedule carried by a deployed beam descriptor.

EPOCH.description: Seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC at which slot offsets begin.

GAIN.description: Gain level in dBi at this contour

EIRP.description: EIRP at beam center in dBW

G_OVER_T.description: G/T at beam center in dB/K

HOP_SCHEDULE.description: Time-sliced activation plan for this deployed beam.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

BSPVector3Series.description: Three coordinate arrays sharing one time vector.

T.description: Sample or waypoint time tags in seconds.

WAYPOINTS.description: Waypoint times and coordinates. T, X1, X2, and X3 must have equal length.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of equally spaced output samples.

POLYNOMIAL_ORDER.description: Polynomial order of the B-spline basis.

HAS_X_DOT_0.description: Whether X_DOT_0 contains the first derivative at the first waypoint.

X_DOT_0.description: Optional first derivative at the first waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_DOT_N.description: Whether X_DOT_N contains the first derivative at the last waypoint.

X_DOT_N.description: Optional first derivative at the last waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_D_DOT_0.description: Whether X_D_DOT_0 contains the second derivative at the first waypoint.

X_D_DOT_0.description: Optional second derivative at the first waypoint, length 3.

HAS_X_D_DOT_N.description: Whether X_D_DOT_N contains the second derivative at the last waypoint.

X_D_DOT_N.description: Optional second derivative at the last waypoint, length 3.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

INVALID_INPUT.description: The request is missing required waypoint, time, order, or sample data.

UNSUPPORTED_ORDER.description: The requested polynomial order is outside the supported B-spline range.

SINGULAR_SYSTEM.description: The interpolation linear system is singular or numerically unstable.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error detail when STATUS is not OK.

XD1.description: First derivative of coordinate 1 at each output sample.

XD2.description: First derivative of coordinate 2 at each output sample.

XD3.description: First derivative of coordinate 3 at each output sample.

XDD1.description: Second derivative of coordinate 1 at each output sample.

XDD2.description: Second derivative of coordinate 2 at each output sample.

XDD3.description: Second derivative of coordinate 3 at each output sample.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

SIZE.description: Bus size category

WET_MASS.description: Maximum wet mass (with propellant) in kg

ETM.description:
Entity Metadata — generic queryable metadata for a host-local entity.
Participates in shared FlatSQL/WASM runtimes where multiple plugins
cross-query the same entity collection.

NAME.description: Human-readable entity name used for shared query/search surfaces.

SUBTYPE.description: More specific runtime subtype or class name.

PARENT_ENTITY_ID.description: Optional parent entity id for hierarchy / linkage queries.

WASM_HANDLE.description: Collection-scoped WASM handle used for batch visibility application.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: Optional NORAD catalog id for standards-backed entities.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Primary object name surfaced by attached standards metadata.

OBJECT_ID.description: Primary international / object designator surfaced by attached standards metadata.

CAT_OBJECT_NAME.description: Secondary CAT object name when different from the primary object name.

CAT_OBJECT_ID.description: Secondary CAT object id when different from the primary object id.

FACILITY_TYPE.description: Ground / facility subtype metadata for non-space entity search.

SEARCH_TEXT.description: Pre-normalized phrase-search text for collection-wide shared queries.

LAUNCH_YEAR.description: Launch year derived from launch date.

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in revolutions per day.

HAS_GP.description: Whether GP / OMM state is present for the entity.

ENTITY_INDICES.description: Return only the matched entity indices.

VISIBILITY_MASK.description: Return a packed visibility mask (one byte per entity).

CATALOG_ROW.description: Return a single catalog row by entity index.

QUERY.description: Host-specific query string (for example a FlatSQL or DSL expression).

MAX_COUNT.description: Upper bound on the number of rows / indices to return (0 = unbounded).

ENTITY_COUNT.description:
Expected number of entities in the catalog at the time the request was
issued, used to size visibility masks.

ENTITY_INDICES.description: Return only the matched entity indices.

VISIBILITY_MASK.description: Return a packed visibility mask (one byte per entity).

CATALOG_ROW.description: Return a single catalog row by entity index.

MASK.description: Populated when KIND == VISIBILITY_MASK (one byte per entity).

VISIBLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible (masked-in) entities in MASK.

ROW.description: Single matched row when KIND == CATALOG_ROW.

CAQ.description: Catalog query envelope — carries either a request or a result payload.

FrequencyRange.description: Frequency range with lower and upper limits

StokesParameters.description: Stokes parameters, representing different aspects of polarization

PNM.description:
Publish Notification Message.

PNM is the compact network announcement for a published record, manifest, or
dataset update. For dataset updates, FILE_ID is the complete canonical
identity for the published update and CID usually points to a small DPM
manifest or digest. The DPM carries the full verification contract:
provider identity, retrieval protocol, canonical query, result hash, Merkle
roots, completeness-capable indexes, file_id partition key, and signature.
Large or paid dataset updates do not need to be published as globally
discoverable IPFS files; a PNM may instead advertise a provider-mediated SDN
query protocol. In that mode the PNM is only the announcement. The DPM is
the signed commitment, and each provider response carries records plus
Merkle proof material that the subscriber verifies against the DPM roots and
the announced FILE_ID before import.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat Address
As specified by the multiaddr specification.
A universal address format for representing multiple network protocols. Examples include:
- /ip4/192.168.1.1/tcp/80 for an IPv4 address with TCP protocol
- /ip6zone/x/ip6/::1 for an IPv6 address with a zone
- /dns4/example.com for a domain name resolvable only to IPv4 addresses
- /ipfs/bafybeiccfclkdtucu6y4yc5cpr6y3yuinr67svmii46v5cfcrkp47ihehy/README.txt -IPFS address w/CID and path to `README.txt`.

PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP.description: Publish Time OF THE Publish Notification Message

CID.description:
Concatenated Content Identifier (CID)
This field is a unique ID for distributed systems (CID).
The CID provides a unique identifier within distributed systems, as
detailed in the multiformats CID specification.
For dataset-update PNMs this SHOULD identify a compact DPM manifest,
manifest digest, or other small verification object, not necessarily the
full dataset bytes.

FILE_NAME.description:
File ID
This field is the Name

FILE_ID.description:
File ID
Canonical publication/update partition identity. For dataset-update PNMs,
this MUST match DPM.FILE_ID and is the stable key used everywhere an SDN
component refers to the update: PNMs, DPMs, assets, entitlements, provider
query requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness
verification. Provider-mediated query requests and responses MUST bind
their Merkle leaves and proof paths to this FILE_ID, and subscribers MUST
reject responses whose DPM, records, or proofs bind to a different FILE_ID.
Example: provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

SIGNATURE.description:
Digital Signature of the CID
This is the digital signature of the CID, signed using the specified cryptographic method.

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE.description:
Timestamp Signature
Digital signature of the publish timestamp, using the specified cryptographic method for timestamp verification.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Type of Cryptographic Signature Used

TIMESTAMP_SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:

CryptoKey.description:
Represents cryptographic key information.

The publication paradigm is "literal public keys, not derivation
material": a published EPM carries the PUBLIC_KEY bytes that verify
the record's SIGNATURE (signing) or encrypt to the entity (encryption),
and NOTHING about how those keys were derived. XPUB, KEY_PATH and
KEY_ADDRESS are PRIVATE / operational — they belong to the wallet that
produced the keys, never to the record a peer resolves.

Requiredness is PROFILE-ENFORCED, never a flatc `(required)` attribute:
a `(required)` on PUBLIC_KEY would make the flatbuffers Verifier reject
every pre-flip secp256k1 record that legitimately omitted it (the
2026-07-27 dual-curve regime allowed xpub-derivation for secp at
non-hardened paths). A published record is self-describing instead —
PUBLIC_KEY present, XPUB/KEY_PATH/KEY_ADDRESS absent — and a conformance
checker asserts that profile (see scripts/check-epm-published-profile.mjs).

Rotation is by republish: a new signing or encryption key means a new
PUBLIC_KEY, a re-signed SIGNATURE, and a re-published EPM at the same
peer-addressed location. The PeerID (multihash of the libp2p identity
pubkey) is the stable anchor across rotations.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Public part of the cryptographic key, in hexadecimal format. AUTHORITATIVE
in a published record: this is the verifying/encrypting key, and no other
field yields it. Required-in-practice (profile-enforced, not flatc
`(required)`) so that pre-flip secp256k1 records without it still decode.

XPUB.description:
Extended public key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic
wallets), "Extended keys". PRIVATE / operational: present only in the
wallet that derived the keys, ABSENT from published records. A verifier
never derives a child key from XPUB — the PUBLIC_KEY is the verification
material.

PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private part of the cryptographic key in hexidecimal format, should be kept secret

XPRIV.description: Extended private key, as specified by BIP-32 (hierarchical deterministic wallets), "Extended keys".

KEY_ADDRESS.description:
Address generated from the cryptographic key. PRIVATE / operational in a
published EPM: a chain address is bound through a ChainProof attestation,
not carried as a standalone KEY_ADDRESS on the CryptoKey. ABSENT from
published records.

ADDRESS_TYPE.description:
Type of the address generated from the cryptographic key. An address
format tag only — NOT a curve or algorithm designator; the algorithm
lives in ALGORITHM

KEY_TYPE.description: Type of the cryptographic key (signing or encryption)

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of this key from the entity root
(e.g., "m/44'/0'/0'/0/0" secp256k1 non-hardened, "m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'"
ed25519 hardened). PRIVATE / operational: how the key was derived belongs
to the wallet, not to a published record. ABSENT from published records.

ALGORITHM.description:
Key algorithm/curve (e.g., "ed25519", "secp256k1"). ABSENT means
ed25519: every record published before this field existed verifies
unchanged under that default. The verifier dispatches on ALGORITHM (not
on ADDRESS_TYPE, which is an address-format tag only).

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format produced by this key (e.g., "raw-ed25519",
"compact"). ABSENT means the canonical encoding of ALGORITHM
(raw-ed25519 for ed25519, compact for secp256k1)

REGION.description: Region of the address (e.g., state or province)

LOCALITY.description: Locality of the address (e.g., city or town)

ChainProof.description: Proves a blockchain key derives from the same HD wallet as the signing key

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description: Signature encoding format (e.g., "compact", "raw-ed25519")

DomainProof.description:
Proves control of a DNS domain by the same HD wallet as the signing key —
the EPM-record mirror of the DNS TXT wire form (which is deliberately
NON-SDS: a base64 FlatBuffer would not fit a 255-byte TXT record). The
canonical statement is 6 fixed LF-terminated lines prefixed
"sdn-domain-proof/1", and it verifies by BYTE-REPLAY of the verbatim
SIGNED_PAYLOAD (ChainProof precedent) — never by JCS.

DOMAIN.description: Fully-qualified domain name the proof binds (e.g., "node.example.org")

KEY_PATH.description:
BIP-32 / SLIP-10 derivation path of the proving key. The signer is the
Ed25519 EPM/publication key at m/44'/0'/0'/0'/0'

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the attestation payload (hex-encoded)

SIGNED_PAYLOAD.description: The canonical payload that was signed, verbatim (hex-encoded)

ENCODING.description:
Signature encoding format. ABSENT means the canonical encoding of
ALGORITHM (raw-ed25519 for ed25519)

KEYS.description: Cryptographic keys associated with the entity

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description: Multiformat addresses associated with the entity

SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the EPM was signed

CHAIN_PROOFS.description: Chain binding proofs linking blockchain keys to the same HD wallet

ENTITY_TYPE.description: Type of entity represented by this profile

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm that produced SIGNATURE (e.g., "ed25519",
"secp256k1"). ABSENT means ed25519 — this single default is what keeps
every EPM signed before this field existed verifying unchanged, so the
field MUST NOT be made required. The signing key is the first CryptoKey
in KEYS with KEY_TYPE Signing whose ALGORITHM matches this declaration
(an absent CryptoKey.ALGORITHM likewise means ed25519)

DOMAIN_PROOFS.description:
DNS domain binding proofs linking domains to the same HD wallet —
symmetric with CHAIN_PROOFS

CES.description:
Catalog Embedding Shard.

One CES publishes the dense semantic-search vector table for one dataset
update: one row per catalog object, alongside that update's $OMM shard and
$DPM manifest (DPMAsset.ASSET_KIND = EMBEDDING_SHARD). Vectors are
L2-normalised at the encoder's output; similarity between two rows, or
between a row and a query vector produced by a paired $QEM, is dot
product (equivalent to cosine similarity for unit-norm vectors).

A consumer MUST compare MODEL_ID, MODEL_VERSION, MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256,
POOLING_METHOD and TEMPLATE_VERSION against a QEM record before trusting
cross-encoding similarity between a query vector and CES rows; a mismatch
on any one field means the two vector spaces are not comparable.

DATASET_ID.description: Joins to DPM.DATASET_ID for the publication this shard belongs to.

UPDATE_ID.description:
Joins to DPM.UPDATE_ID for the specific update this shard was computed
against.

DIMENSIONS.description: Fixed embedding dimensionality shared by every row (e.g. 384).

ENCODING.description: Row element encoding used across ROWS.

SIMILARITY.description: Similarity function rows are intended to be compared with.

MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the encoder weights, lowercase hex. Same convention as
DPMAsset.BYTE_SHA256.

POOLING_METHOD.description: Sentence/document pooling method the encoder used.

TEMPLATE_VERSION.description:
Version of the text template documents were rendered from before
encoding. Must match a QEM's TEMPLATE_VERSION for compatible retrieval.

CMRProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for one fact used by a $CMR.

Each source gets its own entry. A publisher never merges a catalogue's
group membership, a reference catalogue's ownership assertion, and
$CAT/$BUS joins into one ambiguous citation.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not distinguish the assertion's role.

MEMBERSHIP.description: The object belongs to the named constellation or curated group.

OPERATOR.description: The source identifies the constellation's operator or owner.

OBJECT_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the NORAD catalogue identity or object join.

BUS_IDENTITY.description: The source establishes the object's satellite-bus join.

SOURCE.description:
Publisher name verbatim as that publisher states it — a public satellite
catalogue, a general object reference catalogue, or the network provider
that published the joined $CAT record.

SOURCE_DATASET.description:
Source dataset or product name verbatim, such as a named constellation
group file or a catalogue's satellite-catalog product.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source-native row, group, object, or catalogue identifier.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: Source revision, edition, or upstream update marker verbatim.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters. Empty only when the source cannot expose replayable bytes.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Empty means unknown terms, never public
domain and never an implied grant.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text required by the source.

NOTES.description: Source caveats or reconciliation notes; never a substitute for a field.

CMR.description:
Constellation Membership Record.

One record asserts that one NORAD-catalogued object belongs (or formerly
belonged) to one named constellation. Record sets are therefore directly
keyable and queryable by NORAD_CAT_ID in FlatSQL. The record joins to $CAT
by NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID and may join through $CAT.BUS_ID to $BUS; it
does not duplicate catalogue or bus properties.

CONSTELLATION_ID and OPERATOR_ID are publisher-stable identifiers. Display
names and aliases are carried separately so consumers never use branding as
identity. Every emitted record names the independent source assertions used
to establish membership, operator, and catalogue joins.

MEMBERSHIP_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this assertion, unique within its record
set. Recommended form: "<constellation-id>:<norad-cat-id>".

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD catalogue number. Zero is invalid for a published record.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator copied verbatim from the joined $CAT when known.

CONSTELLATION_ID.description: Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the constellation/group.

CONSTELLATION_NAME.description:
Human-readable constellation name as published by the authoritative
membership source.

CONSTELLATION_ALIASES.description:
Alternate constellation names, brands, and search terms. Values are
verbatim; consumers must not treat aliases as stable identifiers.

OPERATOR_ID.description:
Publisher-stable operator/owner identifier. Empty when no source supports
one; never synthesized from a display name.

OPERATOR_NAME.description: Operator/owner display name verbatim from the cited source.

OPERATOR_ALIASES.description: Alternate operator names and brands, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not state whether the membership is current.

ACTIVE.description: The object is a current member of the constellation.

FORMER.description: The object was formerly a member and is retained for history.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which this reconciled assertion
was emitted.

PROVENANCE.description:
Independent evidence used to construct this assertion. At least one
MEMBERSHIP entry is required by the publishing contract.

BAND.description: Operating band (e.g., C, Ku, Ka, L, S, X)

UPLINK_FREQ_MIN.description: Uplink frequency range minimum in MHz

UPLINK_FREQ_MAX.description: Uplink frequency range maximum in MHz

DOWNLINK_FREQ_MIN.description: Downlink frequency range minimum in MHz

DOWNLINK_FREQ_MAX.description: Downlink frequency range maximum in MHz

MISSION.description: Primary mission (e.g., FIXED_SAT, BROADCAST, MOBILE, RELAY, MILSATCOM)

Recipient of an on-chain revenue split. The identity binds to an `$EPM`
via CHAIN_PROOFS so a payout address is provably the recipient's.

XPUB.description: Account xpub the address derives from

Chain Settlement / Smart-Contract Descriptor. The forward description of the
exact established splitter contract/program a buyer's wallet targets so
payment and platform commission settle atomically on-chain. Referenced by
`$CMT.CONTRACTS` and echoed into a store `checkout` quote. Commission is
realized by the splitter contract itself when the buyer pays it; there is no
off-chain or manual settlement step.

SPLITTER_STANDARD.description:
Established split standard id, e.g. "0xsplits.v2" (ETH) or the SOL

Deployed splitter contract address (ETH) or splitter program id (SOL) the
buyer's payment routes into

The specific split configuration (recipient set + basis points) registered

The recipient set the split configuration encodes (platform + publisher…),

Share in basis points (1/100 of a percent); all splits plus the platform

Commission Terms / Revenue Split. Binds a listing, store, or publisher to a
platform commission and the on-chain split that enforces it. This record
makes "the platform earns on every transaction" auditable and portable
across store deployments. Commission is realized purely by the buyer's
payment routing through the on-chain splitter contract described in
CONTRACTS — never by a manual or off-chain settlement step.

SPLITS.description: Recipient splits; each in basis points, summing with the commission to 10000

PLATFORM_RECIPIENT.description: The platform's per-chain payout identity (the commission recipient)

CONTRACTS.description:
The established splitter contract(s)/program(s) that perform the split,
one per accepted chain/asset

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix ms when these terms expire, or 0 for no expiry

CNPRegion.description:
Geography an aggregate is keyed to.

A separate table so an absent REGION means "the source did not key by
geography", which is different from GLOBAL ("the source aggregated across
all geographies") and different again from an empty CODE.

GLOBAL.description: No geographic restriction — the aggregate covers everywhere the operator serves.

COUNTRY.description: A country. CODE is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

SUBDIVISION.description: A first-level subdivision. CODE is ISO 3166-2.

METRO.description: A metropolitan area or city. CODE is the source's own key.

CELL.description: A ground-segment cell or beam footprint. CODE is the operator's own key.

POINT_OF_PRESENCE.description: A point of presence / ground gateway. CODE is the source's own key.

OTHER.description: The source keys by something none of the above describes. CODE and NAME carry the source's key verbatim.

CODE.description:
The region key, verbatim from the source in the coding scheme KIND
names. Never re-coded between schemes on ingest.

NAME.description:
Human-readable region name as the source publishes it. Joins to
$CTR for country identity when KIND is COUNTRY.

CNPProvenance.description: Where one metric came from and under what terms it may be republished.

SOURCE.description:
Name of the organization or programme publishing the underlying
measurements, carried verbatim as that publisher states it.

SOURCE_URL.description: URL of the dataset, endpoint or landing page.

SOURCE_DATASET.description:
Dataset, table or API path queried, verbatim, e.g. a fully qualified
warehouse table name or a REST route.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query or request that produced these numbers, so the
aggregate can be replayed rather than trusted.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source's own identifier for the returned batch, when it issues one.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the raw source bytes this aggregate was computed from,
lowercase hex.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the source was queried.

METHOD.description: How the underlying observations were produced.

SPEED_TEST.description: A speed test other than NDT7 — a third-party measurement platform, a CDN-operated test, or an operator-native test.

TERMINAL_TELEMETRY.description: Telemetry read from the user terminal itself.

MODELED.description: Modelled or simulated rather than measured. A modelled value is not a measurement and this member is how a consumer refuses to treat it as one.

OTHER.description: The source states a method none of the above names.

MEASUREMENT_SERVER.description:
Measurement server, vantage point or probe set, when the source names
one. A throughput number without a vantage is not comparable to one
with a different vantage.

LICENSE.description:
SPDX identifier when the source states one, otherwise the licence name
verbatim. EMPTY MEANS UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, and never a
grant to republish.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence text.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution string the licence requires this record and every derived
product to carry downstream.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
True when the licence forbids commercial use (e.g. CC BY-NC 4.0). A
consumer building a paid surface MUST honour this flag; it is carried
per-source because one $CNP may mix a CC0 lane with a CC BY-NC
cross-check.

CNPStatistic.description: One number drawn from a metric's distribution.

COUNT.description: Number of observations, not a value of the metric.

PERCENTILE_RANK.description:
Percentile rank in 0..100 when STATISTIC is PERCENTILE. Meaningless
otherwise and MUST NOT be set.

VALUE.description: The number, expressed in the parent metric's UNITS.

CNPMetric.description:
One aggregated quantity for the parent record's key.

A metric is a DISTRIBUTION, not a scalar. There is deliberately no
`VALUE: double` on this table: a source that publishes only a median
encodes exactly one CNPStatistic with STATISTIC MEDIAN, and a consumer can
then never mistake it for a mean.

LATENCY_IDLE.description: Round-trip time on an otherwise unloaded path.

LATENCY_LOADED_DOWNLOAD.description: Round-trip time measured while the download test saturates the path.

LATENCY_LOADED_UPLOAD.description: Round-trip time measured while the upload test saturates the path.

AVAILABILITY.description: Fraction of the window in which the service was usable.

OBSTRUCTION.description: Fraction of the terminal's sky view blocked by terrain or structures.

RTT.description: Round-trip time where the source does not distinguish loaded from idle.

OTHER.description: The source publishes a quantity none of the above names. SOURCE_METRIC_NAME is then required to be non-empty.

SOURCE_METRIC_NAME.description:
The source's own name for this metric, verbatim. REQUIRED to be
non-empty when KIND is OTHER; recommended always, because it is what
makes the mapping auditable.

UNITS.description:
Units of every VALUE under STATISTICS. NORMATIVE and required: "Mbps",
"kbps", "ms", "percent", "fraction", "count". Units are never silently
converted on ingest; a source publishing kbps encodes kbps.

STATISTICS.description: The distribution. At least one entry; a metric with none is malformed.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description:
Number of individual measurements aggregated. 0 means the source did
not publish a sample count — it never means zero measurements.

CLIENT_COUNT.description:
Number of distinct clients, terminals or probes contributing. 0 means
unpublished.

PROVENANCE.description: Where this metric came from and under what terms.

CNP.description:
Constellation Network Performance.

Aggregated throughput, latency and availability for one satellite
constellation's user network, keyed by CONSTELLATION, ASN, REGION and a
closed time window. Built for a broadband LEO consumer-terminal lane
(one operator ASN measured via NDT7) and shaped so any operator — another
LEO constellation, a GEO VSAT provider — or a terrestrial ASN used as a
baseline fits the same record.

KEY, NOT MEASUREMENT. One $CNP is an AGGREGATE over a window. It is not a
speed test, not a single client's result, and not a per-satellite link
state: $LKS carries the instantaneous state and data rate of ONE named
link between two endpoints, and no $LKS can express "the p50 download rate
observed by 41,000 terminals in Germany during July".

NEVER-INVENT-DATA IS ENFORCED BY THE SHAPE. A quantity exists only as a
CNPMetric, and CNPMetric carries `UNITS: string (required)` and
`PROVENANCE: CNPProvenance (required)`, so there is no encoding for a
number that does not state its unit and name its source, query,
retrieval time, method and licence. A metric the source did not publish is
ABSENT — never zero. `SOURCES` lists every provider consulted for this key,
including ones that returned nothing, so a consumer can distinguish "not
looked for" from "looked for and empty".

LICENCE RIDES PER SOURCE. `CNPProvenance.NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY` exists
because a single record may legitimately carry a CC0 open-measurement lane
beside a CC BY-NC cross-check from a restricted publisher; the restriction
attaches to the metric that inherited it, never to the record as a whole.

CONSTELLATION.description:
Constellation or network name, carried verbatim as its operator states
it. Empty when the record is a terrestrial baseline. Joins to
$LKS.CONSTELLATION and to $CAT by the same name.

OPERATOR.description: Operating company, when it differs usefully from CONSTELLATION.

AS_NAME.description: Autonomous system name as the routing registry publishes it.

SERVICE_TIER.description:
Service tier the source distinguishes, verbatim ("Residential",
"Roam", "Business", "Maritime"). Empty when the source does not
separate tiers — never guessed from the throughput.

REGION.description:
Geography this aggregate is keyed to. Absent when the source published
no geographic key at all.

WINDOW_START.description: ISO 8601 UTC inclusive start of the aggregation window.

WINDOW_STOP.description: ISO 8601 UTC exclusive end of the aggregation window.

CUSTOM.description: WINDOW_START/WINDOW_STOP are authoritative and match none of the named periods.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this key, including those that returned no
metric.

CREATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time of this record.

UPDATED_AT.description: ISO 8601 UTC last-update time of this record.

SUPERSEDES_CNP_CID.description: CID of the $CNP this record replaces when a source restates a window.

COTPoint.description: CoT Point - geographical point with error estimates

HAE.description: Height above WGS84 ellipsoid in meters

FILL_COLOR.description: Fill color in ARGB integer format

RAW_XML.description: Raw XML detail content (for extensions not covered above)

TYPE.description:
CoT event type (dot-delimited MIL-STD-2525/APP-6 hierarchy)
e.g. "a-f-G-U-C" = atom, friend, Ground, Unit, Combat

HOW.description: How the event was generated (e.g. "m-g" = machine GPS)

START.description: Time the event information was valid (ISO 8601)

STALE.description: Time the event information is no longer valid (ISO 8601)

CPS.description:
Compressed Packet Stream — a run of fixed-length CCSDS packets losslessly
compressed as one stateful stream (CCSDS 124.0-B-1 POCKET+). Decoded output
is a sequence of PACKET_COUNT packets of PACKET_LENGTH bytes, each of which
projects to an $SPP record. This record carries a compressed packet stream
only; it is not a general-purpose compression envelope for SDS records.

ALGORITHM.description: Compression algorithm used to produce COMPRESSED_DATA.

POCKET_PLUS.description: CCSDS 124.0-B-1 POCKET+ — lossless compression of fixed-length spacecraft housekeeping telemetry.

PACKET_LENGTH.description:
Uncompressed length in bytes of EVERY packet in the stream. POCKET+ is
defined only for a fixed packet length; a length change starts a new
stream and therefore a new $CPS record.

PACKET_COUNT.description:
Number of uncompressed packets encoded in COMPRESSED_DATA. NORMATIVE:
this is the only output-size bound a decoder has. The compressed
bitstream alone does not bound the decoded size, and a compression-ratio
guess is unsafe in both directions. Decoders MUST reject a record whose
PACKET_COUNT is zero, and MUST allocate exactly
PACKET_COUNT * PACKET_LENGTH bytes of output.

ROBUSTNESS.description:
POCKET+ robustness level: the window depth in PACKETS, range 0-7. This is
a window depth, NOT a retransmission interval — it does not by itself
configure a decoder. See MASK_UPDATE_PERIOD / MASK_SEND_PERIOD /
REFERENCE_PERIOD, which are three independent periods.

MASK_UPDATE_PERIOD.description:
POCKET+ mask update period (pt), in packets. Independent of ROBUSTNESS,
MASK_SEND_PERIOD, and REFERENCE_PERIOD.

MASK_SEND_PERIOD.description:
POCKET+ mask send period (ft), in packets — how often the change mask is
transmitted. Independent of ROBUSTNESS, MASK_UPDATE_PERIOD, and
REFERENCE_PERIOD.

REFERENCE_PERIOD.description:
POCKET+ reference packet retransmission period (rt), in packets.
Independent of ROBUSTNESS, MASK_UPDATE_PERIOD, and MASK_SEND_PERIOD.

SELF_SYNCHRONIZING.description:
True only when the FIRST packet of COMPRESSED_DATA carries both rt=1 and
ft=1, i.e. it transmits a full reference packet and a full mask, so this
record decodes standalone without its predecessor. There is no
synchronization flag in the POCKET+ bitstream itself: this field is the
producer's assertion about the first packet, and defaults to false.

STREAM_ID.description:
Producer-defined stream identity. Records sharing STREAM_ID decode in
SEGMENT_INDEX order as one continuous POCKET+ stream. A missing segment
poisons every subsequent segment up to the next segment with
SELF_SYNCHRONIZING = true.

SEGMENT_INDEX.description: Zero-based index of this segment within STREAM_ID.

APID.description: CCSDS Application Process Identifier of the packets, when known.

SPACECRAFT_ID.description: Spacecraft identifier of the packets, when known.

START_EPOCH.description: UTC epoch of the first packet in the segment, ISO 8601.

STOP_EPOCH.description: UTC epoch of the last packet in the segment, ISO 8601.

COMPRESSED_DATA.description:
The POCKET+ compressed bitstream per CCSDS 124.0-B-1. Each compressed
packet is individually octet-aligned; padding is per PACKET, never per
stream. Bit-concatenating packets diverges from the reference
implementation and MUST NOT be done.

UNCOMPRESSED_LENGTH.description:
PACKET_LENGTH * PACKET_COUNT. Carried so a decoder can check its decoded
output length without recomputing the product from a corrupt header.

UNCOMPRESSED_CRC32.description: CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3) over the concatenated decompressed packets.

Epoch window start (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

Epoch window stop (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

SENSOR_IDS.description: Sensor identifiers contributing to the coverage set

ASSET_IDS.description: Asset (satellite) identifiers contributing to the coverage set

ACCESS_TOTAL_S.description: Per-cell total access duration in seconds
