COVERAGE_FRACTION.description: Per-cell fraction of the window with at least one access [0-1]

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this coverage set was computed

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`

CVPEmitterRef.description:
An emitter that contributed to this geometry. Identity and the few
parameters that determine the boundary; everything else is joined from
`$RFB` and `$RFE`.

EMITTER_ID.description: Producer-stable emitter identifier within this record.

INTERFERER.description: An interferer degrading the wanted signal.

RELAY.description: An intermediate relay in a multi-hop chain.

RFB_ID.description: `$RFB.ID` — the band specification.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID` when the emitter is on orbit. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the emitter is a terrestrial site.

ID_BEAM.description: Beam and channel within the emitter.

CENTER_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Carrier centre frequency, megahertz — the `$RFB` convention.

EIRP_DBW.description: EIRP toward boresight used in the evaluation, dBW.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization, defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly because `rfPolarization`
ordinal 0 is LHCP.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Emitter position at EPOCH, when the geometry is instantaneous. Geodetic
degrees and metres. Absent means "join it from the source record" — a
stale copied position is worse than none.

CONTRIBUTION_WEIGHT.description: Weight of this emitter's contribution to a union or aggregate [0-1].

CVPReceiverRef.description:
A receiver the coverage was evaluated FOR. Coverage is never absolute: a
-110 dBW contour means one thing for a 60 cm terminal and another for a
12 m dish, so the assumed receiver is part of the record.

SPACECRAFT.description: On-orbit object; joins `$CAT` by NORAD_CAT_ID / OBJECT_ID.

GEODETIC_TRACKING_STATION.description: Geodetic tracking station; joins `$GST` by STATION_ID.

RELAY_PAYLOAD.description: A relay payload acting as an intermediate endpoint of a multi-hop chain.

MIN_ELEVATION_DEG.description: Minimum elevation the receiver can work at, degrees.

RECEIVER_GROUP_ID.description:
Receiver group this receiver belongs to, matching
`$RFL.RFLLink.RECEIVER_GROUP_ID`.

CVPObstacleRef.description:
A 3D obstacle that shaped this coverage boundary. A footprint clipped by
buildings, a spacecraft structure or terrain is a claim about those
objects; publishing the obstacle set with its `$RFS` materials is what
makes the clipped boundary reproducible.

OBSTACLE_ID.description: Producer's identifier for the obstacle instance.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
`$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` of the surface. Absent means the obstacle was treated
as an opaque blocker with no material physics — which a consumer is
entitled to know.

VAM_ID.description: `$VAM` asset identity of the obstacle mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: `$CAT` identity when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID` when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

INTERACTION.description: How the obstacle acted on the field.

LINE_OF_SIGHT_BLOCKAGE.description: The obstacle blocked line of sight; no energy was propagated through it.

TRANSMISSION.description: Energy passed through the obstacle and paid its penetration loss.

REFLECTION.description: Energy reached the receiver by reflecting off the obstacle.

DIFFRACTION.description: Energy reached the receiver by diffracting around an edge.

SCATTERING.description: Energy reached the receiver by rough-surface scattering.

FRESNEL_INTRUSION.description: The obstacle intruded into the Fresnel zone without blocking the direct ray.

LATITUDE_DEG.description: Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres.

CVPUncertainty.description:
How wrong this geometry can be. A contour with no uncertainty is a drawing,
not a measurement.

HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M.description:
1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty of the boundary, metres. Applies
to every vertex unless VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M is present.

LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the level the contour was drawn at, in
LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY_UNITS.

CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence the stated uncertainties correspond to [0-1], e.g. 0.68.

EXTRACTION_TOLERANCE.description: Tolerance the contour extractor converged to, in the metric's units.

SIMPLIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Simplification tolerance applied to the rings, metres. A simplified ring
is not the computed boundary and MUST say so.

METHOD.description:
How the uncertainty was established (e.g. "grid resolution bound",
"Monte Carlo over emitter state covariance").

MEASURED.description: Values recorded by instrumentation on a real link.

MODELED.description: Values produced by propagation and RF models.

HYBRID.description: Modelled geometry reconciled against measured RF terms, or vice versa.

SOURCE.description: Producing system, dataset or campaign. Required.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query or scenario reference.

PROPAGATOR_ID.description:
Propagator that produced the emitter geometry. A MODELED or HYBRID
product MUST name it.

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced the rings.

MODELS.description:
Per-term model bindings for the metric that was contoured, reusing the
`$RFL` binding so a footprint and the samples behind it cite the same
models.

CONTOUR_ALGORITHM.description:
Algorithm that turned the sampled field into rings (e.g. "marching
squares", "alpha shape", "H3 cell union").

ENVIRONMENT_DATASET.description: Environment and terrain datasets the evaluation used.

OBSTACLE_DATASET.description: Dataset the 3D obstacles and their materials were drawn from.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms computed and retrieved.

LICENSE.description: Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS.

COVERAGE_ID.description: Stable identifier of this geometry product.

SCENARIO_ID.description:
Analysis or scenario grouping identifier shared with the `$RFL` samples
and `$ACI` intervals of the same study.

THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.description: The boundary where the metric meets THRESHOLD_VALUE.

ISO_METRIC_CONTOUR.description: A set of iso-level contours; POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES carries each level.

FOOTPRINT.description: The instantaneous beam or antenna footprint on the surface.

HORIZON_MASK.description: The horizon or terrain mask boundary for one endpoint.

INTERFERENCE_ZONE.description: The region in which a stated interference criterion is exceeded.

UNION_COVERAGE.description: The union of many contributing footprints or contours.

INTERSECTION_COVERAGE.description: The intersection of many contributing footprints or contours.

GAP_REGION.description: The region NOT covered — a gap, stated as geometry rather than left to be inferred by subtracting a coverage polygon from the globe.

KEEP_OUT_ZONE.description: A region a transmitter is prohibited from illuminating.

OBSTRUCTION_LOSS.description: Loss caused by an obstacle with stated `$RFS` material properties.

SYMBOL_ENERGY_TO_NOISE_DENSITY.description: Energy per transmitted symbol divided by noise spectral density.

BLOCK_ERROR_RATE.description: Error probability for a decoded transport block or frame.

SPECTRAL_EFFICIENCY.description: Delivered information bits per second per hertz.

ACHIEVED_DATA_RATE.description: Data rate delivered by the selected modulation and coding entry.

ACM_MARGIN.description: Margin above the threshold of the selected adaptive entry.

METRIC_UNITS.description: Units of the metric and of POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: The threshold the boundary was drawn at, for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR.

EPOCH.description:
Instantaneous epoch, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 in TIME_SYSTEM.
Set for FOOTPRINT and other instantaneous products; NaN for aggregates.

INTERVAL_START.description:
Interval this geometry holds over, same encoding. Set for aggregated
products (union over a window, availability contour); NaN for
instantaneous ones. A product that states neither EPOCH nor an interval
is untethered in time and MUST be refused.

TIME_SYSTEM.description:
Time scale all epochs in this record are expressed in. Defaults to UTC
explicitly: `timingStandard` ordinal 0 is GMST.

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

GENERATION.description:
Monotonic generation of this coverage product within its COVERAGE_ID
lineage. A streaming producer increments it per emission; a consumer
holding a higher generation MUST NOT be overwritten by a lower one.

SUPERSEDES_COVERAGE_ID.description: COVERAGE_ID this record replaces, when the lineage was re-identified.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

VERTEX_ALTITUDE_M.description:
Vertex altitudes, metres above ALTITUDE_REFERENCE. Absent when the
geometry lies on the reference surface.

TERRAIN.description: Draped on terrain from the dataset named in CVPProvenance.TERRAIN_DATASET.

FIXED_ALTITUDE.description: A constant altitude plane; the value is in FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.

FIXED_ALTITUDE_M.description: The constant altitude, metres, when ALTITUDE_REFERENCE is FIXED_ALTITUDE.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals the vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description: Polygon each ring belongs to. Same length as RING_COUNT.

RING_ROLES.description: Role of each ring. Same length as RING_COUNT.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1 and is published
so an empty coverage field (zero polygons, zero rings) is representable
and distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

POLYGON_LEVEL_VALUES.description:
Metric value each polygon is drawn at, in METRIC_UNITS. Same length as
POLYGON_COUNT. Carried for ISO_METRIC_CONTOUR; for a THRESHOLD_CONTOUR
every entry equals THRESHOLD_VALUE.

POLYGON_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTIES.description: 1-sigma uncertainty of each polygon's level, same units and length.

POLYGON_AREA_KM2.description: Surface area enclosed by each polygon, square kilometres.

VERTEX_POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Per-vertex 1-sigma horizontal uncertainty, metres. Same length as the
vertex arrays. Absent means CVPUncertainty.HORIZONTAL_POSITION_M governs
the whole boundary.

GRID_SCHEME.description:
Grid the field was sampled on before contouring, e.g. "H3" or
"GEODETIC_LATLON". A contour is never finer than the grid behind it.

GRID_RESOLUTION.description: Grid resolution in the scheme's own convention (H3 resolution 0-15).

GRID_SPACING_DEG.description: Grid spacing in degrees, for a geodetic lat/lon grid.

CVG_COVERAGE_ID.description:
`$CVG.COVERAGE_ID` of the figure-of-merit grid this geometry was
contoured from, when one was published.

RFL_ID.description:
`$RFL.RFL_ID` of the sample set the field was evaluated from, when one
was published.

ACI_ID.description:
`$ACI.ACI_ID` of the interval set an availability or gap product was
aggregated from, when one was published.

CONTRIBUTING_EMITTERS.description:
Emitters that contributed. Required: coverage with no stated emitter is
an unattributable claim about the sky.

RECEIVER_SET_ID.description: Identifier of the receiver set this coverage is stated for.

RECEIVERS.description: The receivers themselves, when the set is enumerable.

CONTRIBUTING_OBSTACLES.description:
3D obstacles that clipped or shaped the boundary, each naming the `$RFS`
material that produced its effect.

OBSTACLE_SET_ID.description:
Identifier of the obstacle set used, when it is published as a set rather
than enumerated here.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT.description: The condition that bounds the boundary — why the contour is where it is.

OBSTACLE_BLOCKAGE.description: A 3D obstacle intersected the path. The material that did it is named in RFLObstruction.MATERIAL_ID (`$RFS`).

MATERIAL_PENETRATION.description: The path passed THROUGH an obstacle and paid its penetration loss.

OTHER.description: The producer states a binding condition this enum cannot express. The verbatim description MUST be preserved in LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.

LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_NOTE.description: Verbatim description, required when LIMITING_CONSTRAINT is OTHER.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`.

CZMDynInterval.description: A single interval in a time-varying property

EPOCH.description: Reference epoch (ISO 8601)

VALUE_TYPE.description: Value type determines stride through DATA

DATA.description: Interleaved [time, value(s), ...] — stride depends on VALUE_TYPE

SAMPLED.description: Sampled data (when property uses epoch + data array)

CZMCartographicDegrees.description: Cartographic position (longitude, latitude, height in radians/meters)

HEIGHT.description: Height in meters above WGS84 ellipsoid

CZMCartesian.description: Cartesian position (X, Y, Z in meters)

LINE_COUNT_X.description: Number of grid lines along X

LINE_COUNT_Y.description: Number of grid lines along Y

LINE_THICKNESS_X.description: Thickness of grid lines along X

LINE_THICKNESS_Y.description: Thickness of grid lines along Y

LINE_OFFSET_X.description: Offset of grid lines along X

LINE_OFFSET_Y.description: Offset of grid lines along Y

CZMMaterial.description: Surface material (used by polygon, ellipse, box, etc.)

POSITIONS_CARTOGRAPHIC_DEGREES.description: Positions as cartographic degrees [lon, lat, height, lon, lat, height, ...]

POSITIONS_CARTESIAN.description: Positions as Cartesian [X, Y, Z, X, Y, Z, ...]

POSITIONS_CARTOGRAPHIC_DEGREES.description: Positions as cartographic degrees [lon, lat, height, ...]

CLOSE_TOP.description: Whether to close the top of extruded polygon

CLOSE_BOTTOM.description: Whether to close the bottom of extruded polygon

POSITIONS_CARTOGRAPHIC_DEGREES.description: Positions as cartographic degrees [lon, lat, height, ...]

LEAD_TIME.description: Trail time in seconds (how far behind)

TRAIL_TIME.description: Lead time in seconds (how far ahead)

COORDINATES_WSEN_DEGREES.description: Coordinates [west, south, east, north] in degrees

CZMPacket.description: A CZML Packet describing an entity and its properties

POSITION_EPOCH.description: Time-tagged positions [time, lon, lat, height, time, lon, lat, height, ...]

ORIENTATION_ARRAY.description: Orientation sampled data [t, x, y, z, w, t, x, y, z, w, ...]

DYNAMIC_PROPERTIES.description: Generic bag for all time-dynamic (non-static) properties

EPOCH.description: Epoch of drift measurement (ISO 8601)

START_TIME.description: History start time (ISO 8601)

MEAN_LONGITUDE.description: Current mean longitude in degrees East

SLOT_CENTER.description: Longitude slot center in degrees East (if station-keeping)

DPMCompletenessIndex.description: Completeness-capable signed index over a dataset update.

INDEX_NAME.description:
Stable index name, e.g. file_id, norad_cat_id, epoch, source_batch. Every
completeness-verifiable dataset update SHOULD include a file_id index so
subscribers can prove that all returned records belong to the announced
FILE_ID partition. The file_id index is the preferred completeness anchor
for provider-mediated data that is not published as a discoverable file.

CANONICAL_ORDER.description:
Deterministic ordering expression for the index. Providers and
subscribers MUST use this ordering when building or verifying range
proofs. A query is completeness-verifiable only when its predicate can be
expressed against one or more declared indexes.

INDEX_ROOT.description:
SHA-256 or Merkle root of the ordered index, lowercase hex. This root is
signed by the DPM provider signature and is the verifier's commitment for
inclusion and range-completeness proofs. To verify a provider-mediated
response, the subscriber recomputes each returned leaf, walks the supplied
sibling hashes using MERKLE_PROFILE, confirms the root equals INDEX_ROOT,
confirms the leaf material includes the DPM.FILE_ID partition when this is
the file_id index, and confirms any range-boundary proofs required by
CANONICAL_ORDER.

MERKLE_PROFILE.description:
Hash profile for leaves and internal nodes, e.g.
SDN-MERKLE-SHA256-v1. Profiles define domain separators, leaf material,
pair ordering, duplicate handling, and odd-leaf promotion.

SUPPORTS_RANGE_COMPLETENESS.description:
Whether this index can prove that no matching records were omitted for a
supported range query. Inclusion proofs alone prove authenticity, not
completeness.

DPMAsset.description:
One immutable asset or provider-mediated query contract published for a
dataset update.

EMBEDDING_SHARD.description: A $CES catalog embedding shard (dense per-object vector table).

QUERY_ENCODER_MODEL.description: A $QEM query encoder model (pruned static token-embedding table).

TRANSPORT_KIND.description:
Transport profile for this asset. CONTENT_ADDRESS assets use CID and
MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS. SDN_QUERY assets use TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL plus the
signed DPM query and root fields; they are not required to be published as
discoverable IPFS files.

CONTENT_ADDRESS.description: Asset bytes are resolved by content address, usually an IPFS CID.

SDN_QUERY.description: Asset bytes are resolved from the provider through a signed SDN query protocol. This mode is used when the update is not published as a globally discoverable file.

OTHER.description: Asset bytes are resolved by another protocol named in TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL.

CID.description:
Optional IPFS CIDv1/multihash content identifier. This field is required
for CONTENT_ADDRESS assets and SHOULD be empty for SDN_QUERY assets whose
bytes are retrieved through a provider protocol.

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS.description:
Multiformat address. For CONTENT_ADDRESS this is usually /ipfs/{CID}. For
SDN_QUERY this MAY be a provider peer multiaddr, relay hint, or empty when
provider routing is resolved from the DPM provider identity.

FILE_NAME.description: File name or logical artifact name.

FILE_ID.description:
Canonical publication/update partition identity for this asset. FILE_ID is
not a display filename; it is the stable identifier used everywhere this
update is referenced: PNMs, DPMs, assets, manifests, entitlements, query
requests, subscriber caches, replay, audit, and completeness proofs.
Example:
provider-slug:gp:OMM.fbs:2026-05-06T03:00:00Z.

TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL.description:
Provider protocol name/version used to fetch this asset when
TRANSPORT_KIND is SDN_QUERY, e.g. /sdn/dataset-query/1.0.0. The protocol
response MUST be verifiable against DATA_ROOT, INDEXES, QUERY, and the
provider signature in this DPM.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length of the published object.

BYTE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the exact published bytes, lowercase hex.

DATA_ROOT.description:
Merkle root over canonical records in this asset, lowercase hex. For
provider-mediated query delivery, subscribers verify returned records and
proof paths against this root before importing data. The proof material is
carried by the provider query response, not by the DPM itself; this field
is the signed root that makes those proofs meaningful.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: SDS schema name for data artifacts, e.g. OMM.fbs, CAT.fbs, SPW.fbs.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Hash of the SDS schema used to encode this object.

CONTENT_KEY_ID.description: Optional content-key identifier for encrypted artifacts.

DPMSourceBatch.description: Source batch metadata bound into the dataset publication.

SOURCE_URL.description: Original source URL.

SOURCE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of raw source bytes, lowercase hex.

HTTP_LAST_MODIFIED.description: HTTP Last-Modified value observed during retrieval.

RECORD_COUNT.description: Number of normalized records emitted from this source.

WARNINGS.description: Warnings or policy notes produced during normalization.

LICENSE.description:
SPDX license identifier governing the source data, e.g. CC-BY-4.0 or
CC-BY-SA-4.0. Machine-readable license provenance is REQUIRED before any
record derived from this batch may be republished; share-alike terms
propagate from this batch to every derived record.

LICENSE_URL.description: Canonical URL of the license text.

CITATION.description:
Attribution/citation string the source license requires downstream
republication to carry.

DPMQueryBinding.description: Canonical query metadata that can replay the dataset selection.

CANONICAL_QUERY.description: Canonical query text or canonical JSON representation.

QUERY_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of CANONICAL_QUERY, lowercase hex.

RESULT_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the ordered result bytes, lowercase hex.

QUERY_ENGINE.description: Query engine or profile name, e.g. FlatSQL.

QUERY_ENGINE_VERSION.description: Query engine version or profile version.

CANONICAL_ORDER.description:
Canonical ordering of result records before RESULT_SHA256 or DATA_ROOT is
computed. Providers MUST stream records in this order unless each chunk
includes enough proof material to restore and verify the canonical order.

QUERY_PROTOCOL.description:
Query protocol name/version for provider-mediated retrieval, e.g.
/sdn/dataset-query/1.0.0. A subscriber verifies the PNM and DPM, opens this
protocol to the provider, submits the signed query or a permitted subset,
and imports only responses that verify against the signed roots. Responses
MUST include enough Merkle proof material for each returned record and, for
completeness-verifiable range queries, the declared range-boundary proofs.

SCHEMA_NAMES.description: SDS schema names selected by the query.

PROVIDER_IDS.description: Provider peer IDs selected by the query.

SOURCE_NAMES.description: Source names selected by the query.

BATCH_IDS.description: Batch IDs selected by the query.

WINDOW_START.description: Inclusive query window start in ISO 8601 UTC.

WINDOW_END.description: Inclusive query window end in ISO 8601 UTC.

DPMEncryptionBinding.description: Encryption metadata for protected dataset artifacts.

ENCRYPTED.description: Whether any artifact in this manifest is encrypted.

POLICY_ID.description: Policy or listing identifier bound as AAD.

AAD_SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical encryption AAD, lowercase hex.

DPM.description:
Immutable signed publication contract for one dataset update. DPM records
are the authoritative product manifests consumed by subscribers, pinning
nodes, archive nodes, and query gateways. A valid DPM answers: who published
this update, which dataset and FILE_ID it represents, which source batches
produced it, which exact bytes or provider-mediated query responses are
authorized, how those bytes are addressed, how records and indexes are
hashed, whether content-key metadata applies, and which provider signature
commits to the manifest. PNM announces the current DPM; DPM defines what
must be fetched, verified, imported, pinned, or archived.

FILE_ID.description:
Canonical publication/update partition identity. FILE_ID is the key used
everywhere a subscriber, provider, PNM, asset, entitlement, cache, audit
log, or query protocol refers to this exact update. It is not merely a
human filename and it is not the FlatBuffer file_identifier. For
completeness-verifiable streams, all returned records MUST belong to this
FILE_ID and prove inclusion under this DPM's signed roots, normally through
a declared file_id completeness index. Use this field for all update
addressing instead of inventing per-protocol IDs; provider responses,
Merkle leaves, proof paths, PNM.FILE_ID, and DPMAsset.FILE_ID must all bind
to the same value.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Provider peer ID.

ASSETS.description: Published shard, index, and auxiliary artifacts.

SOURCES.description: Source batches used to build the dataset.

INDEXES.description:
Signed completeness-capable indexes. Inclusion proofs prove that returned
records are authentic members of DATA_ROOT. Range-completeness proofs also
prove that no matching records were omitted, but only for predicates
expressible against these declared indexes.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the canonical manifest bytes or manifest digest.

DTTPayloadRef.description:
Where a block of bytes lives and how it is verified. The payload lane is
CID-first: a tile record addresses its bytes so an epoch can be verified
rather than trusted, and carries them inline only when the block is small
enough that a second fetch costs more than it saves. Exactly one of CID or
BYTES is the authority for a given ref; when both are present the bytes
MUST hash to the CID.

CID.description: Content identifier of the block in the dataset lane.

BYTES.description:
The block inline. Reserved for small blocks; a tile pyramid is
distributed by CID, never by embedding megabytes per record.

SIZE_BYTES.description:
Length of the block in bytes, whether inline or referenced, so a
consumer can budget a fetch before making it.

DIGEST.description:
Multihash of the block, lowercase hexadecimal, when the publisher states
one independently of the CID.

CONTENT_ENCODING.description:
Content encoding applied to the block before hashing, verbatim, when the
bytes are stored compressed.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the block as the publisher serves it.

DTTProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one terrain tile.

Required on every record: a redistributed elevation tile whose dataset,
epoch, and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is
DATA: DATASET_ID, DATASET_NAME, and ATTRIBUTION carry verbatim what the
source states about itself. The standard names no dataset, mission, agency,
or vendor.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the elevation dataset this
tile was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this tile was
derived from. The edition boundary, not the fetch: two tiles carrying the
same DATASET_ID and DATASET_EPOCH were cut from the same bytes.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact tile, granule, or file selection used, so the same source
bytes can be recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description:
Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display,
carried verbatim so a surface can render it without composing its own
credit line.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the granule this tile was cut from,
verbatim. The join key back to the source dataset.

GENERATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which this tile's bytes were produced by the
publisher, as distinct from the dataset edition they were cut from.

PROCESSOR.description:
Identifier of the processing pipeline and its version that produced the
tile bytes, so two tiles from one edition but different pipelines are
distinguishable.

DTT.description:
Digital Terrain Tile

One addressable tile of a terrain elevation pyramid: its address in a
stated tiling scheme, its geographic extent, its payload encoding and where
those bytes live, the vertical datum its heights are measured from, what it
states about water cover, and the dataset edition and licence it was
redistributed under.

$DTT is the SERVED ARTIFACT of a terrain lane and is deliberately not
$TRN, which configures how a consumer uses terrain (sources, interpolation,
cache size, exaggeration) and holds no elevation; nor $TRS, which is a
radio-propagation solve over terrain heights. A terrain service publishes
$DTT records, is configured by $TRN, and its heights may be consumed by
$TRS.

Angles are decimal degrees on WGS 84 and heights are metres. Tile bytes are
referenced by content identifier by default; see DTTPayloadRef.

TILESET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for the tile pyramid (the tileset) this tile
belongs to. Tiles of one pyramid share a scheme, format, and datum.

TILESET_NAME.description: The tileset's own name, verbatim, for display.

TILING_SCHEME.description: Scheme the address below is expressed in.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The scheme this tile is addressed in is not stated. Ordinal 0 so an unset field can never be read as a real scheme.

GEOGRAPHIC_WGS84.description: Equirectangular geographic scheme on WGS 84, two root tiles at level 0 covering [-180,0] and [0,180] degrees of longitude.

GEOGRAPHIC_SINGLE_ROOT.description: Single-root equirectangular geographic scheme, one root tile at level 0.

WEB_MERCATOR.description: Spherical Mercator scheme, one square root tile at level 0.

CUSTOM.description: A scheme this enum does not model; the publisher states it out of band and the tile is not addressable by a consumer that does not know it.

LEVEL.description: Zoom level of the tile, 0 at the pyramid root.

X.description: Column index within LEVEL, increasing eastward from the scheme origin.

Y.description:
Row index within LEVEL, increasing in the scheme's own row direction;
ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH states which.

ROW_ORIGIN_NORTH.description:
Row index 0 lies at the north edge of the scheme. When false, row 0 lies
at the south edge.

WEST_DEG.description: Western extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

SOUTH_DEG.description: Southern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

EAST_DEG.description: Eastern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

NORTH_DEG.description: Northern extent of the tile, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

MIN_HEIGHT_M.description:
Lowest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM. Stated
so a consumer can build a bounding volume without decoding the payload.

MAX_HEIGHT_M.description: Highest height present in the tile, metres above VERTICAL_DATUM.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The payload encoding is not stated. The tile is undecodable.

QUANTIZED_MESH.description: Quantized triangle mesh with 16-bit normalized vertex coordinates and an indexed triangle list, plus optional extension chunks.

HEIGHTMAP_UINT16.description: Regular grid of 16-bit unsigned height posts with a stated child-tile availability byte.

HEIGHTMAP_FLOAT32.description: Regular grid of 32-bit float height posts, row-major from the north-west post.

RASTER_GEOTIFF.description: Tagged image raster carrying elevation samples with its own georeference.

RASTER_RGB_ENCODED.description: Lossless RGB image raster whose channels encode elevation.

CUSTOM.description: A format this enum does not model; the publisher states it out of band.

PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION.description:
Version of PAYLOAD_FORMAT the bytes conform to, verbatim, when the
format is versioned.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Number of height posts across the tile for gridded formats. Unset for
mesh formats, whose vertex count varies.

GRID_HEIGHT.description: Number of height posts down the tile for gridded formats.

POST_SPACING_M.description:
Nominal ground distance between adjacent height posts at the tile
centre, metres. The tile's effective resolution as served, which is not
necessarily the source dataset's native post spacing.

SOURCE_POST_SPACING_M.description:
Native post spacing of the source elevations, metres, when the tile was
resampled from a coarser or finer grid.

VERTICAL_DATUM.description: Surface the heights are measured from.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The datum is not stated. Heights are not comparable across tiles.

ELLIPSOIDAL_WGS84.description: Heights above the WGS 84 reference ellipsoid.

GEOID.description: Heights above a gravimetric geoid model; the model edition is carried verbatim in VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.

MEAN_SEA_LEVEL.description: Heights above a tidal mean-sea-level surface; the realization is carried verbatim in VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.

REGIONAL_DATUM.description: Heights above a national or regional vertical reference frame, named verbatim in VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.

CUSTOM.description: A datum this enum does not model, named verbatim in VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.

VERTICAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
The datum, geoid model, or vertical reference frame named verbatim as
its authority states it.

HORIZONTAL_DATUM_NAME.description:
Horizontal reference frame the extent is expressed in, verbatim, when it
is not WGS 84.

VERTICAL_ACCURACY_M.description:
Vertical accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres, at the
confidence level stated in ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.

ACCURACY_CONFIDENCE.description:
Confidence level the accuracy figures are stated at, as a fraction
between 0 and 1.

HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY_M.description: Horizontal accuracy the publisher states for this tile, metres.

DATA_COVERAGE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of the tile extent covered by real measurements rather than
interpolated or filled values, between 0 and 1.

NO_DATA_VALUE.description: Height value used to mark absent samples in gridded payloads.

WATER_MASK_KIND.description: What the tile states about water cover.

NONE.description: The tile states nothing about water cover.

UNIFORM_LAND.description: The whole tile extent is land.

UNIFORM_WATER.description: The whole tile extent is water.

RASTER.description: A per-sample mask accompanies the tile, referenced by WATER_MASK.

WATER_MASK.description:
The per-sample water mask bytes when WATER_MASK_KIND is RASTER: one
unsigned byte per sample, 255 fully water, 0 fully land.

WATER_MASK_WIDTH.description:
Number of mask samples across and down the tile when WATER_MASK_KIND is
RASTER. Independent of GRID_WIDTH/GRID_HEIGHT: a mask is commonly
carried at a different resolution than the heights.

WATER_MASK_PROVENANCE.description:
Dataset the water mask was derived from, when it is not the elevation
dataset. A separate lineage because a mask carries its own licence.

VERTEX_NORMALS.description:
Per-sample surface normals accompanying the tile, when the publisher
serves them, so a consumer need not derive lighting from heights.

LAND_COVER.description:
Per-sample land-cover classification accompanying the tile, when the
publisher serves one.

CHILD_AVAILABILITY.description:
Availability of the four child tiles at LEVEL+1, as the low four bits:
bit 0 south-west, bit 1 south-east, bit 2 north-west, bit 3 north-east.
A set bit states the child exists in this tileset.

MAX_LEVEL.description:
The deepest level this tileset serves anywhere. A consumer stops
requesting below it rather than discovering absence by failed fetches.

SOURCE_CLASS.description: Production technique class of the source elevations.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The production technique is not stated.

AIRBORNE_RADAR.description: Airborne radar, including interferometric and synthetic-aperture radar.

GROUND_SURVEY.description: Ground survey, including levelling and kinematic positioning.

BATHYMETRIC_SOUNDING.description: Acoustic or altimetric depth sounding of water-covered surface.

CARTOGRAPHIC_CONTOUR.description: Digitized from a published contour or hypsographic map.

FUSED_MULTI_SOURCE.description: Merged from two or more classes above; the contributing datasets are carried in DTTProvenance.

SYNTHETIC.description: Synthesized rather than measured: interpolated fill, procedural relief, or a model output. Never to be presented as a measurement.

PROVENANCE.description: Dataset lineage and redistribution terms. Required.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch the elevations represent, when the
dataset states an observation epoch distinct from its edition. Terrain
changes; a tile compared across time is compared at this epoch.

ETAG.description: Entity tag for the served bytes, verbatim, so a cache can revalidate.

EXPIRES.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp after which this tile should be revalidated.

REMARKS.description:
Free-form publisher notes about this tile. Never a substitute for a
stated field.

EGPProvenance.description:
Provenance of the assertions behind a group. Field-for-field the
`$CMR` provenance shape, so one consumer parses both.

SOURCE.description: Publisher name verbatim as that publisher states it.

SOURCE_DATASET.description: Source dataset or product name verbatim.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description: Source-native row, group, object, or catalogue identifier.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: Source revision, edition, or upstream update marker verbatim.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters. Empty only when the source cannot expose replayable bytes.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Empty means unknown terms, never public
domain and never an implied grant.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text required by the source.

NOTES.description: Source caveats or reconciliation notes; never a substitute for a field.

EGPQuery.description:
The query that generated this group — the wire form of save-search-as-group.
This is generating provenance, not source lineage, so it is a field of its
own and never overloaded onto EGPProvenance.

DIALECT.description:
Query language the TEXT is written in, verbatim and lowercase, e.g.
`flatsql`. A consumer that does not implement the dialect keeps MEMBERS
and never guesses at the text.

TEXT.description: The query text verbatim, exactly as evaluated.

EVALUATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which TEXT was evaluated to
produce MEMBERS.

RESULT_COUNT.description:
Row count the evaluation returned. A consumer whose re-evaluation differs
reports drift; it never silently rewrites the record.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
Dataset or collection epoch the evaluation ran against, when the publisher
can name one.

STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the referenced record, `$` included,
e.g. `$CAT`. Never the union ordinal.

RECORD_ID.description: The referenced record's publisher-stable identifier, verbatim.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
Denormalized fast key for catalogued space objects. 0 means absent, which
is the normal case for every non-catalogue member.

CID.description: Optional content identifier pinning the exact referenced record bytes.

ADDED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp the member was added.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this membership; never a substitute for a field.

GROUP_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the group. Together with the publishing
key it is the group's identity across versions.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of what the group collects.

TAGS.description:
`namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.
This is the ONLY classification surface: there are no folders.

ENUMERATED.description: Members were chosen one by one; MEMBERS is the whole truth.

QUERY_SNAPSHOT.description: Members were produced by evaluating QUERY; MEMBERS is that evaluation frozen at QUERY.EVALUATED_AT.

QUERY_LIVE.description: QUERY is the definition and MEMBERS is an advisory cache a consumer may recompute; the query wins on disagreement.

QUERY.description: The generating query, when the group was saved from a search.

CREATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond creation timestamp.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond update timestamp. With GROUP_ID and the
publishing key this is the version key: latest-wins per publisher.

PROVENANCE.description: Dataset lineage and licence for the assertions in this group.

DATASET_CID.description: Optional content identifier of the dataset the group was drawn from.

RFSFrequencySample.description:
The material's electromagnetic properties at ONE frequency. A table of
these beats the power-law fit wherever it covers the frequency.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency this sample is stated at, megahertz — the `$RFB` MHz
convention. A join to `$IQC` (hertz) converts explicitly at the join.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_REAL.description: Real part of the relative permittivity.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description:
Imaginary part of the relative permittivity (loss term), stated as a
POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description:
Real and imaginary relative permeability. 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic
materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at THICKNESS_M, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

RFSReflectionEntry.description:
Reflection and transmission at one incidence angle and polarization. The
angular dependence of a real surface cannot be carried by a single
normal-incidence number.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description: Frequency this entry is stated at, megahertz.

INCIDENCE_ANGLE_DEG.description: Angle from the surface normal, degrees [0-90).

TRANSVERSE_ELECTRIC.description: Electric field perpendicular to the plane of incidence.

TRANSVERSE_MAGNETIC.description: Electric field parallel to the plane of incidence.

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_MAGNITUDE.description: Magnitude of the field reflection coefficient [0-1].

REFLECTION_COEFFICIENT_PHASE_DEG.description: Phase of the field reflection coefficient, degrees.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through the material at this angle, dB (positive).

SCATTERING_LOSS_DB.description: Power removed from the specular direction by surface roughness, dB.

RFSGeometryRef.description:
Where and what this material is attached to. A material record with no
geometry describes a substance; a material record WITH geometry describes
an obstacle a solver can intersect.

ASSET_MESH.description: A mesh or material slot inside a reviewed 3D asset; joins `$VAM`.

OBJECT_SURFACE.description: A named surface of a catalogued object; joins `$OPP.OPPSurface`.

SITE_STRUCTURE.description: A structure at a terrestrial site; joins `$TBS`.

BUILDING_FACE.description: A face of a building or other fixed structure.

TERRAIN_SURFACE.description: The ground or sea surface itself.

ANALYTIC_SHAPE.description: A primitive solved analytically rather than as a mesh.

VAM_ID.description:
`$VAM` asset identity, copied VERBATIM including the byte hash so the
material can never drift onto a different revision of the mesh.

MESH_NAME.description: Mesh and primitive inside the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
glTF material slot the properties apply to, matching the
`$OPP.OPPSurface` join fields.

FACE_INDEXES.description: Explicit face indexes, when the material covers part of a mesh.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description:
`$CAT` identity, when the obstacle is a catalogued object. 0 when
unbound.

TBS_SITE_ID.description: `$TBS.SITE_ID`, when the obstacle is a structure at a terrestrial site.

FEATURE_ID.description: Producer's own feature identifier for a building, wall or terrain patch.

ANALYTIC_SHAPE.description:
Primitive and its dimensions in metres, when GEOMETRY_KIND is
ANALYTIC_SHAPE. The dimension order is the primitive's own convention and
MUST be stated in SHAPE_DIMENSION_NAMES.

CONVEX_HULL.description: Convex hull of a point set carried by the geometry it references.

LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Geodetic placement of a fixed obstacle, degrees and metres. Absent for
an obstacle whose position is joined from `$CAT`, `$TBS` or `$VAM`.

HEIGHT_M.description: Height above ground of a fixed structure, metres.

NORMAL_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Orientation of the surface normal, degrees east of north and above the
horizon. A wall that faces the wrong way blocks the wrong link.

MEASURED.description: Measured on this surface or a coupon of its material.

MODELED.description: Computed from a physical model of the material's composition.

CLASS_DEFAULT.description: Taken from a published table for the material class, not this surface.

INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY.description: Borrowed from a similar structure or bus family; visibly an approximation.

SOURCE.description:
The measurement campaign, published table or model. Required: an
unattributed permittivity is not publishable.

SOURCE_REFERENCE.description: The specific table, recommendation or dataset entry within SOURCE.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: Replayable query that retrieves the source value.

MEASUREMENT_TECHNIQUE.description:
How it was measured (e.g. "free-space transmission", "coaxial probe",
"resonant cavity").

MODULE_ID.description: `$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` / `$PMM.MODULE_ID` that produced modelled values.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty of the permittivity and conductivity values, in the
units of the quantity they qualify.

LICENSE.description:
Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a
grant to redistribute.

MATERIAL_ID.description:
Stable identifier of this material. Joined by
`$RFL.RFLObstruction.MATERIAL_ID` and `$CVP.CVPObstacleRef.MATERIAL_ID`.

NAME.description: Name as its source states it, verbatim.

COATED_GLASS.description: Glass treated to reflect infrared, which also attenuates RF strongly.

CARBON_FIBER_COMPOSITE.description: Carbon-fibre structure, electrically conductive along the fibres.

ABSORBER.description: Surface engineered to absorb incident RF energy.

ENGINEERED_SURFACE.description: Frequency-selective or periodic structure whose response is not a bulk material property.

OTHER.description: The source states a material this enum cannot express. The verbatim name MUST be preserved in NAME.

DESCRIPTION.description: Free-text description of the surface, not of its vendor.

FREQUENCY_MIN_MHZ.description:
Frequency range over which this record's parameters are valid,
megahertz. A solver MUST refuse to evaluate outside it rather than
extrapolate.

REFERENCE_FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Frequency the scalar values below are stated at, megahertz. Without it
they are uninterpretable.

RELATIVE_PERMITTIVITY_IMAGINARY.description: Loss term, stated as a POSITIVE magnitude.

RELATIVE_PERMEABILITY_REAL.description: 1.0 and 0.0 for non-magnetic materials — stated, not assumed.

REFLECTIVITY.description: Power reflected at normal incidence as a ratio [0-1].

REFLECTION_LOSS_DB.description: Reflection loss at normal incidence, dB (positive).

THICKNESS_M.description:
Thickness the transmission and penetration losses are stated for, metres.
A transmission loss without a thickness cannot be rescaled.

TRANSMISSION_LOSS_DB.description: Loss through THICKNESS_M at normal incidence, dB (positive).

ATTENUATION_DB_PER_M.description: Attenuation inside the material, dB per metre.

ABSORPTION_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of incident power absorbed at normal incidence [0-1].

SURFACE_ROUGHNESS_RMS_M.description:
RMS surface roughness, metres. Roughness is what decides whether a
surface is a mirror or a scatterer at a given wavelength.

ROUGHNESS_CORRELATION_LENGTH_M.description: Correlation length of the roughness, metres.

SPECULAR.description: Mirror-like; energy leaves at the reflection angle.

MIXED.description: A specular lobe over a diffuse background.

LAMBERTIAN.description: Diffuse with a cosine angular distribution.

ANISOTROPIC.description: Direction-dependent scattering that a single coefficient cannot describe.

DIFFUSE_SCATTERING_COEFFICIENT.description: Fraction of non-absorbed power leaving diffusely [0-1].

TEMPERATURE_K.description: Temperature the properties were evaluated at, kelvin.

MOISTURE_CONTENT_FRACTION.description:
Volumetric moisture content [0-1]. Wet concrete and dry concrete are
different materials at RF.

SALINITY_PSU.description: Salinity, practical salinity units, for water surfaces.

FREQUENCY_SAMPLES.description:
Per-frequency samples. Where present and covering the frequency, these
take precedence over the power law.

GEOMETRY.description:
Geometry this material is attached to. A record may attach one material
to several obstacles.

PROVENANCE.description: Provenance. Required.

COMPUTED_AT.description: Unix ms this record was serialized.

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature by the producing `$EPM`.

EMCEndpointRef.description: Stable reference to one endpoint of the assessment.

SPACECRAFT.description: On-orbit object; joins `$CAT` by NORAD_CAT_ID / OBJECT_ID.

GEODETIC_TRACKING_STATION.description: Geodetic tracking station; joins `$GST` by STATION_ID.

RELAY_PAYLOAD.description: A relay payload acting as an intermediate endpoint of a multi-hop chain.

EMCIntermodulationTerm.description:
One signed integer coefficient in an intermodulation product. The product
frequency is the exact sum of COEFFICIENT * SOURCE_FREQUENCY_HZ terms.

INTERMODULATION_ORDER.description:
Order of the active or passive intermodulation product. 0 when the
mechanism is not intermodulation.

EMISSION_MASK_ID.description: RFEEmissionMask.MASK_ID used for an emission-limit comparison.

RFS_MATERIAL_ID.description: `$RFS.MATERIAL_ID` and class used for structural coupling.

COATED_GLASS.description: Glass treated to reflect infrared, which also attenuates RF strongly.

CARBON_FIBER_COMPOSITE.description: Carbon-fibre structure, electrically conductive along the fibres.

ABSORBER.description: Surface engineered to absorb incident RF energy.

ENGINEERED_SURFACE.description: Frequency-selective or periodic structure whose response is not a bulk material property.

OTHER.description: The source states a material this enum cannot express. The verbatim name MUST be preserved in NAME.

EXCEEDANCE_DB.description: Positive when the victim limit is exceeded.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

ENCRYPTED_BLOB.description: Encrypted data blob, containing the ciphertext of the original plaintext message.

EPHEMERAL_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Temporary public key used for the encryption session, contributing to the derivation of the shared secret.

MAC.description: Message Authentication Code to verify the integrity and authenticity of the encrypted message.

NONCE_START.description: Random 12-byte nonce starting value. Incremented for each record in the stream to ensure unique nonces.

TAG.description: Additional authentication tag used in some encryption schemes for integrity and authenticity verification.

IV.description: Initialization vector used to introduce randomness in the encryption process, enhancing security.

SALT.description: Cryptographic salt used in key derivation (e.g. HKDF) to ensure unique key material per session.

PUBLIC_KEY_IDENTIFIER.description: Identifier for the public key used, aiding in recipient key management and message decryption.

CIPHER_SUITE.description: Specifies the set of cryptographic algorithms used in the encryption process.

KDF_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters for the Key Derivation Function, guiding the process of deriving keys from the shared secret.

ENCRYPTION_ALGORITHM_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters defining specific settings for the encryption algorithm, such as block size or operation mode.

ENC.description: Encryption Header containing all parameters needed for decryption

EPHEMERAL_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Ephemeral public key for ECDH key agreement (32-65 bytes depending on algorithm)

NONCE_START.description: Random 12-byte nonce starting value. Incremented for each record in the stream to ensure unique nonces.

RECIPIENT_KEY_ID.description: Optional identifier for the recipient's public key (up to 32 bytes)

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the FlatBuffers schema (32 bytes)

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name from the schema

TIMESTAMP.description: Optional Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when encryption was performed

ENT.description:
Entitlement - Provider subscription or account entitlement state.

This is durable operational state for a provider account, not a plugin
license key. It records the current authoritative entitlement for an SDN
account identity and can be projected into subscription, billing, and
access-control surfaces.

PEER_ID.description: Current SDN peer ID bound to the entitlement.

STATUS_TEXT.description: Original provider status string when finer detail is needed.

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement expires (0 = no expiry).

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when the entitlement was last updated.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the entitlement issuer/provider.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the entitlement record.

CLASSIFICATION.description: Classification marking of the data in IC/CAPCO Portion-marked format.

OB_TIME.description: Ob detection time in ISO 8601 UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ssssssZ), up to microsecond precision.

CORR_QUALITY.description: Correlation score of the observation when compared to a known orbit state.

ID_ON_ORBIT.description: Server will auto-populate with SAT_NO if available.

SENSOR_ID.description: Unique ID of the sensor. Must have a corresponding sensor record on the server.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: 18SDS satellite number. Only list if correlated against the 18SDS catalog.

TASK_ID.description: Identifier for the collectRequest message if the collection was in response to tasking.

TRANSACTION_ID.description: Optional identifier to track a transaction.

IMAGE_SET_ID.description: The user-defined set ID of a sequence of images.

IMAGE_SET_LENGTH.description: The number of images in an image set.

SEQUENCE_ID.description: The sequence ID of an image within an image set.

OB_POSITION.description: The position of this observation within a track (FENCE, FIRST, IN, LAST, SINGLE).

ORIG_OBJECT_ID.description: Provider maintained ID. May not be consistent with 18SDS SAT_NO.

UCT.description: Required if correlation is attempted. Indicates whether correlation succeeded.

AZIMUTH.description: Line of sight azimuth angle in degrees and topocentric frame.

AZIMUTH_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight azimuth angle, in degrees.

AZIMUTH_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight azimuth angle bias in degrees.

AZIMUTH_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight azimuth in degrees per second.

ELEVATION.description: Line of sight elevation in degrees and topocentric frame.

ELEVATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight elevation angle, in degrees.

ELEVATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight elevation bias in degrees.

ELEVATION_RATE.description: Rate of change of the line of sight elevation in degrees per second.

RANGE.description: Line of sight range in km. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range, in km.

RANGE_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight range bias in km.

RANGE_RATE.description: Range rate in km/s. Reported value should include all applicable corrections.

RANGE_RATE_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight range rate, in km/sec.

RA.description: Right ascension in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

RA_RATE.description: Line of sight right ascension rate of change, in degrees/sec.

RA_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight right ascension angle, in degrees.

RA_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight right ascension bias in degrees.

DECLINATION.description: Declination in degrees. Required metric reporting field for EO observations.

DECLINATION_RATE.description: Line of sight declination rate of change, in degrees/sec.

DECLINATION_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line of sight declination angle, in degrees.

DECLINATION_BIAS.description: Sensor line of sight declination angle bias in degrees.

LOSX.description: X-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSY.description: Y-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOSZ.description: Z-component of the unit vector representing the line-of-sight direction in the observer's reference frame.

LOS_UNC.description: One sigma uncertainty in the line-of-sight direction vector components.

LOSXVEL.description: X-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSYVEL.description: Y-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

LOSZVEL.description: Z-component of the velocity vector along the line of sight, in km/s.

SENLAT.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENLON.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees at the time of the observation.

SENALT.description: Sensor height in km relative to the WGS-84 ellipsoid at the time of the observation.

SENX.description: Cartesian X position in km at the time of the observation.

SENY.description: Cartesian Y position in km at the time of the observation.

SENZ.description: Cartesian Z position in km at the time of the observation.

FOV_COUNT.description: Total number of satellites in the field of view.

FOV_COUNT_UCTS.description: Number of uncorrelated satellites in the field of view (JCO).

EXP_DURATION.description:
Image exposure duration in seconds. For observations performed using frame stacking or synthetic tracking methods,
the exposure duration should be the total integration time. This field is highly recommended / required if the
observations are going to be used for photometric processing.

NET_OBJ_SIG_UNC.description: Net object signature uncertainty = counts uncertainty / EXP_DURATION.

MAG.description: Measure of observed brightness calibrated against the Gaia G-band.

GEOLAT.description:
Computed estimate of the latitude, positive degrees north. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and corresponding viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOLON.description:
Computed estimate of the longitude as +/- 180 degrees east. It should be computed based on the assumed slant range
and viewing geometry. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEOALT.description: Computed estimate of satellite altitude in km at the reported location. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

GEORANGE.description: Computed estimate of the slant range in km. It must NOT be computed from the orbit state.

SKY_BKGRND.description:
Average Sky Background signal, in Magnitudes. Sky Background refers to the incoming light from an apparently
empty part of the night sky.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION.description:
Primary Extinction Coefficient, in Magnitudes. Primary Extinction is the coefficient applied to the airmass
to determine how much the observed visual magnitude has been attenuated by the atmosphere. Extinction, in general,
describes the absorption and scattering of electromagnetic radiation by dust and gas between an emitting astronomical
object and the observer.

PRIMARY_EXTINCTION_UNC.description: Primary Extinction Coefficient Uncertainty, in Magnitudes.

SOLAR_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector. Recommend using the
calculation listed in the EOSSA documentation, pg 106 of the EOSSA spec.

SOLAR_EQ_PHASE_ANGLE.description:
The angle, in degrees, between the projections of the target-to-observer vector and the target-to-sun vector
onto the equatorial plane. The convention used is negative when closing (i.e., before the opposition)
and positive when opening (after the opposition).

SOLAR_DEC_ANGLE.description: Angle from the sun to the equatorial plane.

RAW_FILE_URI.description: Optional URI location in the document repository of the raw file parsed by the system to produce this record.

INTENSITY.description: Intensity of the target for IR observations, in kw/sr/em.

BG_INTENSITY.description: Background intensity for IR observations, in kw/sr/um.

DESCRIPTOR.description: Optional source-provided and searchable metadata or descriptor of the data.

ORIGIN.description:
Originating system or organization which produced the data, if different from the source.
The origin may be different than the source if the source was a mediating system which forwarded
the data on behalf of the origin system. If null, the source may be assumed to be the origin.

DATA_MODE.description: Indicator of whether the data is EXERCISE, REAL, SIMULATED, or TEST.

EXERCISE.description: Data collected during an exercise scenario.

CREATED_AT.description: Time the row was created in the database, auto-populated by the system.

CREATED_BY.description: Application user who created the row in the database, auto-populated by the system.

REFERENCE_FRAME.description: EO observations are assumed to be topocentric J2000 coordinates ('J2000') as defined by the IAU, unless otherwise specified.

SEN_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
The sensor reference frame is assumed to be the International Terrestrial Reference Frame (ITRF),
unless otherwise specified. (ITRF is equivalent to Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed (ECEF) for this purpose).
Lat / long / height values should be reported using the WGS-84 ellipsoid, where applicable.

UMBRA.description: Boolean indicating that the target object was in umbral eclipse at the time of this observation.

PENUMBRA.description:
Boolean indicating that the target object was in a penumbral eclipse at the time of this observation.
This field is highly recommended if the observations will be used for photometric processing.

ORIG_NETWORK.description: The originating source network on which this record was created, auto-populated by the system.

SOURCE_DL.description: The source from which this record was received.

UNKNOWN.description: Basic and General Sensors Basic or undefined sensor type

INFRARED_SENSOR.description: Electromagnetic Spectrum Sensors Detects infrared radiation

RADAR.description: Radar and Radio Telescopes Basic radar systems

PHASED_ARRAY_RADAR.description: Advanced radar with phased array technology

BISTATIC_RADIO_TELESCOPE.description: For astronomical observations using bistatic setup

ATMOSPHERIC_SENSOR.description: Environmental and Atmospheric Sensors For atmospheric studies

SEISMIC_SENSOR.description: Specialized Scientific Sensors For measuring seismic activities

LIDAR.description: Advanced Optical and Imaging Sensors Light Detection and Ranging

MULTISPECTRAL_SENSOR.description: Capturing image data at multiple wavelengths

HYPERSPECTRAL_SENSOR.description: Advanced imaging across many spectral bands

GPS_RECEIVER.description: Positioning and Tracking Sensors For Global Positioning System reception

RADIO_COMMUNICATIONS.description: Communication Devices Standard radio communication device

LASER_INSTRUMENT.description: Specialized Scientific Instruments Device for laser-based experiments and measurements

RF_ANALYZER.description: Radio frequency analysis and measurement device

LASER_IMAGING.description: Optical Devices Device for laser-based imaging

AZIMUTH_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if azimuth is reported.

ELEVATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if elevation is reported.

RANGE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range is reported.

RANGERATE_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if range-rate is reported.

RA_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if right ascension is reported.

DECLINATION_MEASURED.description: True if measured, false if computed. Required if declination is reported.

NIIRS.description: National Imagery Interpretability Rating Scale (NIIRS). Ranging from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest).

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground sample distance in meters per pixel.

IMAGE_SNR.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the image. Higher values indicate cleaner imagery.

IMAGE_WIDTH.description: Width of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_HEIGHT.description: Height of the image in pixels.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION.description: Compression type used for the image, e.g., "JPEG", "PNG", "RAW", etc.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION_RATIO.description: Compression ratio used (original size / compressed size), if applicable.

PROCESSED_IMAGE_URI.description: URI to the processed image used for this observation.

IMAGE_AUTO_ENHANCED.description: Flag indicating whether the image was auto-enhanced (e.g., contrast stretch, denoise).

MULTI_FRAME_STACKED.description: True if the observation was taken with multiple frames stacked into one image.

SYNTHETIC_TRACKING_USED.description: True if synthetic tracking was used to create the image.

IMAGE_SHARPNESS.description: Sharpness metric of the image based on the Tenengrad method or variance of Laplacian. Higher values indicate sharper images.

IMAGE_NOISE_STDDEV.description: Noise level of the image, estimated via pixel intensity variance in background regions.

IMAGE_CONTRAST.description: Contrast metric of the image, such as Michelson contrast or RMS contrast.

IMAGE_DYNAMIC_RANGE.description: Dynamic range of the image (max pixel value / min pixel value), indicating tonal spread.

IMAGE_ENTROPY.description: Entropy of the image, representing the richness of information content. Higher entropy suggests higher texture detail.

BACKGROUND_UNIFORMITY.description: Background uniformity metric (e.g., mean gradient in background areas). Lower values indicate more uniform background.

BACKGROUND_MEAN_LEVEL.description: Mean background level, computed from non-object regions in pixel units.

SATURATED_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of saturated pixels in the image. Indicates overexposure when high.

DEAD_PIXEL_PERCENT.description: Percentage of dead or zero-value pixels in the image. Indicates sensor defects or underexposure.

PSF_FWHM.description: Estimated Point Spread Function (PSF) Full Width at Half Maximum (FWHM) in pixels. Indicates image blur or focus.

CLOUD_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of cloud cover in the image. Derived using cloud detection algorithms such as Fmask or machine learning classifiers.

CLOUD_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence score of the cloud detection result, from 0 (low confidence) to 1 (high confidence).

HAZE_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of the image obscured by haze or atmospheric scattering effects.

AEROSOL_OPTICAL_THICKNESS.description: Estimated aerosol optical thickness (AOT) at 550 nm, indicating particulate matter in the atmosphere affecting image clarity.

WATER_VAPOR_CONTENT.description: Estimated water vapor content (e.g., total column precipitable water) at the time of imaging, in mm.

SUN_ELEVATION.description: Sun elevation angle at the time of image capture, in degrees above the horizon.

SUN_AZIMUTH.description: Sun azimuth angle at the time of image capture, in degrees from true north.

VIEW_ZENITH_ANGLE.description: View zenith angle (sensor line-of-sight angle from nadir), in degrees.

VIEW_AZIMUTH_ANGLE.description: View azimuth angle (direction of sensor relative to north), in degrees.

OFF_NADIR_ANGLE.description: Off-nadir angle of the sensor at the time of image capture, in degrees.

SWATH_WIDTH_KM.description: Ground coverage width of the image swath in kilometers.

MEAN_TERRAIN_ELEVATION.description: Mean terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters above sea level.

TERRAIN_ELEVATION_STDDEV.description: Standard deviation of terrain elevation in the image footprint, in meters.

SHADOW_COVER_PERCENT.description: Percentage of the image affected by shadows, derived via topographic or object shadow detection.

SUNGLINT_PRESENT.description: Flag indicating whether sunglint is present in the image (true if high reflectance from water surface due to sun geometry).

SUNGLINT_PERCENT.description: Percentage of image affected by sunglint.

SNOW_ICE_COVER_PERCENT.description: Estimated percentage of snow or ice coverage in the image footprint.

VALID_DATA_AREA_KM2.description: Total area covered by valid data (non-masked, usable imagery) in square kilometers.

IERS_BULLETIN_A.description: IERS Bulletin A rapid service / prediction.

Fastest Path Compute — envelope message for weighted graph ingestion and

FSB.description:
FlatSQL Byte Stream — a bounded, typed chunk used for append/query and
opaque snapshot/WAL persistence. DATA carries at most one MiB so larger
inputs and snapshots are delivered as ordered chunks. The host may persist
canonical FSB bytes but must not interpret DATA as tables, rows, or SQL.

FSOTableBinding.description:
One canonical SDS file-identifier to FlatSQL table binding. A configured
node rebuilds these bindings before replaying durable record bytes.

FSO.description:
FlatSQL Operation — generic control, policy, and status record for the
independently packaged FlatSQL WASM node.

Bulk records, query results, snapshots, and WAL chunks travel separately as
FSB frames so operations remain streamable and no host needs to interpret a
database payload. SCHEMA_IDL is canonical SDS/FlatBuffers IDL supplied to
the node for schema-derived table/index construction.

SCHEMA_IDL.description:
UTF-8 FlatBuffers IDL bytes. A byte vector is used because the aligned
compiler intentionally limits fixed inline strings to 255 bytes.

`$DOA` observation must have been derived from the named `$IQC` capture.

GELConvergenceDiagnostics.description: Numerical convergence diagnostics for the fused estimator.

Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and

Array of position arrays (for MultiLineString, Polygon rings)

IS_BOOL.description: True if this property value is a boolean

BOOL_VALUE.description: Boolean value (use when IS_BOOL is true)

GJNBoundingBox.description: GeoJSON Bounding Box [west, south, east, north] or [west, south, min-alt, east, north, max-alt]
