DID_NOT_CONVERGE.description: Iteration did not reach ACCURACY within MAX_ITERATIONS.

STANDARD_DEVIATION.description: Post-warmup per-state sample standard deviations with n - 1 denominator.

FINAL_STATE.description: State after the final generated sample.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

odSensorContribution.description: Sensor contribution to an orbit determination solution

NUM_ACCEPTED.description: Number of accepted observations from this sensor

NUM_REJECTED.description: Number of rejected observations from this sensor

WRMS.description: Weighted RMS for this sensor's observations

START_TIME.description: OD fit start time (ISO 8601)

INITIAL_OD.description: True if this is an initial orbit determination

APRIORI_ELSET.description: A priori element set data reference

APRIORI_STATE_VECTOR.description: A priori state vector data reference

BALLISTIC_COEFF_EST.description: True if ballistic coefficient was estimated

AGOM_EST.description: True if area-to-mass ratio was estimated

REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
Reference Frame
Typically TEMEOFDATE

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time System [M, UTC]

SCLK.description: Spacecraft Clock (receiver) (requires rules for interpretation in ICD)

SGP4XP.description: Simplified General Perturbation Model 4 eXtended Perturbations (SGP4-XP), as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature.

EPOCH.description: EPOCH of Mean Keplerian elements (ISO 8601 UTC format)

SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS.description: Semi-major axis in km or Mean Motion in rev/day

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in rev/day if MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY=SGP/SGP4 else unused

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: MEAN_ANOMALY in degrees

EPHEMERIS_TYPE.description:
TLE Related Parameters (Only if MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY=SGP/SGP4)
EPHEMERIS_TYPE Default=0

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD_CAT_ID (integer) [O if SGP/SGP4]

BSTAR.description: BSTAR in 1/Earth radii or BTERM in m**2/kg depending on MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY [C]

MEAN_MOTION_DOT.description: MEAN_MOTION_DOT in rev/day**2 [C if SGP or PPT3]

MEAN_MOTION_DDOT.description: MEAN_MOTION_DDOT in rev/day**3 if SGP/PPT3 or AGOM in m**2/kg if SGP4-XP [C]

COV_REFERENCE_FRAME.description:
Position/Velocity Covariance Matrix (6x6 Lower Triangular) [C if any covariance provided]
COV_REF_FRAME reference frame for covariance [C if covariance given]
Typically RSW

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (6x6 lower triangular = 21 elements).
Order: [CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z,
CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z, CX_DOT_X_DOT,
CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT]
Units: position in km**2, velocity in km**2/s**2, cross in km**2/s

ANTENNA_TYPE.description: Antenna type (e.g., PARABOLIC, PHASED_ARRAY, HORN, HELICAL, DIPOLE, PATCH, YAGI)

QUANTITY.description: Number of antennas of this type

BAND.description: Operating frequency band (e.g., UHF, L, S, C, X, Ku, Ka, V, W)

APERTURE.description: Antenna diameter or aperture in meters

POLARIZATION.description: Polarization type (e.g., LINEAR, CIRCULAR, DUAL, RHCP, LHCP)

SLEW_RATE.description: Maximum slew rate in degrees per second

PURPOSE.description: Purpose or function (e.g., TT_C, PAYLOAD, CROSSLINK, GPS)

CHEMISTRY.description: Battery chemistry (e.g., LI_ION, NICD, NIMH, LIPO, SILVER_ZINC)

QUANTITY.description: Number of batteries of this type

MAX_DOD.description: Maximum depth of discharge as fraction (0.0-1.0)

STATE_OF_HEALTH.description: Current state of health as fraction (0.0-1.0)

DERIVED_FROM.description: Source record this was derived from

GEO_POSITION.description: GEO longitude at event time (degrees east)

DESCRIPTION.description: Description of why object is of interest

MEAN_ANOMALY.description: Mean anomaly (degrees)

CELL_TYPE.description: Solar cell type (e.g., SILICON, GAAS, MULTI_JUNCTION, THIN_FILM, PEROVSKITE)

QUANTITY.description: Number of solar arrays of this type

AREA.description: Total array area in square meters

POWER_BOL.description: Beginning of life power output in Watts

POWER_EOL.description: End of life power output in Watts

DEGRADATION_RATE.description: Degradation rate per year as fraction

QUANTITY.description: Number of thrusters of this type

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant type (e.g., HYDRAZINE, XENON, KRYPTON, MMH_NTO, N2, GN2)

OPPProvenance.description:
Provenance for exactly one physical value.

This table is the mechanism by which the never-invent-data law is enforced
in the IDL rather than in prose: no physical quantity in an $OPP can be
expressed without one of these attached, so a value with no admissible
source cannot be encoded at all. Unknown values are ABSENT. They are never
zero, never a placeholder, and never carried forward from a different
object.

SOURCE.description:
Publisher of the value, named as the publisher names itself — a space
agency's object database, a public satellite catalogue, a third-party
satellite reference site, or the operator itself.

SOURCE_RECORD_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the record this value was read from, such
as that database's object id. Verbatim, never normalized.

SOURCE_URL.description: Deep link to the exact source record when the source publishes one.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) of the
instant the value describes: the epoch at which the property held. A
design or as-built value that does not change over time omits EPOCH.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
this record retrieved the value from SOURCE.

SOURCE_VERSION.description: The source's own revision, edition or publication marker, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source published the value without stating how it was obtained.

MEASURED.description: Direct physical measurement: radar range measurement, laboratory weigh-in, photometric observation, tape measure on the flight article.

OPERATOR_STATED.description: Published by the operator, manufacturer or launch provider for this specific object.

ESTIMATED.description: The source's own estimate, stated as an estimate.

DERIVED.description: Computed by the record's publisher from other values that each carry their own provenance in this same record.

MODEL_DERIVED.description: Measured off 3D-asset geometry. A MODEL_DERIVED value describes the model, not the flight article, and is never presented as a physical measurement.

INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY.description: Taken from the bus design or from a sibling object in the same family because no per-object value exists. Always an approximation.

LICENSE.description: Terms under which SOURCE permits redistribution of the value, verbatim.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution string the source requires be displayed with the value.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact source
payload bytes the value was parsed from.

NOTES.description: Free text qualifying the value, such as the source's own caveat.

OPPQuantity.description:
One scalar physical quantity, its unit and its own provenance.

PROVENANCE is required: an OPPQuantity that exists names where it came from.
Presence of the table is the signal that a value exists, so VALUE zero is a
real zero (0 dBsm is 1 m2) and an unknown quantity omits the whole table.

UNITS.description:
Unit symbol verbatim, never silently converted: "kg", "m", "m2", "m2/kg",
"kg/m2", "dBsm", "W", "mag". A converted value states the unit it was
converted to and records the conversion in PROVENANCE.NOTES with
PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

SIGMA.description:
1-sigma uncertainty in UNITS. Zero means the source stated no uncertainty;
a genuine stated sigma is never exactly zero.

OPPRadarCrossSection.description:
Radar cross-section as reported for one band, polarization and aspect
convention. Radar cross-section is band- and aspect-dependent, so an $OPP
carries a list of these and never a single scalar. A source publishing
minimum, average and maximum cross-sections becomes three entries with
ASPECT MINIMUM, AVERAGE and MAXIMUM sharing one SOURCE.

BAND.description:
Radar band designation verbatim from the source: "UHF", "L", "S", "C",
"X", "Ku". Empty when the source states no band.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Centre frequency [megahertz] when the source states one. Zero means
unstated.

POLARIZATION.description:
Polarization verbatim from the source: "HH", "VV", "HV", "RCRC". Empty
when the source states none.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source states no aspect convention. Characteristic cross-sections published by catalogue-level object databases use this value.

CROSS_SECTION.description:
The cross-section itself. UNITS is "m2" or "dBsm" as the source published
it; the two are never mixed within one entry and never silently converted.

SIZE_CLASS.description:
Size bucket verbatim when a source publishes a bucket instead of a number,
such as a public catalogue's "SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE". A bucket is never
turned into a number.

SENSOR.description: Sensor or facility that produced the measurement, when stated.

OPPMass.description:
Mass breakdown. Each component is independently sourced; a wet mass and a
dry mass may legitimately come from different publishers and epochs.

WET.description: Mass with propellant, at the stated epoch [kg].

LAUNCH.description: Mass at separation from the launch vehicle [kg].

PROPELLANT.description: Propellant mass at the stated epoch [kg].

PAYLOAD.description: Payload mass carried by the bus [kg].

CURRENT.description: Best current estimate of mass at the record's epoch [kg].

OPPDimensions.description:
Physical envelope. Every extent is a sourced quantity. Extents measured off
3D-asset geometry carry PROVENANCE.METHOD MODEL_DERIVED and describe the
model, not the flight article.

BODY_X.description: Extents along the object's own body axes [m].

HEIGHT.description: Envelope terms as an object database publishes them [m].

SHAPE.description:
Gross geometric shape verbatim from the source, such as a shape string
of the form "Box + 1 Pan" or "Cyl". Never parsed into geometry.

SHAPE_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of SHAPE. Present whenever SHAPE is nonempty.

OPPAreas.description: Projected areas and the ratios derived from them.

CROSS_SECTIONAL_AVERAGE.description: Average projected cross-sectional area over all aspects [m2].

AREA_TO_MASS_RATIO.description:
Area-to-mass ratio [m2/kg], only when a source publishes one directly or
the publisher derives it with PROVENANCE.METHOD DERIVED.

OPPSurface.description:
One exterior surface of the object: what it is made of, how large it is and
how it interacts with light.

$PNL carries the articulated panel model used for solar-radiation-pressure
propagation; an $OPP surface is the sourced material inventory. When both
exist, PANEL_ID joins this surface to its $PNL panel. GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME and
GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX join it to the exact glTF material in the asset variant
named by OPP.ASSET.

ID.description: Stable identifier for this surface within the record.

MATERIAL.description:
Material name verbatim from the source, in whatever designation the
source uses: a multi-layer-insulation film, a photovoltaic cell
chemistry, an alloy temper designation. Empty when unstated.

COUNT.description:
How many identical surfaces this entry represents, such as two solar-array
wings.

PROVENANCE.description:
Provenance of MATERIAL, MATERIAL_CLASS, KIND and COUNT. Every dimensioned
field below carries its own.

AREA.description: Area of one surface, not of COUNT surfaces [m2].

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly, dimensionless.

DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected diffusely, dimensionless.

PANEL_ID.description:
Join key to the $PNL panel representing this surface; holds that record's
PNLPanel.PANEL_ID verbatim. Empty when no $PNL panel exists.

GLTF_MATERIAL_NAME.description:
Name of the glTF material that renders this surface, verbatim, in the
variant named by OPP.ASSET.VARIANT_ID. Empty when the surface is not
represented in the asset.

GLTF_MATERIAL_INDEX.description:
Zero-based index into the glTF materials array of that same variant.
Negative one means no glTF material corresponds to this surface.

OPPAssetRef.description:
Binding to the exact 3D asset bytes this record accompanies.

Every field is copied verbatim from the $VAM that governs the asset, so an
$OPP is valid for exactly one reviewed variant. Different bytes are a
different asset: mint a new $OPP and set SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID rather than
repointing an existing one.

VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact $VAM bytes.

VARIANT_ID.description: $VAMVariant.ID verbatim: the specific glTF or GLB this record describes.

ASSET_SHA256.description:
$VAMVariant.BYTE_SHA256 verbatim: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
encoding SHA-256 of the exact asset file bytes.

GEOMETRY_MATCHES_PHYSICAL.description:
True only when the asset geometry was authored or rescaled to the physical
dimensions in this record. False, the default, means the asset is
representative and its geometry is not a source of physical dimensions.

METERS_PER_ASSET_UNIT.description:
Metres per asset unit for the named variant. Restates
$VAMTransform.METERS_PER_SOURCE_UNIT for consumers that read only $OPP.

OPP.description:
Object Physical Properties - the sourced physical description of one space
object and, when one exists, of the exact 3D asset that represents it.

Division of labour with the neighbouring standards. $CAT is catalogue
identity and orbit, and its RCS, SIZE and MASS scalars are unattributed
convenience fields carried from the catalogue publisher. $BUS is the bus
DESIGN, shared by every object built on it. $VAM is the asset manifest: the
bytes, the licence, the review and the geometry metrics. $PNL is the
articulated panel model consumed by solar-radiation-pressure propagation.
$OPP is the per-object physical truth in which EVERY value names its own
source, epoch and method. $OPP never restates orbital elements and never
duplicates bus-design values; a per-object value that came from the bus
design is stated here with METHOD INFERRED_FROM_FAMILY so a consumer can see
that it is an approximation.

Joins. NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID join to $CAT. BUS_ID joins to $BUS.
ASSET joins to the exact reviewed $VAM variant. ENTITY_ID is the stable
non-catalogue key shared with $VAM for objects that have no catalogue entry.

Never-invent law, enforced by the shape rather than by prose: a physical
quantity exists only as an OPPQuantity and OPPQuantity.PROVENANCE is
required, so there is no encoding for a mass, dimension, area or
cross-section that does not name where it came from. Unknown values are
absent. A consumer that finds a field missing has learned that no admissible
source published it.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 record-format version, not a content revision.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: $CAT.NORAD_CAT_ID verbatim. Zero when the object has no catalogue number.

OBJECT_NAME.description: $CAT.OBJECT_NAME verbatim, for display only. Never a join key.

ENTITY_ID.description:
Stable non-catalogue entity key, such as an asset catalogue entity path.
MUST equal ASSET.ENTITY_ID when ASSET is present.

BUS_ID.description:
Join key to the $BUS record describing this object's bus design; holds
that record's BUS.ID verbatim. Empty when the bus is unknown or has no
$BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY.description:
Bus or platform family name verbatim from BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.SOURCE,
for objects whose family is known but has no $BUS record.

BUS_FAMILY_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of BUS_FAMILY. Present whenever BUS_FAMILY is nonempty.

MANUFACTURER.description: Manufacturer or prime contractor as stated by MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.

MANUFACTURER_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance of MANUFACTURER. Present whenever MANUFACTURER is nonempty.

RADAR_CROSS_SECTIONS.description:
One entry per band, polarization and aspect the sources publish. Empty
means no source published a radar cross-section for this object.

VISUAL_MAGNITUDE.description:
Visual magnitude, UNITS "mag", with the observing conditions in
PROVENANCE.NOTES.

ASSET.description:
Binding to the exact reviewed 3D asset this record accompanies. Absent for
an object with no asset; the physical values remain valid without it.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted while building this record, including sources that
yielded no value. Lets a consumer distinguish "not looked for" from
"looked for and not published".

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when
the record was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_OPP_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded $OPP bytes.

IS_STABLE.description: Indicates whether the observation is stable or not

OBJECT_ID.description: Unique identifier for the object being observed

PASS_DURATION.description: Duration of the observation pass in seconds

PAPElement.description: One array element and its applied complex weight.

PAPGainCut.description: One one-dimensional gain cut through the synthesized pattern.

PAPNull.description: One requested adaptive null and its achieved result.

HOP_SCHEDULE_ID.description: BEMHopSchedule.SCHEDULE_ID evaluated by this synthesis, when applicable.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.

PGMMetadataEntry.description: String metadata key/value attached to a peer group.

DEFAULT_TRUST_LEVEL.description: Default trust level for peers in this group.

MEMBERS.description: libp2p peer IDs that belong to this group.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this group was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this group record was last updated.

METADATA.description: Additional group metadata as string key/value entries.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the group from the current registry.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this group record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the peer group record.

INPUTS.description:
Input frames. Each TAB.TYPE_REF names the payload schema and each
TAB.WIRE_FORMAT selects FLATBUFFER or ALIGNED_BINARY. TAB.OFFSET
is arena-relative into PAYLOAD_ARENA (or an absolute pointer when
PAYLOAD_ARENA is empty).

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description:
Optional arena backing the INPUTS payload bodies. Empty means the
caller manages arena state out-of-band.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace identifier for request correlation.

OUTPUT_STREAM_CAP.description:
Optional yield-budget hint. Plugins MAY pause queued work after
draining this many output frames and return YIELDED for the caller
to resume. 0 = no hint.

STATUS_CODE.description: Method-specific status code. Zero conventionally indicates success.

OK.description: Invocation completed; STATUS_CODE carries the method-specific value.

NOT_FOUND.description: Method id not registered on the target plugin.

YIELDED.description: Invocation succeeded but yielded before draining queued work. Caller should inspect BACKLOG_REMAINING and re-invoke to continue.

FAILED.description: Invocation failed; ERROR_CODE + ERROR_MESSAGE describe the failure.

YIELDED.description: True when the method yielded before fully draining queued work.

BACKLOG_REMAINING.description:
Outstanding frame count remaining after this response. Non-zero
only when STATUS == YIELDED.

OUTPUTS.description: Output frames. Each TAB carries schema identity and wire format.

PAYLOAD_ARENA.description: Optional arena backing OUTPUTS payload bodies.

ERROR_CODE.description: Stable machine-readable error code when STATUS == FAILED.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Human-readable diagnostic when STATUS == FAILED.

TRACE_ID.description: Echo of the request's TRACE_ID for correlation.

PIV.description:
Envelope — carries either a request or a response. Either REQUEST or
RESPONSE is populated per message; both populated is undefined.

PUBLISHER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the publisher `$EPM` that operates this broker

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: libp2p peer id of the publisher node hosting the broker

PROTOCOL_ID.description:
libp2p protocol the broker answers on
(e.g. "/space-data-network/module-delivery/1.0.0")

MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESSES.description: Dialable multiformat addresses for the broker

BROKER_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The broker's public key (from the key server's get_public_key) so the
buyer can pin it

SelfHosted.description: The publisher's own node hosts the broker and holds the content keys

StandbyReplica.description: A publisher-run replica sharing the wrapping key (custody stays with the publisher)

EscrowFallback.description: A third-party (e.g. platform-run) fallback broker able to release the content key for this module

Online.description: Broker answered the most recent probe/heartbeat window

Degraded.description: Heartbeats are late or intermittently failing

Unreachable.description: Broker failed probing; paid listings behind it are unpurchasable

LAST_HEARTBEAT_AT.description: Unix ms of the last successful probe/heartbeat

FIRST_SEEN_AT.description: Unix ms the store first saw this broker

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix ms this descriptor was last updated

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature by the publisher `$EPM` over the self-attested endpoint
fields; re-verified by the store's live probe

PLK.description:
Plugin License Key - Issued license for plugin access
Uses ECIES: both parties derive symmetric key via X25519 ECDH
Key derivation: X25519(private, peer_public) → HKDF-SHA256 → AES-256-GCM

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin ID this license is for

ISSUER_PUBKEY.description:
Issuer's X25519 public key (32 bytes)
Used with licensee's private key to derive shared secret via ECDH

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when license was issued

VALID_FROM.description: Unix timestamp when license becomes valid

EXPIRES_AT.description: Unix timestamp when license expires (0 = never expires)

ISSUER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the license issuer (OrbPro)

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from issuer over all fields (except SIGNATURE)

PMMTrustAnchor.description:
The single key identity every signature in this manifest resolves to, and
the two external anchors that give that key its weight: the DNS proof that
binds it to the domain, and the Adversarial-Security bond that prices
trust in it.

PROVIDER_DOMAIN.description:
Domain the node key is bound to. MUST equal `PMM.PROVIDER_DOMAIN` and
MUST equal the origin the manifest was fetched from.

NODE_PEER_ID.description: libp2p peer id of the provider node.

NODE_XPUB.description:
BIP-32 account xpub of the node identity, verbatim as advertised in the
node's `$EPM`.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Hex-encoded public key that verifies `PMM.SIGNATURE` and every
`PMMModuleEntry.ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE`, derived from the node key.

SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM.description:
Signature algorithm identifier, e.g. "ed25519",
"secp256k1-compact-ethereum". Empty means "ed25519".

EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the provider node's `$EPM`.

DNS_PROOF_RECORD_NAME.description:
Fully-qualified DNS name of the TXT record carrying the signed
domain-to-nodekey proof, e.g. "_sdnkey.example.org". A verifying client
resolves this itself (DNS-over-HTTPS) rather than trusting the copy
below.

DNS_PROOF_TXT.description:
Verbatim TXT value of that proof, carried only so a client can detect
disagreement with what DNS returns. The resolved record always wins.

DNS_PROOF_STATEMENT.description:
The canonical statement the DNS proof signs, verbatim, when the proof
format keeps it out of the TXT value.

BOND_ADDRESSES.description:
Chain addresses derived from this same node key that hold the provider's
Adversarial-Security bond. Each entry proves, through `ChainProof`, that
the address derives from the key that signed this manifest.

BOND_ATTESTATION_URL.description:
Optional URL of a machine-readable bond attestation (bonded value,
duration unspent) for clients that price trust rather than gate on it.

MODULE_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS module identity, e.g. "com.orbpro.sgp4-propagator". Stable
across versions. Required and unique within the manifest.

PLUGIN_ID.description:
`$PLG.PLUGIN_ID` of the full listing for this module, when one is
published.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the offered artifact.

EPOCH.description:
Monotonic publication counter for this MODULE_ID. Increases on every
re-publication, including a rebuild at the same VERSION.

CONTENT_HASH.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the module's
portable (pre-AOT, publication-trailer-stripped) WASM bytes. Identical
in meaning to `$APP.APPModuleRef.CONTENT_HASH`: this is the identity
capability and signature policies key on.

ARTIFACT_SIZE_BYTES.description: Size of those portable WASM bytes.

ARTIFACT_PATH.description:
Path, relative to the provider origin, from which the artifact is
fetched. Relative on purpose: the bytes must come from the same origin
whose domain the DNS proof binds.

ARTIFACT_CID.description: IPFS CID of the artifact, for content-addressed retrieval.

ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE.description:
Detached signature by the key in `PMMTrustAnchor.SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY`
over the 32 raw bytes of `CONTENT_HASH`. Lets a client reject an entry
before spending a byte of bandwidth. The artifact's own publication
trailer remains authoritative after download.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. Treated as OPTIONAL by verifiers.

CORE.description: The provider declares this module part of its baseline service. Only a CORE entry may ever be loaded before a user session exists, and only a CORE entry is presented pre-selected at first sign-in.

RECOMMENDED.description: Offered and endorsed by the provider, but never loaded without an explicit user selection.

DEFAULT_ENABLED.description:
True when the provider ships this module enabled by default. A recorded
user choice overrides it permanently.

ACCESS_POLICY.description: What the client must hold to fetch and run it.

ANONYMOUS.description: No session, no grant: an unauthenticated client may fetch and run it.

ENTITLED.description: An entitlement or license grant is required (see `$ENT`, `$PLK`).

DEPRECATED.description: Still served, superseded by another entry. Clients SHOULD migrate.

WITHDRAWN.description: No longer served. Clients MUST NOT fetch it.

REVOKED.description: Actively distrusted by the provider (compromise, bad build). Clients MUST refuse this CONTENT_HASH even if they already hold the bytes.

RUNTIME_TARGETS.description:
Opaque runtime-target tags this artifact is built for, e.g. "browser",
"wasmedge". Same vocabulary as `$PLG.RUNTIME_TARGETS`.

REQUIRED_SCHEMAS.description: SDS schema codes at this module's invoke surface, e.g. "OMM", "OEM".

MIN_PERMISSIONS.description:
Minimum host permissions the module needs, same vocabulary as
`$PLG.MIN_PERMISSIONS`. Surfaced so a client can show what an
anonymously-loaded CORE module is allowed to do.

LICENSE.description: SPDX license identifier of the module.

SUPERSEDES_CONTENT_HASH.description: `CONTENT_HASH` this entry replaces, when it supersedes an earlier build.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) of
the last change to this entry.

PLUGIN_TYPE.description:
Family this module belongs to. Mirrors `$PLG.PLUGIN_TYPE` verbatim and
is the ONLY sanctioned way to group an offering: a client grouping a
catalogue MUST read this field and MUST NOT infer family from the shape
of `MODULE_ID`, which carries no normative structure. Defaults to
`Unspecified`, which a client MUST render as ungrouped — never silently
as `Sensor`. Present here, rather than only on
the linked `$PLG`, so an anonymous client can section the catalogue at
boot without fetching one `$PLG` per module.

Shader.description: GLSL shader plugins for custom visualization

Parser.description: Parses raw upstream bytes into canonical SDS records

Exporter.description: Exports records to external formats (CSV, etc.)

Basilisk.description: DEPRECATED — owner law 2026-08-06 forbids vendor/org-derived names in a standard's vocabulary, and this member is one. Its ordinal is wire data and is therefore NEVER removed or reused, and renaming it in place would still be a breaking change for every published manifest; the sanctioned repair is to stop publishing it. Publishers MUST migrate to `PRIMARY_CATEGORY: PROPAGATION` (astrodynamics simulation and dynamics-modelling) and MUST NOT set `PLUGIN_TYPE: Basilisk` on new manifests. Consumers MUST render an existing record carrying it as `Propagation` and MUST NOT surface the member identifier in any user- facing label.

Maneuver.description: Maneuver planning, targeting and trajectory optimization

Flow.description: A composed flow published as a single loadable module. The unit is a graph of other modules, not a leaf algorithm.

Unspecified.description: No family stated. Sits at the end of the enum rather than at 0 because this enum is append-only and `Sensor` already holds 0; it exists so a record can distinguish "the provider did not say" from "Sensor". A consumer MUST render an `Unspecified` module as ungrouped, never as a member of any family.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified `$CCT` category this module is shelved under. Mirrors
`$PLG.PRIMARY_CATEGORY` verbatim and SUPERSEDES `PLUGIN_TYPE` as the
sanctioned way to group an offering: `pluginCategory` is single-valued,
holds a real family at ordinal 0, mixes capability families with
node-internal plumbing, and carries a deprecated vendor-derived member.
Present here, rather than only on the linked `$PLG`, so an anonymous
client can section the catalogue at boot without fetching one `$PLG` per
module. `UNSPECIFIED` MUST render as ungrouped, never as a real category.

SIGNATURE SEAM — normative. Under the `SDN-MODULE-MANIFEST-V1` canonical
statement this field is NOT covered by `PMM.SIGNATURE`, exactly like
`NAME`, `DESCRIPTION` and `ICON_URL`. It is an UNVERIFIED PROVIDER CLAIM
resting on a signed content hash. A consumer that shelves, filters or
counts by this field MUST NOT present the resulting grouping as
authenticated, and MUST keep the verified identity (`MODULE_ID`,
`CONTENT_HASH`, `ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE`, `TRUST_TIER`) visually separable
from provider-supplied presentation. Extending the canonical statement to
cover presentation fields is a `SDN-MODULE-MANIFEST-V2` change that moves
every verifier in lockstep and is not made implicitly by adopting this
field.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No capability class stated. The publisher did not classify the unit. A consumer MUST render an UNSPECIFIED unit as ungrouped and MUST NOT infer a class from the unit's name, description or tags. Display name: "Unspecified".

PROPAGATION.description: Advancing an object's state forward or backward in time under a force model, and interpolating between computed states. Display name: "Propagation".

ORBIT_DETERMINATION.description: Estimating an object's state or model parameters by fitting to observations or ephemerides. Display name: "Orbit Determination".

MANEUVER_PLANNING.description: Planning, targeting and optimizing trajectory changes, including station-keeping, transfers and collision-avoidance maneuvers. Display name: "Maneuver Planning".

CONJUNCTION_ASSESSMENT.description: Screening for close approaches between objects and quantifying collision probability and miss distance. Display name: "Conjunction Assessment".

ATTITUDE_AND_POINTING.description: Attitude determination and control, body orientation, and pointing or slew planning. Display name: "Attitude & Pointing".

REFERENCE_FRAMES_AND_TIME.description: Coordinate frame realization and transformation, time scale conversion, and earth-orientation parameter handling. Display name: "Reference Frames & Time".

SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE.description: Sensor modelling and tasking, field-of-regard and access computation, and area or target coverage figures of merit. Display name: "Sensors & Coverage".

TRACKING_AND_OBSERVATION.description: Producing, correlating or associating observations of tracked objects, and maintaining tracks from them. Display name: "Tracking & Observation".

ELECTRONIC_WARFARE.description: Interference, jamming, spoofing and countermeasure modelling. Display name: "Electronic Warfare".

SPACE_ENVIRONMENT.description: Atmospheric density, gravity field, magnetic field, radiation, solar and geomagnetic activity, and ionospheric modelling. Display name: "Space Environment".

DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST.description: Acquiring bytes from upstream providers and parsing or exporting them across canonical record formats. Display name: "Data Sources & Ingest".

DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY.description: Validating records for integrity, physical plausibility, continuity and schema conformance, and scoring data quality. Display name: "Data Validation & Quality".

CATALOG_AND_IDENTITY.description: Object catalogue curation, cross-identifier resolution, bus and physical property association, and entity identity. Display name: "Catalog & Identity".

VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING.description: Rendering, scene composition, shading and interactive display of space data. Display name: "Visualization & Rendering".

GROUND_SEGMENT_AND_HARDWARE.description: Ground station operation and control of physical equipment, including antenna rotators, radios and other hardware interfaces. Display name: "Ground Segment & Hardware".

MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS.description: Mission and constellation design, trade studies, performance analysis and report generation. Display name: "Mission Design & Analysis".

FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION.description: Composition of other units into a graph. The unit of distribution is a flow of modules, not a leaf algorithm. Display name: "Flows & Composition".

DATA_STORAGE_AND_QUERY.description: Persisting, indexing and querying records; storage engines and query surfaces. Display name: "Data Storage & Query".

SECURITY_AND_IDENTITY.description: Key custody, signing and verification, authentication, authorization and access control. Display name: "Security & Identity".

COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING.description: Listing, purchase, subscription, entitlement and license enforcement for distributed units. Display name: "Commerce & Licensing".

NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE.description: Node runtime, artifact delivery, registry, publication and peer transport plumbing. Display name: "Node Infrastructure".

FOUNDATION_AND_MATH.description: Foundational mathematics and general-purpose utility libraries consumed by other units rather than run on their own. Display name: "Foundation & Math".

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified `$CCT` category this module belongs to, for browse, filter
and per-category counting. Mirrors `$PLG.CATEGORIES`. If nonempty it MUST
include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Carries the same unsigned-claim caveat as

Provider Module Manifest — what one provider node offers, signed by that

Domain of the provider, e.g. "node.example.org". Required. MUST equal

TRUST.description: The key identity and its external anchors.

CANONICAL_URL.description: Canonical absolute URL this manifest is served from.

CREATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)
when the manifest was last signed.

EXPIRES_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ)

PNLPanel.description:
One flat panel of a macro model.

The reflection coefficients describe how incident radiation is disposed of:
SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY + DIFFUSE_REFLECTIVITY + ABSORPTIVITY should sum to
1 for a physically consistent panel. Producers SHOULD state the source of
the optical properties in the parent record's SOURCE field; a panel model
whose coefficients have no provenance is worse than none.

PANEL_ID.description: Stable panel identifier within the model.

NORMAL_X.description: Outward panel normal in the body frame, unit vector.

BODY_FIXED.description: Panel normal is fixed in the body frame.

SUN_TRACKING.description: Panel normal tracks the Sun (typical solar array).

BODY_TRACKING.description: Panel normal tracks the central body (typical nadir-pointing radiator or antenna face).

VELOCITY_TRACKING.description: Panel normal tracks the velocity direction.

SPECULAR_REFLECTIVITY.description: Fraction of incident radiation reflected specularly.

EMISSIVITY.description: Infrared emissivity of the panel surface.

INSTANTANEOUS_RERADIATION.description:
True when absorbed energy is re-radiated instantaneously (no thermal
lag). False means the consumer must model thermal inertia.

DRAG_COEFFICIENT.description: Panel drag coefficient, when the model is used for aerodynamic forces.

MATERIAL_NAME.description: Material name, for traceability back to a materials table.

PNL.description:
Panelled (box-wing) Spacecraft Macro Model — the surface geometry and
optical properties needed to compute non-conservative forces (solar
radiation pressure, atmospheric drag, thermal re-radiation) on one object.

This is deliberately NOT $VAM, $BUS or $PHY. $VAM ranks visual assets for
rendering and a render mesh is not a force model; $BUS/$OOD are descriptive
inventory; $PHY is simulation configuration (integration method, force-type
toggles). None of them carries per-panel area, normal, and optical
coefficients.

Epoch the model is valid at, ISO 8601. Mass and panel configuration

PRWInit.description:
Propagator initialization request — assigns TLE / OMM / Keplerian /
polynomial inputs to entity handles.

The actual per-entity source record is carried inline as raw bytes
tagged with SOURCE_KIND and, where useful, a SDS file_identifier.
Callers encode `OMM`, `OCM`, or a one-off Keplerian set and pass the
bytes verbatim; the propagator uses SOURCE_KIND to decide how to
consume them.

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to assign results to (same order as SOURCES[]).

SOURCES.description: Per-entity source records, encoded as SDS FlatBuffers.

MU.description: Gravitational parameter of the central body (km^3 / s^2).

RAAN.description: Right ascension of the ascending node (radians).

EPOCH.description: Epoch as Julian date.

NORAD_ID.description: NORAD catalog number parsed from the TLE.

OMM.description: Source is an OMM (CCSDS mean elements) FlatBuffer.

TLE.description: Source is a raw TLE line pair (3LE supported via NAME).

PPE.description: Source is a PPE (polynomial ephemeris) FlatBuffer.

KEPLERIAN.description: Source is a single classical Keplerian element set.

BYTES.description: Encoded source record as a FlatBuffer (consumed per KIND).

KEPLERIAN.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == KEPLERIAN.

TLE.description: Convenience inline form when KIND == TLE.

PRWBatchRequest.description:
Batch propagation request — propagate every entity in ENTITY_HANDLES[] to
EPOCH and write the result StateVector stream to OUTPUT_OFFSET in the
shared arena.

EPOCH.description: Target epoch as a Julian date (TIME_SYSTEM is configured on the host).

ENTITY_HANDLES.description: Entity handles to propagate (empty = all initialized entities).

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Output buffer offset in the arena where the StateVector stream begins.

MAX_COUNT.description: Maximum entities to process in this call (0 = unbounded).

TARGET_FRAME.description:
Target reference frame for the output state stream. Matches enum
values in SDS `RFM`. If zero, the propagator chooses its native frame.

PRWBatchResponse.description:
Batch propagation response header — describes the stream written to
OUTPUT_OFFSET and reports errors. The stream itself is
`STATE_VECTOR_SIZE`-tuple rows in the SDS `OCM` STATE_DATA layout.

OUTPUT_OFFSET.description: Offset in the arena where the state-vector stream begins.

STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.description: Components per state vector (6 = PV, 9 = PVA). Mirrors OCM.STATE_VECTOR_SIZE.

INVALID_EPOCH.description: Invalid epoch (NaN, out of range, before earliest init epoch, etc.).

OUTPUT_BUFFER_OVERFLOW.description: Output buffer too small for the requested count.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description: Optional error message when ERROR_CODE != OK.

QEM.description:
Query Encoder Model.

One QEM publishes the pruned static token-embedding table a lightweight
client (e.g. a browser) loads to encode a search query into the same
vector space a paired $CES shard's rows live in, without shipping a full
transformer. A consumer pools the rows of the query's tokens (per
POOLING_METHOD) into a query vector, then dot-products it against
CES.ROWS.

A QEM is compatible with a CES only when MODEL_ID, MODEL_VERSION,
MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256, POOLING_METHOD and TEMPLATE_VERSION all match; a
mismatch on any one means the two vector spaces are not comparable.

MODEL_ID.description: Encoder model identifier/name. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_ID.

MODEL_VERSION.description: Encoder model version. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_VERSION.

MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the encoder weights, lowercase hex. Same convention as
DPMAsset.BYTE_SHA256. Compared verbatim against CES.MODEL_WEIGHTS_SHA256.

POOLING_METHOD.description:
Sentence/document pooling method the encoder uses. Compared verbatim
against CES.POOLING_METHOD.

TEMPLATE_VERSION.description:
Version of the text template documents were rendered from before
encoding. Compared verbatim against CES.TEMPLATE_VERSION.

DIMENSIONS.description: Fixed embedding dimensionality; must equal the paired CES.DIMENSIONS.

ENCODING.description: Row element encoding used across TOKENS.

VOCAB_SIZE.description: Number of tokens in the pruned vocabulary.

TOKENS.description: One row per pruned vocabulary token.

SBM.description:
Satellite Breakup Model

One SBM record is a single on-orbit fragmentation event — an explosion or
a collision — together with the debris population a breakup model produced
for it. It carries the model inputs (parent states, masses, relative
velocity, object class, cutoff, seed) so the population is reproducible,
and the resulting fragments in FRAGMENTS.

Units on the wire: parent and fragment position are KILOMETERS, parent and
fragment velocity are KILOMETERS PER SECOND (matching $OMM, $OEM, $OCM and
$CDM state conventions); ejection delta-V, relative velocity and
characteristic length are METERS PER SECOND and METERS respectively
(matching the breakup-model literature). Every field name states its unit.

This record describes an ON-ORBIT breakup. Atmospheric reentry breakup and
demise stay in $RDM/$REM; a business-loss classification of the event stays
in $OOE.

SHC.description:
Spherical-Harmonic Coefficient Set — an actual gravity field, as opposed to
the NAME of one.

This is deliberately NOT $GRV. $GRV is a model SELECTOR: it names a model,
bounds its degree/order, toggles third-body and tidal effects, and carries
scalar J2..J6. It cannot carry a coefficient set, and a named model without
its coefficients is not interchange — it is a citation.

Coefficients are carried as four parallel arrays of equal length, indexed
together: entry i is the coefficient at DEGREES[i], ORDERS[i] with cosine
term C[i] and sine term S[i]. Parallel arrays rather than a table per
coefficient because a 200x200 field is ~40,000 coefficients and a
table-per-coefficient encoding is pathological in both size and decode cost.

community lane; the record-level POSITION_AUTHORITY states which class the
PUBLISHED coordinate came from.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The publisher does not state how the position was established. POSITION AUTHORITY defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a regulator's coordinate.

REGULATOR_PUBLISHED.description: A spectrum regulator or licensing administration publishes the coordinate in its own licence or assignment record.

COORDINATION_FILING.description: An international frequency coordination register or notification filing carries the coordinate.

LICENSEE_PUBLISHED.description: The licensee or facility operator publishes the coordinate itself.

SURVEYED_INDEPENDENT.description: The coordinate was surveyed or measured on site by a party independent of the licensee.

DERIVED_FROM_IMAGERY.description: The coordinate was read off imagery or a mapping product by the publisher or a cited source.

INFERRED_FROM_OBSERVATION.description: The coordinate is the result of radio direction finding, time- or frequency-difference-of-arrival geolocation, or another observation-based fix. The fused solution itself belongs in `$GEL`.

COMMUNITY_ASSERTED.description: The coordinate is asserted by an observer community or an enthusiast compilation with no regulator, licensee or survey behind it. It is publishable and it is never interchangeable with a licence coordinate.

COMMUNITY_ASSERTED_HISTORICAL.description: A community assertion the sources themselves report as superseded — the facility is believed to have moved, and the coordinate describes where it formerly stood.

UNDISCLOSED.description: The facility is documented to exist and no party publishes a position at all. LATITUDE and LONGITUDE are ABSENT in this case; they are never filled with a region centroid.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this source reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the source was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This source's report materially contributed to the published record.
False marks a source that was consulted and either returned nothing or
was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TXSConsensus.description:
How one facility's independent source reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

Agreement is CORROBORATION and is never authority: five compilations that
copied one another agree perfectly and establish nothing. Read this table
beside POSITION_AUTHORITY, never instead of it.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The publisher does not state how the reports were reduced. METHOD defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a real method.

SINGLE_SOURCE.description: Exactly one source reported the facility; nothing was reconciled.

AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE.description: A declared precedence ranking over publishing authorities selected the winning report.

MOST_RECENT.description: The report with the most recent publication or observation window won.

HIGHEST_SAMPLE_COUNT.description: The report backed by the largest independent observation count won.

CENTROID.description: The published position is computed from the agreeing reports and belongs to no single source.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Sources queried for this facility, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

PROVIDERS_DISAGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell OUTSIDE that threshold and were not
reconciled. Non-zero is the machine-readable form of a contested
position and is published alongside POSITION_DISPUTED.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single source.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
source's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TXSPriorPosition.description:
A position the facility is asserted to have occupied and vacated, retained
so a relocation never silently rewrites history.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
Class of authority behind THIS coordinate, which is frequently weaker
than the authority behind the current one.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
One-sigma-equivalent horizontal envelope in metres, as the source states

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds over which the facility is asserted to have occupied
this position. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

PROVIDER_ID.description: PROVIDER_ID of the SOURCES entry asserting this position.

TXSEmission.description:
One documented emission of one facility: a carrier or channel the facility
is stated to radiate, with the power and antenna terms published for it.

A facility radiating many carriers carries many entries; a facility whose
frequency changes by season or hour carries the documented set here and the
time-bounded usage in `$STX`. Unknown terms are ABSENT.

EMISSION_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this emission within its facility record.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned or nominal centre frequency in kilohertz. Kilohertz is the base
unit for this family because it spans the low-frequency broadcasting
allocations to the microwave allocations without unit switching; a
consumer joining to `$RFB` or `$TBS`, which carry megahertz, or to
`$IQC`, which carries hertz, converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means
unpublished.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz as the source states it.
Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim, e.g. the necessary-bandwidth and
class-of-emission string a licence record carries. Authoritative over
MODULATION whenever both are present.

SERVICE.description: Service class of THIS emission when it differs from the facility's.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no service class. Every service field defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a real class.

LONG_WAVE_BROADCAST.description: Sound broadcasting on the low-frequency broadcasting allocations.

MEDIUM_WAVE_BROADCAST.description: Sound broadcasting on the medium-frequency broadcasting allocations.

SHORT_WAVE_BROADCAST.description: Sound broadcasting on the high-frequency broadcasting allocations, including transmissions directed at audiences outside the transmitting administration.

FM_SOUND_BROADCAST.description: Frequency-modulated sound broadcasting on the very-high-frequency broadcasting allocations.

TELEVISION_BROADCAST.description: Terrestrial television broadcasting, analogue or digital.

MILITARY_FIXED.description: Fixed service operated by or for an armed service.

UTILITY_FIXED.description: Fixed service operated by a non-broadcast, non-military user for its own operational traffic.

AERONAUTICAL.description: Aeronautical mobile or aeronautical fixed service.

MARITIME.description: Maritime mobile or maritime fixed service.

PUBLIC_SAFETY_LAND_MOBILE.description: Land mobile service supporting emergency response and public protection.

LAND_MOBILE_PRIVATE.description: Land mobile service operated by a private or commercial user.

AMATEUR.description: Amateur service, including unattended propagation beacons.

RADIONAVIGATION.description: Radionavigation service, including terrestrial hyperbolic and non-directional navigation aids.

RADIOLOCATION.description: Radiolocation service, including over-the-horizon and surface-wave installations.

SPACE_OPERATIONS_UPLINK.description: Space operations, space research or satellite feeder-link earth-station transmission from a terrestrial facility.

EXPERIMENTAL.description: Service authorized for experiment or development.

OTHER.description: The source states a service this enum does not model. The source's own term is retained verbatim in the provenance entry, never discarded.

EFFECTIVE_RADIATED_POWER_KW.description:
Effective radiated power referenced to a half-wave dipole, kilowatts.

EIRP_KW.description:
Equivalent isotropically radiated power, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Published alongside, never instead of, the dipole-referenced
figure: the two differ by the dipole gain and this standard never
converts between them.

ANTENNA_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Antenna centre of radiation above ground level, metres. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing, degrees clockwise from true north. Absent for a
non-directional emission; a non-directional emission is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL, never by a bearing of zero.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The emission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

BEAMWIDTH_DEG.description: Half-power beamwidth in degrees. Zero means unpublished.

ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description:
Antenna gain in decibels referenced to an isotropic radiator. Zero means
unpublished; a real 0 dBi figure is published as a source term in
provenance rather than being indistinguishable from absence.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this emission, verbatim: a callsign, a
spoken or keyed identifier, or the identity string the source publishes.
Never synthesized.

OPERATIONAL.description: Radiating on a regular or continuous basis.

INTERMITTENT.description: Radiating irregularly or only for part of the year.

SILENT.description: Licensed and standing, but not currently radiating.

DECOMMISSIONED.description: Authorization withdrawn or surrendered; structure may still stand.

PLANNED.description: Authorized or announced, not yet radiating.

RELOCATED.description: Sources agree the operation moved to a different facility.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds of the authorization or documented use of this
emission. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this facility, unique within its record
set. Never a source's own identifier and never a coordinate string.

NATIVE_ID.description:
Winning source's native facility identifier, copied verbatim from the
SOURCES entry named by CONSENSUS.WINNING_PROVIDER_ID. Never a substitute
for ID and never stable across sources.

SITE_NAME.description:
Facility or structure name verbatim when a source publishes one. Never
synthesized from coordinates, licensee, or nearest settlement.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification the facility as a whole answers to, verbatim: a
callsign, an assigned station identifier, or the identifier an observer
community records. Per-emission identity lives in
EMISSIONS[].STATION_IDENTITY.

LICENSEE.description:
Licensee, operator or responsible administration name verbatim as the
cited source states it. A display name, never an identifier: consumers
must not treat it as a stable key.

LICENSE_ID.description: Licence, assignment or authorization identifier verbatim.

SERVICE.description:
Primary service class of the facility. Individual emissions may state
their own.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no service class. Every service field defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a real class.

ADMIN_AREA.description: Administrative subdivision or locality verbatim as the source states it.

LATITUDE.description:

a region centroid is never substituted. Per-source positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

a position without reading this field is rendering an unlabelled claim.

UNDISCLOSED.description: The facility is documented to exist and no party publishes a position at all. LATITUDE and LONGITUDE are ABSENT in this case; they are never filled with a region centroid.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description:
Horizontal envelope in metres within which the facility is asserted to
lie, as the publisher states it. Zero means unpublished — never that the
position is exact.

POSITION_DISPUTED.description:
Credible consulted sources place the facility in materially different
locations, or a source states the position is contested. The published
coordinate remains the publisher's best merge; this flag forbids a
consumer from presenting it as settled.

PRIOR_POSITIONS.description: Positions the facility is asserted to have vacated, most recent first.

GROUND_ELEVATION_AMSL_M.description:
Ground elevation at the facility, metres above mean sea level as the
source states it. Zero means unpublished.

STRUCTURE_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Overall height of the antenna-supporting structure above ground level,
metres. Distinct from any emission's antenna height. Zero means
unpublished.

STRUCTURE_COUNT.description:
Number of antenna-supporting structures at the facility. Zero means
unpublished.

EMISSIONS.description: Every emission the facility is documented to radiate.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the documentation or observation
window backing the published record.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this facility, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a facility with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:
How the entries in SOURCES were reduced to the published position.
Required: a published position always states the rule that produced it,
including SINGLE_SOURCE.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this schedule row, unique within its
record set.

SITE_ID.description:
`$TXS`.ID of the facility radiating this transmission. ABSENT when the
originating facility is unidentified or disputed; a row is publishable
without one and a consumer must not fabricate a join.

SITE_NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the transmitting facility, verbatim —
a register site code or a compilation's site abbreviation. Retained so a
row whose SITE_ID could not be resolved is still traceable.

STATION_NAME.description:
Station or service name verbatim as the source states it. A display name,
never an identifier.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this transmission, verbatim: a
callsign, a keyed or spoken identifier, or the identity string the source
publishes. Never synthesized and never inferred from frequency.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned frequency in kilohertz, following the `$TXS` convention. Zero
means unpublished; a row whose frequency is unpublished is a facility
record, not a schedule row.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz when the source states one
for this transmission. Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim. Authoritative over MODULATION whenever
both are present.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no service class. Every service field defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a real class.

RADIONAVIGATION.description: Radionavigation service, including terrestrial hyperbolic and non-directional navigation aids.

RADIOLOCATION.description: Radiolocation service, including over-the-horizon and surface-wave installations.

EXPERIMENTAL.description: Service authorized for experiment or development.
