SOUND_PROGRAMME.description: Sound programming intended for a general audience.

DIGITAL_MULTIPLEX.description: Digitally multiplexed data or sound carriage.

BEACON_OR_MARKER.description: Continuous or intermittent carrier radiated for identification, propagation assessment or channel marking, with no programme content.

FORMATTED_NUMERIC_OR_VOICE.description: Keyed or spoken sequences of letters, digits or words with no published meaning, radiated on a fixed frequency by an unidentified or non-broadcast user.

SERVICE_BULLETIN.description: Meteorological, navigational or safety broadcast to a service.

OTHER.description: The source states a content class this enum does not model. The source's own term is retained verbatim in the provenance entry.

TIME_START_UTC.description:
Daily on-air window in Coordinated Universal Time, as four decimal digits
"HHMM". A window whose stop is not later than its start crosses midnight
and is read as continuing into the following day. Strings because the
register form is four digits with significant leading zeros and no date;
an integer would invite a consumer to treat 0000 as absence.

DAYS.description:
Days on which the window runs. An unset field means the source publishes
no day pattern.

IRREGULAR.description:
The transmission runs without a fixed daily window — as required, on
occurrence, or continuously. TIME_START_UTC and TIME_STOP_UTC are absent
in that case and are never filled with 0000/2400 to stand in for it.

VALID_FROM.description:
RFC 3339 UTC bounds over which this row is valid — the seasonal or
licence period. Either bound is absent when unpublished.

SEASON.description:
The source's own name for the validity period, verbatim: a season code, a
schedule edition, or a period label. Never parsed into VALID_FROM by this
standard.

TARGET_AREA.description:
Target area verbatim as the source states it, including its own zone or
region notation.

TARGET_ZONES.description:
Individual target zone identifiers verbatim when the source publishes a
list, one entry per zone, in source order.

TRANSMITTER_POWER_KW.description:
Transmitter output power for this transmission, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing for this transmission, degrees clockwise from true
north. Absent for a non-directional transmission, which is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL and never by a bearing of zero.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_SECONDARY_DEG.description:
Secondary lobe bearing when the source publishes a slewed or dual-beam
antenna, degrees clockwise from true north.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The transmission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

ANTENNA_DESIGNATION.description:
Antenna designation verbatim as the source states it — a curtain-array
code, an antenna number, or a pattern identifier.

EMISSION_ID.description:
`$TXS`.EMISSIONS[].EMISSION_ID this row exercises, when the facility
record enumerates it.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The publisher does not state where the row came from. AUTHORITY defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a coordination register.

COORDINATION_REGISTER.description: An international frequency coordination register or seasonal requirement-notification process carries the row.

REGULATOR_PUBLISHED.description: A spectrum regulator or licensing administration publishes the row.

BROADCASTER_PUBLISHED.description: The broadcaster, operator or licensee publishes its own schedule.

MONITORING_OBSERVATION.description: A monitoring service or organized observation programme logged the transmission and published the row from what it heard.

COMMUNITY_COMPILED.description: An observer community or enthusiast compilation asserts the row with no register, regulator or broadcaster behind it.

REGISTERED.description: Registered or announced for the stated period.

ACTIVE.description: Registered and confirmed on the air within the stated period.

PROVISIONAL.description: Registered subject to coordination, or announced provisionally.

UNCONFIRMED.description: Documented but not heard within the period observers cover.

INACTIVE.description: Registered and stated to be off the air for the period.

CANCELLED.description: Withdrawn before or during the period.

OBSERVED_ONLY.description: Known only from observation; no registration is claimed.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the observation window backing
the row, when observers rather than a register established it.

OBSERVATION_COUNT.description:
Independent observation reports behind the row. Zero means the source
publishes no count, never that the transmission was never heard.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this row, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a schedule row with no named sources is not
publishable. The provenance table is the one this family already
publishes in `$TXS`; a schedule row and a facility carry provenance of
the same shape and are frequently reconciled from the same fetch.

Erc20Allowance.description: ERC-20 allowance the settlement contract draws per period

ReAuthorizePerPeriod.description: No standing authorization; the buyer re-authorizes each period

CHAIN_SETTLEMENT.description: Settlement descriptor (chain, splitter, token) that charges each period

AMOUNT_PER_PERIOD.description: Charge per period in the smallest unit of CURRENCY

NEXT_CHARGE_AT.description: Unix ms of the next scheduled charge

MAX_PERIODS.description: Maximum number of periods; 0 = until cancelled

Paused.description: Temporarily paused by the buyer or store

Cancelled.description: Cancelled by the buyer; no further charges

Lapsed.description: A scheduled charge failed / authorization expired

SIGNATURE.description: Buyer's Ed25519 authorization signature over the terms

TBSProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for ONE provider's report of ONE site.

Every provider consulted gets its own entry, including providers that
returned nothing, so a consumer can tell "not looked for" from "looked for
and returned nothing". Provider identity is DATA: PROVIDER_ID and AUTHORITY
carry verbatim what that provider states about itself. The standard names
no provider, dataset, or site.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the consulted provider,
unique within the publisher's own provider registry. Never a display
name and never a URL.

AUTHORITY.description:
The authority under which that provider publishes, verbatim as the
provider states it: a spectrum regulator, a network operator, a
crowd-sourced observation programme, or a research dataset. Never
inferred by the publisher.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or request parameters used, so the same rows can
be recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed site whose terms are unstated. A provider that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that provider publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This provider's own row, cell, or site identifier, verbatim.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this provider reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the provider was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This provider's report materially contributed to the published CONSENSUS
position. False marks a provider that was consulted and either returned
nothing or was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TBSConsensus.description:
How one site's independent provider reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

SINGLE_SOURCE.description: Exactly one provider reported the site; nothing was reconciled.

HIGHEST_SAMPLE_COUNT.description: The report backed by the largest independent observation count won.

MOST_RECENT.description: The report with the most recent observation window won.

AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE.description: A declared precedence ranking over publishing authorities selected the winning report, regardless of sample count or recency.

CENTROID.description: The published position is computed from the agreeing reports and belongs to no single provider.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The publisher does not state how the reports were reduced. METHOD defaults here so an unset field can never be read as SINGLE_SOURCE, which holds ordinal 0.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Providers queried for this site, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Providers whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single provider.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
provider's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TBS.description:
Terrestrial Base Station Site.

One record describes ONE terrestrial cellular base-station site as
reconciled from every provider the publisher consulted. It is the wire
record for terrestrial mobile-network infrastructure, and it is not an
emitter model ($RFE), a band specification ($RFB), a geodetic tracking
station ($GST), a satellite ground station ($SIT), or an observation.

A site cannot be re-serialized unattributed. SOURCES and CONSENSUS are both
required, so every published position carries the providers it came from and
the rule that reconciled them; a consumer that strips attribution has to
leave the standard to do it. Unknown values are ABSENT — never zero, never a
placeholder, never carried across from a neighbouring site.

Identity is ID, the publisher's own. The network addressing fields are the
mobile network's, are assigned by its operator, and are reused worldwide;
none of them is a global key on its own.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this site, unique within its record set.
Recommended form: "<mcc>-<mnc>-<area-code>-<cell-id>".

NATIVE_ID.description:
Winning provider's native site identifier, copied verbatim from the
SOURCES entry named by CONSENSUS.WINNING_PROVIDER_ID. Never a substitute
for ID and never stable across providers.

OTHER.description: An access technology the source names but this enum does not model. The source's own term is retained in the provenance entry, never discarded.

UNKNOWN.description: The source publishes no access technology. RADIO defaults here so an unset field can never be read as GSM, which holds ordinal 0.

MCC.description:
Mobile country code from the international mobile-subscriber identity
numbering plan. Zero means the source published none.

MNC.description:
Mobile network code within MCC. Carried as an integer, so decimal leading
zeros are NOT preserved: a two- versus three-digit network code is
distinguished by the numbering plan of MCC, and the source's own text is
retained verbatim in TBSProvenance.NATIVE_ID. Zero means unpublished.

LAC.description:
Location area code, used by GSM-, CDMA- and UMTS-class access. Zero means
unpublished. A site published with a location area code does not also
carry a tracking area code; publishing both asserts two access
generations for one cell.

TAC.description:
Tracking area code, used by LTE- and NR-class access. Zero means
unpublished.

CELL_ID.description:
Cell identity verbatim from the source. A string because width, radix and
leading zeros are significant and differ by access class: a 16-bit cell
identity, a 28-bit evolved cell identity and a 36-bit new-radio cell
identity are not interchangeable integers, and this field never converts
between them.

LATITUDE.description:
Reconciled site position in decimal degrees on WGS 84, produced by the
merge described in CONSENSUS. Per-provider positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

RANGE_M.description:
Radius in metres of the area within which the site's observations were
collected — a positional-uncertainty envelope, not a transmission range,
not a coverage guarantee, and never converted from another unit. Zero
means unpublished.

SAMPLES.description:
Independent observations behind the winning report. Zero means the source
publishes no observation count, never that the site was never observed.

AVERAGE_SIGNAL_DBM.description:
Mean received signal strength in dBm across those observations, as the
source publishes it. Carried in dBm unconverted; a consumer needing watts
converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means unpublished.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the observation window backing
the winning report.

OPERATOR.description:
Network operator name verbatim as the cited source states it. A display
name, never an identifier: consumers must not treat it as a stable key.

FREQUENCY_MHZ.description:
Operating centre frequency in MHz, following the $RFB convention. A
consumer joining to $IQC, which carries hertz, converts at the join,
explicitly. Zero means unpublished.

SITE_NAME.description:
Site or structure name verbatim when the source publishes one. Never
synthesized from coordinates, operator, or cell identity.

COUNTRY_CODE.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.
Derived from MCC only when the source itself derives it.

SOURCES.description:
Every provider consulted for this site, including providers that returned
nothing. Required: a site with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:
How the entries in SOURCES were reduced to LATITUDE/LONGITUDE. Required:
a published position always states the rule that produced it, including
SINGLE_SOURCE.

TDMTransmitRamp.description:
One uplink transmitter frequency ramp applying over a closed time interval.

SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1: the base standard carries a single
TRANSMIT_FREQ_1 per segment, which cannot express a ramped uplink. Deep-space
radiometric archives carry an explicit ramp table and the Doppler observables
are NOT reconstructible without it. Ramps are optional; a record that omits
TRANSMIT_RAMPS is exactly a CCSDS-conformant TDM.

Frequency over the interval is the linear polynomial
f(t) = FREQUENCY_HZ + FREQUENCY_RATE_HZ_PER_S * (t - REFERENCE_TIME)
which is the common form of the two archive representations: DSN ODF
(TRK-2-18, table 3-5) supplies ramp start frequency, ramp rate, and ramp
start/end time, so REFERENCE_TIME equals START_TIME; ESA IFMS supplies a
ramp reference time with constant and linear transmission-frequency terms,
so REFERENCE_TIME is that reference time and may precede START_TIME.
Producers MUST set REFERENCE_TIME explicitly rather than letting a consumer
assume which convention was used.

START_TIME.description: Start of the interval over which this ramp applies, ISO 8601.

END_TIME.description: End of the interval over which this ramp applies, ISO 8601.

REFERENCE_TIME.description: Epoch at which FREQUENCY_HZ is the instantaneous value, ISO 8601.

FREQUENCY_RATE_HZ_PER_S.description: Constant ramp rate over the interval, Hz per second.

TRANSMITTING_STATION_ID.description:
Identifier of the transmitting station the ramp applies to. Must match
the PARTICIPANT_n naming used by the segment when both are present.

TRANSMIT_BAND.description:
Uplink band the ramp applies to, using the same vocabulary as
TRANSMIT_BAND (e.g. "S", "X", "Ka", "Ku").

OBSERVER_ID.description: Unique identifier for the observation OBSERVER -  [Specific CCSDS Document]

OBSERVER_X.description: Cartesian X coordinate of the OBSERVER location in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_Y.description: Cartesian Y coordinate of the OBSERVER location in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_Z.description: Cartesian Z coordinate of the OBSERVER location in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_VX.description: Cartesian X coordinate of the OBSERVER velocity in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_VY.description: Cartesian Y coordinate of the OBSERVER velocity in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_VZ.description: Cartesian Z coordinate of the OBSERVER velocity in chosen reference frame

OBSERVER_POSITION_REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame used for OBSERVER location Cartesian coordinates (e.g., ECEF, ECI)

OBS_REFERENCE_FRAME.description: Reference frame used for obs location Cartesian coordinates (e.g., ECEF, ECI)

EPOCH.description: Epoch time or observation time, in ISO 8601 UTC format -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1

OBSERVATION_STEP_SIZE.description:
Time interval between observations in seconds (required).
Time reconstruction: time[i] = OBSERVATION_START_TIME + (i * OBSERVATION_STEP_SIZE)

OBSERVATION_START_TIME.description: Start time for observation time reconstruction (ISO 8601 UTC format).

CCSDS_TDM_VERS.description: TDM version number -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

COMMENT.description: Comments regarding TDM -  various sections, e.g., Page D-9

CREATION_DATE.description: Date of TDM creation -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

ORIGINATOR.description: Originator of the TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

META_START.description: Start of metadata section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

TIME_SYSTEM.description: Time system used -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

START_TIME.description: Start time of the data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

STOP_TIME.description: Stop time of the data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PARTICIPANT_1.description: First participant in the TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PARTICIPANT_2.description: Second participant in the TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PARTICIPANT_3.description: Third participant in the TDM (if applicable) -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PARTICIPANT_4.description: Fourth participant in the TDM (if applicable) -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PARTICIPANT_5.description: Fifth participant in the TDM (if applicable) -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9, max participants

MODE.description: Mode of TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PATH_1.description: First path in TDM -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

PATH_2.description: Second path in TDM (if applicable) -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

RECEIVE_DELAY_2.description: Receive delay for second participant -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

RECEIVE_DELAY_3.description: Receive delay for third participant -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

META_STOP.description: End of metadata section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

DATA_START.description: Start of data section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

TRANSMIT_FREQ_1.description: Transmit frequency for first participant -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

DATA_STOP.description: End of data section -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-9

TIMETAG_REF.description:
Additional properties as required by the specific application of the TDM...
Reference for time tagging -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-10

ANGLE_TYPE.description:
Type of angle data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12
Can be AZEL, RADEC, XEYN, XSYE, or another value with provided ICD

ANGLE_1.description: First angle value -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

ANGLE_2.description: Second angle value -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

RANGE_RATE.description: Rate of change of range -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1

RANGE_MODE.description: Mode of range data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-10

RANGE_MODULUS.description: Modulus value for range data -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-10

CORRECTION_ANGLE_1.description: First correction angle -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

CORRECTION_ANGLE_2.description: Second correction angle -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

CORRECTIONS_APPLIED.description: Indicator of corrections applied -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-12

TROPO_DRY.description: Dry component of tropospheric delay -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-14

TROPO_WET.description: Wet component of tropospheric delay -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-14

STEC.description: Slant total electron content -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-13

CLOCK_BIAS.description: Clock bias values -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-15

CLOCK_DRIFT.description: Clock drift values -  CCSDS 503.0-B-1, Page D-15

SIGNAL_TO_NOISE.description:
SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1. Open-loop (non-coherent) Doppler
quality metrics, one entry per observation, parallel to the other
observation arrays and reconstructed on the same OBSERVATION_START_TIME +
i * OBSERVATION_STEP_SIZE grid.

Signal-to-noise ratio of the detection.

SPECTRAL_MAX.description: SDS EXTENSION. Normalised spectral maximum of the detection.

DOPPLER_NOISE_HZ.description:
SDS EXTENSION. 1-sigma noise on the measured Doppler frequency, Hz. The
measured sky frequency itself is carried by RECEIVE_FREQ; this is its
uncertainty, which CCSDS 503.0-B-1 has no field for.

TRANSMIT_RAMPS.description:
SDS EXTENSION beyond CCSDS 503.0-B-1. Uplink transmitter frequency ramp
table covering this segment, ordered by START_TIME and non-overlapping.
Required in practice for ramped uplinks, where TRANSMIT_FREQ_1 alone
cannot reconstruct the observables. Absent for unramped tracking, which
leaves the record exactly CCSDS-conformant.

TFNDesignator.description: One designator the facility answers to in a named coding system.

SCHEME.description:
Coding-system token, verbatim (the system's own name). Never a field
name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The designator within that system, verbatim.

TFNOperatingSurface.description:
One operating surface: the arrival/departure geometry of the facility.
A runway and a berth carry the same shape; fields a domain does not use
are absent (NaN), never zero.

SURFACE_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier of this surface within the facility.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no kind, or one this enum does not model; the source's own token, when there is one, rides in SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.

RUNWAY.description: A runway, including water runways at seaplane bases.

HELIPAD.description: A helipad or other vertical-operations pad.

BERTH.description: A berth a vessel moors alongside.

LAUNCH_PAD.description: A launch or landing pad at a spaceport.

SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.description:
The source's own surface-kind token, verbatim, so a kind outside
tfnSurfaceKind survives a round trip.

DESIGNATOR.description:
Published designator of the surface, verbatim (runway designator,
berth number).

DEPTH_M.description: Available depth of water, metres, for a maritime surface.

SURFACE_MATERIAL.description: Surface material or construction, verbatim as the source states it.

TRUE_BEARING_DEG.description: True bearing of the surface's operating direction, degrees, [0, 360).

THRESHOLD_LATITUDE.description:
Geodetic position of the threshold or reference point of this
surface, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

TFNProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one facility record.

Required on every record: a redistributed facility whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no
dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the dataset this facility
was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset registry.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
facility was decoded from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description: The source dataset's own identifier for this facility, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description: RFC 3339 UTC date the source last modified this row, as it states.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this facility record.

PLACE_ID.description:
`$GNP.ID` of the gazetteer place carrying this facility's name set
and location. Location is joined, never re-published here.

NAME.description:
Operational display name, verbatim, when it differs from the place
name in `$GNP`.

DESIGNATORS.description: Every designator the facility answers to, scheme-tagged.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

ELEVATION_M.description:
Field or reference elevation, metres above mean sea level as the
source publishes it. Zero means unpublished, never sea level; a
facility at sea level is distinguished by ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.

MAGNETIC_VARIATION_DEG.description:
Magnetic variation at the facility, degrees, positive east, as the
source publishes it. NaN when unpublished.

OPERATING_SURFACES.description: The operating surfaces of the facility.

MAXIMUM_DRAFT_M.description: Maximum vessel draft the facility accepts, metres.

ANCHORAGE_DEPTH_M.description: Depth of water at the principal anchorage, metres.

HARBOR_TYPE.description: Harbor type token, verbatim as the source publishes it.

SHELTER_AFFORDED.description: Shelter afforded token, verbatim as the source publishes it.

MULTI_SOURCE.description: True if fused from multiple sources

TRACK_COMPONENTS.description: Number of components per point (default 3 for X, Y, Z)

ECEF_POS.description: ECEF position as flat array [X0, Y0, Z0, X1, Y1, Z1, ...]

ECEF_VEL.description: ECEF velocity as flat array [VX0, VY0, VZ0, VX1, VY1, VZ1, ...]

ECEF_ACC.description: ECEF acceleration as flat array [AX0, AY0, AZ0, AX1, AY1, AZ1, ...]

LC_POS.description: Local coordinate position as flat array

LC_VEL.description: Local coordinate velocity as flat array

LC_ACC.description: Local coordinate acceleration as flat array

COV.description: Covariance data (21 elements per point for 6x6 lower triangular)

ERR_ELLP.description: Error ellipse data (6 elements per point)

TMSModelParameter.description:
One parameter of the propagation model, stated by name so a model
registry can evolve without schema change.

NAME.description: Parameter name within the MODEL_ID model's own registry, verbatim.

UNITS.description:
Units of VALUE, verbatim. Required: a unitless parameter states so
explicitly (e.g. "1").

TMSIdentifier.description: One identity the track is known by in a named identity scheme.

SCHEME.description:
Identity scheme token, verbatim (the identity system's own name).
Never a field name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The identifier within that scheme, verbatim.

TMSProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one track model state.

Required on every record: a redistributed track whose feed, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no feed,
provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the feed or dataset this
state was derived from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The feed or dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the feed or dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition or feed
session this state was derived from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or subscription used.

RETRIEVED_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond retrieval timestamp of the observation
this state was updated from.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the track or observation stream this
state was derived from, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant the source last modified or emitted the
underlying observation, as the source states it.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this state record.

TRACK_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the track this state belongs to, held
constant across every state update of the same track.

ENVIRONMENT.description:
Domain the track moves in. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0
is SPACE, so a publisher MUST set this field — it is defaulted to
UNKNOWN explicitly so an unset field can never be read as SPACE.

EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch this state is valid at. The
propagation origin: every kinematic field below is stated at EPOCH.

LATITUDE.description: Latitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive north.

LONGITUDE.description: Longitude, decimal degrees on WGS 84, positive east, in [-180, 180].

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Altitude, metres above the WGS 84 ellipsoid. NaN for a surface track
whose source publishes no altitude.

GROUND_SPEED_MPS.description: Speed over ground, metres per second.

VELOCITY_NORTH_MPS.description:
Velocity components, metres per second, local NED-derived axes:
north, east, and up. Published when the source or filter resolves
them; NaN otherwise.

HEADING_DEG.description: Heading, degrees true, [0, 360): the direction the vehicle points.

COURSE_DEG.description: Course over ground, degrees true, [0, 360): the direction it moves.

TURN_RATE_DPS.description: Turn rate, degrees per second, positive clockwise seen from above.

VERTICAL_RATE_MPS.description: Vertical rate, metres per second, positive up.

MODEL_ID.description:
Identifier of the dead-reckoning or motion model that extrapolates
this state, a key into the publisher's model registry. Required: a
state with no model is a position report, which this record is not.

MODEL_PARAMETERS.description: Parameters of that model, named per its own registry.

PROPAGATION_VALID_UNTIL.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant beyond which the publisher no longer stands
behind propagation of this state.

POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M.description: 1-sigma horizontal position uncertainty at EPOCH, metres.

INNOVATION_GATE_SIGMA.description:
Gate in standard deviations: an observation whose innovation exceeds
this many sigma of POSITION_UNCERTAINTY_M breached the model and
produced this update.

INNOVATION_GATE_DISTANCE_M.description:
Gate as an absolute distance, metres, when the publisher gates on
distance rather than sigma.

TOLERANCE_M.description:
Publisher's stated tolerance, metres, within which propagation of this
state is considered to agree with truth.

TRACK_STATUS.description:
Track status. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim; ordinal 0 is ACTIVE,
so a publisher MUST set this field on every record — an unset field
reads as ACTIVE and a consumer cannot distinguish the two.

STALE_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST mark the
track stale.

DROP_AFTER_S.description:
Seconds after LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH at which a consumer MUST drop the
track.

LAST_UPDATE_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the last source observation
that updated this track — the staleness clock origin. EPOCH may lag it
when the publisher re-emits a keepalive state.

IDENTIFIERS.description: Every identity the track is known by, scheme-tagged.

TNR.description:
Trust Node Record - Durable node membership state for an SDN trust graph.

TNR records preserve isolated trust graph nodes that do not currently have
an active trust edge. The current graph is a projection over the latest TNR
and TRE records, where deleted records are tombstones.

NODE_ID.description: Stable trust graph node identifier, normally an SDN peer ID or account id.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this node record was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this node record was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the node from the current graph.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this trust graph record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the trust node record.

TRE.description:
Trust Edge Record - Durable directed trust assertion for an SDN trust graph.

A TRE records one directed truster -> trustee assertion. The current trust
graph is a projection over the latest TRE records by EDGE_ID, with deleted
records acting as tombstones. Implementations must still validate the
projected graph for acyclicity before accepting it.

WEIGHT.description: Truster-assigned edge weight in the range [0, 1].

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this edge was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the edge from the current graph.

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the node/provider that issued this trust edge record.

PROVIDER_SIGNATURE.description: Provider signature over the trust edge record.

TRSRequest.description:
One terrain raster solve request.

FRAMES. The analysis frame is a local East-North-Up (ENU) frame: local X
is east, Y is north, Z is up. Both grids share the same analysis-frame
bounds, anchored at (MIN_EAST_M, MIN_NORTH_M). Per-cell geodetic
coordinates are carried explicitly in GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD /
GRID_LATITUDE_RAD so a solver recomputes exact per-cell Earth-fixed
geometry instead of interpolating it.

PROFILE_WIDTH.description:
Obstruction profile field width, cells. The profile is a FINER field
than the output raster; the line-of-sight march samples it.

SOLVER_TIER.description:
Fidelity tier requested. A solver that does not implement the tier
REFUSES; it never silently downgrades.

LOS_OCCLUSION.description: Geometric line-of-sight occlusion only; propagation on visible cells.

DIFFRACTION_ASSISTED.description: Knife-edge diffraction assists shadowed cells (ITU-R P.526-15).

SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE.description: Adds a single specular ground-bounce contribution.

PROPAGATION_MODEL.description:
Propagation model requested for the per-cell loss term. A solver that
does not implement the model REFUSES; it never silently substitutes.

FREE_SPACE.description: Free-space path loss. Holds ordinal 0 and is the default.

CUSTOM.description: A model this enum cannot express; the solver names it out of band.

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_MASK.description:
Atmospheric attenuation terms requested, as a bitmask: 0 none,
bit 0 (1) gaseous absorption, bit 1 (2) rain attenuation, bit 2 (4)
cloud/fog attenuation. A solver that does not implement a requested
term REFUSES.

THREAD_COUNT_HINT.description:
Parallelism hint. 0 or 1 means sequential. A solver MUST produce
byte-identical layers at any value — cells are independent and a thread
writes only its own indices; determinism is part of this contract.

MIN_EAST_M.description: Analysis-frame east coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

MIN_NORTH_M.description: Analysis-frame north coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

PROFILE_SPACING_M.description: Profile sample spacing, meters; sets the line-of-sight march stride.

MINIMUM_STEP_M.description:
Minimum march step, meters. NaN means caller left it unset and the
solver applies its own documented default.

TX_LOCAL_X_M.description:
Emitter position in the analysis ENU frame, meters (X east, Y north,
Z up).

TX_ECEF_X_M.description:
Emitter Earth-centered Earth-fixed position, meters — carried so the
solver computes exact per-cell range rather than a small-angle
approximation.

TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M.description: Emitter height above the reference ellipsoid, meters.

TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Terrain surface height under the emitter, meters above the ellipsoid.
Emitter height above ground = TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M −
TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.

INVERSE_ENU_TRANSFORM.description:
Column-major 4x4 inverse of the analysis ENU frame transform (the
matrix that takes Earth-fixed points INTO the analysis frame). Exactly
16 entries.

TARGET_HEIGHT_M.description: Receiver height above ground at every cell, meters.

BANDWIDTH_HZ.description:
Noise bandwidth, hertz. NaN means caller left it unset and the solver
applies its own documented default.

TX_POWER_W.description: Transmit power, watts. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Transmit line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

RX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Receive line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_NOISE_FIGURE_DB.description: Receiver noise figure, dB. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

EFFECTIVE_EARTH_RADIUS_FACTOR.description:
Effective Earth radius factor (k-factor) for curvature correction.
NaN means no curvature term is applied — NOT a default of 4/3.

GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic longitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GRID_LATITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic latitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GROUND_HEIGHTS_M.description:
Terrain height at every output cell, meters above the ellipsoid,
row-major, GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_HEIGHTS_M.description:
COMPOSITE obstruction surface (terrain plus structures) at every
profile cell, meters above the ellipsoid, row-major,
PROFILE_WIDTH * PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_SURFACE_Z_M.description:
The same composite surface expressed as analysis-frame Z, meters —
the frame the line-of-sight test runs in. PROFILE_WIDTH *
PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

TRACE_ID.description: Optional trace/correlation identifier.

TRSResult.description:
One terrain raster solve result. On STATUS = OK every layer below is
present with exactly GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT row-major entries. On any
other STATUS the result carries NO layers — never a partial raster.

OK.description: Solve completed; every layer is present for every cell.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite where a value is required, or dimensionally inconsistent.

REFUSED.description: The solver does not implement the requested physics. ERROR_MESSAGE names the gap; NO layers are carried. A refusal is never a fallback.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description:
On REFUSED or INVALID_INPUT: names the exact gap or defect. Empty on
OK.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Output raster dimensions the layers are stated for, echoed from the
request.

VISIBLE_MASK.description:
1 where the geometric ray from the emitter clears the obstruction
surface, else 0.

PATH_CLASS.description:
Path classification of every cell from the dominant-edge diffraction
parameter — see trsPathClass.

PATH_LOSS_DB.description: Total path loss including every applied term, dB (positive).

EXCESS_LOSS_DB.description: Loss above free space — what the terrain cost the cell, dB.

DIFFRACTION_PARAMETER.description:
ITU-R P.526-15 eq. (29) diffraction parameter v of the dominant edge.
Exactly -10.0 where no finite v exists (an unobstructed, Fresnel-clear
path) — the layer's stated no-finite-v encoding, carried verbatim so
the FlatBuffer and aligned-binary forms stay byte-comparable.

REFLECTION_CONTRIBUTION_DB.description:
Specular ground-bounce contribution, dB. All zeros outside the
SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE tier.

TRACE_ID.description:
Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when
present.

VAMSource.description: Provenance and license metadata for an asset source.

VAMMetrics.description: Geometry, material, texture, and bounds measurements.

VAMValidation.description: Validation result for one asset variant.

VALIDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when validation completed.

VAMQualityDimension.description: One named quality score and its basis.

VAMVariant.description: One source, optimized, LOD, or alternate visual representation.

MEDIA_TYPE.description: IANA media type of the exact variant bytes.

BYTE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact variant file bytes.

CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact variant file bytes.

GLTF_VERSION.description: MAJOR.MINOR glTF specification version, such as 2.0.

CONVERSION_VERSION.description: CONVERSION_VERSION is the exact version identifier reported by CONVERSION_TOOL without normalization.

INPUT_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the exact conversion input bytes.

RANK.description: Priority within the VAM; zero is highest priority and ranks must be unique within a VAM.

VAMApprovedAlternate.description: Exact approved alternate asset bytes and reviewed state.

BYTE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the exact approved alternate bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

VAMReview.description:
Signed binary-backed review decision over a specific candidate. This table exists only for a submitted decision; DECISION NONE and APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY are not accepted VAMReview evidence.
The review-envelope projection contains these uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID when present; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_CID when present; CANDIDATE_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; SIGNATURE_TYPE; PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM when present; CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID when present; ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS; ANNOTATIONS; and APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Projection order is descriptive; RFC 8785 sorts object keys during canonicalization.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order; nested VAMTransform and VAMAnnotation use uppercase schema field names and numeric enums. Nested VAMApprovedAlternate uses uppercase schema field names, numeric RANK, and transforms normalized by decoding schema defaults. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares the digest, then verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest.
Before trusting DECISION, a verifier must enforce binary decision invariants; repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; and exact candidate binding. CAPABILITY_ID, REPOSITORY, ISSUE_NUMBER, ENTITY_ID, VAM_ID, and NONCE MUST be present and nonempty for any new binary-backed signed decision and are required by the binary validation profile; their wire slots are optional only for backward compatibility.
Legacy buffers lacking those six fields remain decodable but are not valid new publication approvals. For these compatibility fields, the projection omits absent optionals only when decoding legacy records; the new validation profile rejects absence before signature trust. APPROVE requires CANDIDATE_CID; every binary decision requires exact CANDIDATE_SHA256.
Under the validation profile, when DECISION is APPROVE, CANDIDATE_CID MUST be present; REVIEWED_TRANSFORM and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST be present; and CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID. These fields remain optional on the wire for compatibility.
The enclosing VAM.ID MUST equal VAM_ID; the enclosing VAM.ENTITY_ID MUST equal review ENTITY_ID; and the enclosing VAM.CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID MUST equal review CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.
The referenced VAMVariant.ID MUST equal CANDIDATE_ID; that variant CID and BYTE_SHA256 MUST equal signed CANDIDATE_CID and CANDIDATE_SHA256; and its TRANSFORM MUST be field-for-field equal to REVIEWED_TRANSFORM after decoding schema defaults.
The enclosing VAM.ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS MUST exactly equal signed review ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS, with the same IDs in the same order; empty equals empty.
Each alternate ID MUST resolve to an existing VAMVariant; alternate IDs MUST be distinct and MUST NOT equal CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID. The referenced alternates retain their signed canonical rank ordering as represented by the manifest list.
APPROVED_ALTERNATES MUST correspond one-for-one with ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS in the same order; each descriptor VARIANT_ID MUST equal the corresponding alternate ID. Empty ALTERNATE_VARIANT_IDS requires empty APPROVED_ALTERNATES.
Each descriptor CID, BYTE_SHA256, REVIEWED_TRANSFORM, and RANK MUST be field-for-field equal to the resolved VAMVariant. BYTE_SHA256 MUST be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and CID MUST be nonempty.
The publication validator rejects any omission or mismatch before signature trust or publication. Any alternate byte, CID, BYTE_SHA256, transform, or rank change requires a new signed review and envelope.

CANDIDATE_CID.description: Optional CIDv1 containing a multihash of exact candidate bytes; metadata-only candidates may not have a CID.

CANDIDATE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of exact candidate bytes, required for every binary-backed decision.

DECIDED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the decision was made.

ENVELOPE_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS serialization of the projected review object, excluding ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature over the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest represented by ENVELOPE_SHA256.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description: Signature algorithm and profile; initially Ed25519.

PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding SHA-256 of the prior projected review object's RFC 8785 JCS serialization, excluding its ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE.

REPOSITORY.description: Canonical repository identifier in owner/name form.

ISSUE_NUMBER.description: Positive base-10 issue number digits with no leading zero.

NONCE.description: Unique opaque identifier containing at least 128 bits of entropy.

VAMMetadataOnlyReview.description:
Signed metadata-only review. DECISION validation MUST equal APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY; no candidate binary or CID fields exist.
The metadata-review signed projection contains uppercase schema field names in schema declaration order: REVIEWER_ID; CAPABILITY_ID; REVIEWER_ROLE encoded as its unsigned enum integer; REPOSITORY; ISSUE_NUMBER; ENTITY_ID; VAM_ID; NONCE; DECISION encoded as its unsigned enum integer; CANDIDATE_ID; CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256; DECIDED_AT; REASONS; COMMENT when present; ANNOTATIONS; SIGNATURE_TYPE; and PREVIOUS_DECISION_SHA256 when present.
Absent optional fields are omitted and arrays preserve order. A verifier reconstructs exactly this projection, applies RFC 8785 JCS, hashes the UTF-8 serialization bytes, compares ENVELOPE_SHA256, and verifies SIGNATURE over the raw 32-byte digest. ENVELOPE_SHA256 and SIGNATURE are excluded from the projection.
The verifier must also enforce repository, issue, entity, and VAM equality; nonce single use; role authorization; exact metadata binding; and DECISION equal to APPROVE_METADATA_ONLY before trusting the decision.

CANDIDATE_METADATA_SHA256.description:
64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON VAMSource projection using uppercase field names.
The VAMSource projection always includes SOURCE_RECORD_ID and SOURCE_URL; includes SOURCE_NAME, OBSERVED_AT, LICENSE_NAME, ATTRIBUTION, SOURCE_METADATA_SHA256, and NOTES only when present; and always includes LICENSE_CLASS, REDISTRIBUTION_PERMISSION, and DERIVATIVE_PERMISSION as unsigned enum integers. It contains no other fields.
A verifier reconstructs this projection from the candidate SOURCE and compares the digest before trusting DECISION.

VAM.description: Visual Asset Manifest — ranked visual representations for one stable entity.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 manifest-format version, not a content revision.

CANONICAL_VARIANT_ID.description: Identifies the approved canonical variant; alternate variants preserve their ranks.

VARIANTS.description: MUST be sorted ascending RANK. Ranks must be unique; tie-break bytewise ID only for invalid or legacy duplicate ranks.

CREATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was created.

UPDATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ) when the manifest was last updated.

SUPERSEDES_VAM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact superseded VAM bytes.

DPM_CID.description: CIDv1 containing a multihash of the exact referenced DPM bytes.

METADATA_REVIEW.description: Mutually exclusive with REVIEW; metadata-only decisions use METADATA_REVIEW.

VCFProperty.description: One emitted card property, as the publisher parsed its own output.

NAME.description: Property name verbatim and upper-case, e.g. `EMAIL`.

PARAMETERS.description:
Parameter tokens verbatim in emission order, each a single `name=value`
pair. A parameter the emitter wrote without a value is carried verbatim.

VALUE.description:
Property value with the text format's escaping REMOVED, so a consumer
reads a value rather than re-implementing an unescaper. `CARD` retains the
escaped form.

GROUP.description: Grouping prefix the property was emitted under, when the emitter used one.

ORDER.description:
Zero-based position of this property in the canonical emission order for
this FORM. Two conforming emitters agree on this number.

OCTET_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of the property's complete UNFOLDED content line, excluding
the line terminator. This is the number folding is applied against.

VCFAlias.description: One identity address row: the machine-readable half of the card.

SIGNING_KEY.description: The literal public key that produced the profile's signature.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The literal public key a correspondent encrypts to.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE.description: The profile's own signature value, so a scanner can verify without a second fetch.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: The profile's signature timestamp, as the publisher stated it.

PROFILE_CONTENT_ID.description: Content identifier of the exact profile bytes the card projects.

LEDGER_ACCOUNT.description: A distributed-ledger account the profile proves control of. CHAIN names which ledger.

OTHER.description: A row whose kind this standard does not model. KIND_TOKEN is authoritative.

KIND_TOKEN.description:
The row's kind label verbatim as emitted — the leftmost domain label.
Authoritative when KIND is OTHER.

LOCAL_PART.description: Everything left of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim.

DOMAIN.description:
Everything right of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim. This
is publisher data: the identity domain of the deployment that produced the
card, never a value this standard fixes.

ADDRESS.description:
The complete emitted address, `LOCAL_PART` then the separator then
`DOMAIN`, verbatim. Carried whole because it is what the importer stores
and what a consumer matches on.

ENCODING.description:
Transport encoding of LOCAL_PART verbatim and lowercase. An address
local part has a hard octet cap, so raw hexadecimal key material does not
fit and a compact binary-to-text encoding is REQUIRED for key rows.

ALGORITHM.description:
Cryptographic algorithm the row's key or signature belongs to, verbatim as
the profile states it. A key without a named algorithm is not verifiable.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The profile's published public key value verbatim, for key rows. The SAME
bytes LOCAL_PART transport-encodes, carried in the profile's own spelling
so a consumer can join card to profile without decoding. NEVER an extended
public key and NEVER a derivation path.

CHAIN.description: Ledger token verbatim for LEDGER_ACCOUNT rows.

ON_COMPACT_CARD.description: Whether this row survives into the COMPACT form.

OCTET_LENGTH.description: Octet length of the complete UNFOLDED row as emitted.

VCFSubject.description: The profile this card projects, and the provenance that binds them.

PEER_ID.description: Network peer identifier the profile is anchored to, verbatim.

DN.description: The profile's distinguished name verbatim, as published.

PROFILE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact, size-prefixed profile bytes projected.
With PROFILE_SHA256 this is what makes a card re-derivable.

PROFILE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of those same profile bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description:
The profile's signature timestamp as the publisher stated it, in
milliseconds since the Unix epoch. 0 means unpublished.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key that produced PROFILE_SIGNATURE, verbatim from the
profile. Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key a correspondent encrypts to, verbatim from the profile.
Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

SOURCE_STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the projected profile record, `$`
included. Carried so the projection is not silently assumed.

VCFConformance.description:
Everything needed to decide whether this card is servable, and whether two
implementations produced the same bytes.

VERSION.description: Card format version token verbatim as emitted, e.g. `3.0`.

PROFILE.description:
Identifier of the emission profile the card conforms to, verbatim, naming
the annex revision the publisher implemented.

LINE_ENDING.description: Line terminator the card text uses.

CRLF.description: Carriage return + line feed. The only canonical value.

LF.description: Line feed only. Non-canonical; importers in the strict class reject it.

FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH.description:
Octet width beyond which a content line is folded onto continuation lines.
0 means the publisher folded nothing, which is non-canonical.

BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of `CARD` exactly as emitted, folding and terminators
included. This is the number a serving surface budgets against.

UNFOLDED_BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length the same card would have with folding removed. Carried so a
folding disagreement is detectable without unfolding the text.

BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Octet ceiling of the surface this card was produced for. 0 means the
publisher states no ceiling; it never means a ceiling of zero.

WITHIN_BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Whether BYTE_LENGTH is within BYTE_BUDGET. False with a non-zero budget
means the card is a valid record that is NOT servable on that surface.

CARD_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of `CARD` as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This is the
value two implementations compare to prove byte-identical projection.

PROPERTY_COUNT.description:
Number of property rows emitted, unfolded. Carried so a truncated card is
detectable before parsing.

CARRIES_VERIFICATION_CHAIN.description:
Whether the card carries a complete verification chain: a signing-key row,
an encryption-key row, and a profile-signature row, all present in the
UNFOLDED text. A card without all three cannot verify its own subject and
is not servable as an identity card.

CARD_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of this card. Together with the publishing key
it is the card's identity across every republication.

FORM.description: Which canonical emission form this record carries.

FULL.description: The complete downloadable card: contact rows, the full verification chain, and the photo when one is published.

COMPACT.description: The density-limited card meant for optical scanning: contact rows plus the minimum verification chain, and nothing whose absence is recoverable from the profile the signature binds.

CARD.description:
The emitted card text VERBATIM: every octet an importer will read,
including folding and line terminators. Authoritative over PROPERTIES and
ALIASES in every disagreement.

MEDIA_TYPE.description:
Media type the card is served as, verbatim, including its charset
parameter.

SUBJECT.description: The profile this card projects and the provenance binding them.

PROPERTIES.description: The publisher's parse of `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

ALIASES.description: The identity address rows carried by `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

PHOTO_POLICY.description: How the card carries a portrait, if at all.

URI_REFERENCE.description: A portrait row referencing content by locator rather than embedding it. The canonical form, because an embedded image dominates the octet budget.

INLINE_ENCODED.description: A portrait row embedding transport-encoded image bytes inline.

PHOTO_URI.description:
Locator of the portrait content under URI_REFERENCE, verbatim as emitted.
Empty under every other policy.

PHOTO_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the portrait content verbatim, when one is carried.

CONFORMANCE.description: Emission facts and the digest two implementations compare.

PRODUCER_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS identifier of the component that produced the card, so two
projectors are distinguishable when their bytes differ.

PRODUCER_VERSION.description: Build or release identifier of that component verbatim.

GENERATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which the card was projected.

EXPIRES_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp after which a consumer re-projects
from the profile rather than serving this card. Empty means no expiry.

TAGS.description: `namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this card; never a substitute for a field.

propagatorConfig.description: Propagator configuration structure to describe propagation settings

uvwSigmas.description: UVW Sigmas (Covariance matrix in UVW frame)

VCMAtmosphericModelData.description: VCM Atmospheric and Perturbation Model Data

COVARIANCE.description:
Covariance matrix as flat array (6x6 lower triangular = 21 elements).
Order: [CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z,
CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z, CX_DOT_X_DOT,
CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT]
Units: position in km**2, velocity in km**2/s**2, cross in km**2/s

VEPPerformancePoint.description:
One point of the burn-rate table: consumption at a stated regime,
altitude, and speed.

ALTITUDE_M.description:
Altitude the point is stated at, metres above mean sea level. NaN for
surface and subsurface regimes where altitude does not apply.

SPEED_MPS.description: Speed the point is stated at, metres per second.

TRANSIT.description: Steady transit for surface and subsurface vehicles.

BURN_RATE_VALUE.description:
Consumption rate at this point, in BURN_RATE_UNITS per second unless
the unit token itself states another time base.

BURN_RATE_UNITS.description:
Units of BURN_RATE_VALUE, verbatim. Required: a rate with no unit is
not publishable.

SPECIFIC_RANGE_M_PER_UNIT.description:
Distance travelled per unit of energy at this point, metres per
CAPACITY_UNITS unit.

GROSS_MASS_KG.description: Gross mass the point is stated at, kilograms.

VEPReplenishment.description: One replenishment option: how the energy store is reset.

FACILITY_ID.description:
`$TFN.ID` of a facility where this replenishment is available. Absent
for a replenishment that is not facility-bound.

DURATION_S.description: Typical duration of the replenishment, seconds.

IN_MOTION.description:
Replenishment happens while the vehicle is underway (aerial
refuelling, underway replenishment).

VEPProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one endurance profile.

Required on every record: a profile whose data source, epoch, and
licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no dataset,
provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the dataset or study this
profile was derived from.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
profile was derived from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description: The licence forbids commercial use.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source's own identifier for the vehicle class or type this
profile describes, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC instant the source last modified this data, as it
states.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this profile record.

VEHICLE_CLASS_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of the vehicle CLASS this profile models.
Required: every profile is at least class-level.

VEHICLE_TYPE_DESIGNATOR.description:
Verbatim vehicle type token refining the class, when this profile is
a per-type refinement.

ENVIRONMENT.description:
Domain the vehicle operates in. The `$TRK` enum reused verbatim;
ordinal 0 is SPACE, so it is defaulted to UNKNOWN explicitly.

CAPACITY_VALUE.description: Usable energy store capacity, in CAPACITY_UNITS.

CAPACITY_UNITS.description:
Units of CAPACITY_VALUE, verbatim. The same unit keys
SPECIFIC_RANGE_M_PER_UNIT and the replenishment transfer rates.

RESERVE_FRACTION.description:
Fraction of capacity [0-1] held as reserve; endurance computations
spend down to the reserve, never through it.

PERFORMANCE_POINTS.description:
The burn-rate table, keyed regime x altitude x speed. Required, and
never a single collapsed scalar.

INTERPOLATION.description: How a consumer interpolates between the points.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No method stated; a consumer MUST treat the table as TABLE_LOOKUP rather than invent an interpolant.

LINEAR.description: Linear along the single varying axis.

BILINEAR.description: Bilinear over altitude and speed within a regime.

TABLE_LOOKUP.description: Exact-key lookup only; no interpolation between points.

MAXIMUM_ENDURANCE_S.description: Maximum endurance, seconds, as the source publishes it.

MAXIMUM_RANGE_M.description: Maximum range, metres, as the source publishes it.

SERVICE_CEILING_M.description: Service ceiling, metres above mean sea level.

REPLENISHMENT.description: Replenishment options available to this class or type.

REFINES_ID.description:
`$VEP.ID` of the parent profile this one refines — the class-to-type
specialization chain. Absent for a class-level root profile.

XTC.description:
SpaceSystem - Root element for XTCE document
A SpaceSystem defines the telemetry and command configuration for a space
vehicle or subsystem. SpaceSystems can be nested hierarchically to represent
the structure of a spacecraft (e.g., spacecraft -> subsystem -> payload).

CMR.description:
Constellation Membership Record.

One record asserts that one NORAD-catalogued object belongs (or formerly
belonged) to one named constellation. Record sets are therefore directly
keyable and queryable by NORAD_CAT_ID in FlatSQL. The record joins to $CAT
by NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_ID and may join through $CAT.BUS_ID to $BUS; it
does not duplicate catalogue or bus properties.

CONSTELLATION_ID and OPERATOR_ID are publisher-stable identifiers. Display
names and aliases are carried separately so consumers never use branding as
identity. Every emitted record names the independent source assertions used
to establish membership, operator, and catalogue joins.

MEMBERSHIP_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this assertion, unique within its record
set. Recommended form: "<constellation-id>:<norad-cat-id>".

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD catalogue number. Zero is invalid for a published record.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator copied verbatim from the joined $CAT when known.

CONSTELLATION_ID.description: Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the constellation/group.

CONSTELLATION_NAME.description:
Human-readable constellation name as published by the authoritative
membership source.

CONSTELLATION_ALIASES.description:
Alternate constellation names, brands, and search terms. Values are
verbatim; consumers must not treat aliases as stable identifiers.

OPERATOR_ID.description:
Publisher-stable operator/owner identifier. Empty when no source supports
one; never synthesized from a display name.

OPERATOR_NAME.description: Operator/owner display name verbatim from the cited source.

OPERATOR_ALIASES.description: Alternate operator names and brands, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source does not state whether the membership is current.

ACTIVE.description: The object is a current member of the constellation.

FORMER.description: The object was formerly a member and is retained for history.

was emitted.

PROVENANCE.description:
Independent evidence used to construct this assertion. At least one
MEMBERSHIP entry is required by the publishing contract.

FULL.description: The complete downloadable card: contact rows, the full verification chain, and the photo when one is published.

COMPACT.description: The density-limited card meant for optical scanning: contact rows plus the minimum verification chain, and nothing whose absence is recoverable from the profile the signature binds.

SIGNING_KEY.description: The literal public key that produced the profile's signature.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The literal public key a correspondent encrypts to.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE.description: The profile's own signature value, so a scanner can verify without a second fetch.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: The profile's signature timestamp, as the publisher stated it.

PROFILE_CONTENT_ID.description: Content identifier of the exact profile bytes the card projects.

LEDGER_ACCOUNT.description: A distributed-ledger account the profile proves control of. CHAIN names which ledger.

OTHER.description: A row whose kind this standard does not model. KIND_TOKEN is authoritative.

CRLF.description: Carriage return + line feed. The only canonical value.

LF.description: Line feed only. Non-canonical; importers in the strict class reject it.

URI_REFERENCE.description: A portrait row referencing content by locator rather than embedding it. The canonical form, because an embedded image dominates the octet budget.

INLINE_ENCODED.description: A portrait row embedding transport-encoded image bytes inline.

VCFProperty.description: One emitted card property, as the publisher parsed its own output.

NAME.description: Property name verbatim and upper-case, e.g. `EMAIL`.

PARAMETERS.description:
Parameter tokens verbatim in emission order, each a single `name=value`
pair. A parameter the emitter wrote without a value is carried verbatim.

VALUE.description:
Property value with the text format's escaping REMOVED, so a consumer
reads a value rather than re-implementing an unescaper. `CARD` retains the
escaped form.

GROUP.description: Grouping prefix the property was emitted under, when the emitter used one.

ORDER.description:
Zero-based position of this property in the canonical emission order for
this FORM. Two conforming emitters agree on this number.

OCTET_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of the property's complete UNFOLDED content line, excluding
the line terminator. This is the number folding is applied against.

VCFAlias.description: One identity address row: the machine-readable half of the card.

SIGNING_KEY.description: The literal public key that produced the profile's signature.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: The literal public key a correspondent encrypts to.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE.description: The profile's own signature value, so a scanner can verify without a second fetch.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description: The profile's signature timestamp, as the publisher stated it.

PROFILE_CONTENT_ID.description: Content identifier of the exact profile bytes the card projects.

LEDGER_ACCOUNT.description: A distributed-ledger account the profile proves control of. CHAIN names which ledger.

OTHER.description: A row whose kind this standard does not model. KIND_TOKEN is authoritative.

KIND_TOKEN.description:
The row's kind label verbatim as emitted — the leftmost domain label.
Authoritative when KIND is OTHER.

LOCAL_PART.description: Everything left of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim.

DOMAIN.description:
Everything right of the separator in the emitted address, verbatim. This
is publisher data: the identity domain of the deployment that produced the
card, never a value this standard fixes.

ADDRESS.description:
The complete emitted address, `LOCAL_PART` then the separator then
`DOMAIN`, verbatim. Carried whole because it is what the importer stores
and what a consumer matches on.

ENCODING.description:
Transport encoding of LOCAL_PART verbatim and lowercase. An address
local part has a hard octet cap, so raw hexadecimal key material does not
fit and a compact binary-to-text encoding is REQUIRED for key rows.

ALGORITHM.description:
Cryptographic algorithm the row's key or signature belongs to, verbatim as
the profile states it. A key without a named algorithm is not verifiable.

PUBLIC_KEY.description:
The profile's published public key value verbatim, for key rows. The SAME
bytes LOCAL_PART transport-encodes, carried in the profile's own spelling
so a consumer can join card to profile without decoding. NEVER an extended
public key and NEVER a derivation path.

CHAIN.description: Ledger token verbatim for LEDGER_ACCOUNT rows.

ON_COMPACT_CARD.description: Whether this row survives into the COMPACT form.

OCTET_LENGTH.description: Octet length of the complete UNFOLDED row as emitted.

VCFSubject.description: The profile this card projects, and the provenance that binds them.

PEER_ID.description: Network peer identifier the profile is anchored to, verbatim.

DN.description: The profile's distinguished name verbatim, as published.

PROFILE_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact, size-prefixed profile bytes projected.
With PROFILE_SHA256 this is what makes a card re-derivable.

PROFILE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of those same profile bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal
characters.

PROFILE_SIGNATURE_TIMESTAMP.description:
The profile's signature timestamp as the publisher stated it, in
milliseconds since the Unix epoch. 0 means unpublished.

SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key that produced PROFILE_SIGNATURE, verbatim from the
profile. Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

ENCRYPTION_PUBLIC_KEY.description:
Literal public key a correspondent encrypts to, verbatim from the profile.
Never an extended public key, never a derivation path.

SOURCE_STANDARD.description:
Four-character standard code of the projected profile record, `$`
included. Carried so the projection is not silently assumed.

VCFConformance.description:
Everything needed to decide whether this card is servable, and whether two
implementations produced the same bytes.

VERSION.description: Card format version token verbatim as emitted, e.g. `3.0`.

PROFILE.description:
Identifier of the emission profile the card conforms to, verbatim, naming
the annex revision the publisher implemented.

LINE_ENDING.description: Line terminator the card text uses.

CRLF.description: Carriage return + line feed. The only canonical value.

LF.description: Line feed only. Non-canonical; importers in the strict class reject it.

FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH.description:
Octet width beyond which a content line is folded onto continuation lines.
0 means the publisher folded nothing, which is non-canonical.

BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length of `CARD` exactly as emitted, folding and terminators
included. This is the number a serving surface budgets against.

UNFOLDED_BYTE_LENGTH.description:
Octet length the same card would have with folding removed. Carried so a
folding disagreement is detectable without unfolding the text.

BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Octet ceiling of the surface this card was produced for. 0 means the
publisher states no ceiling; it never means a ceiling of zero.

WITHIN_BYTE_BUDGET.description:
Whether BYTE_LENGTH is within BYTE_BUDGET. False with a non-zero budget
means the card is a valid record that is NOT servable on that surface.

CARD_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of `CARD` as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This is the
value two implementations compare to prove byte-identical projection.

PROPERTY_COUNT.description:
Number of property rows emitted, unfolded. Carried so a truncated card is
detectable before parsing.

CARRIES_VERIFICATION_CHAIN.description:
Whether the card carries a complete verification chain: a signing-key row,
an encryption-key row, and a profile-signature row, all present in the
UNFOLDED text. A card without all three cannot verify its own subject and
is not servable as an identity card.

CARD_ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier of this card. Together with the publishing key
it is the card's identity across every republication.

FORM.description: Which canonical emission form this record carries.

FULL.description: The complete downloadable card: contact rows, the full verification chain, and the photo when one is published.

COMPACT.description: The density-limited card meant for optical scanning: contact rows plus the minimum verification chain, and nothing whose absence is recoverable from the profile the signature binds.

CARD.description:
The emitted card text VERBATIM: every octet an importer will read,
including folding and line terminators. Authoritative over PROPERTIES and
ALIASES in every disagreement.

MEDIA_TYPE.description:
Media type the card is served as, verbatim, including its charset
parameter.

SUBJECT.description: The profile this card projects and the provenance binding them.

PROPERTIES.description: The publisher's parse of `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

ALIASES.description: The identity address rows carried by `CARD`, in canonical emission order.

PHOTO_POLICY.description: How the card carries a portrait, if at all.

URI_REFERENCE.description: A portrait row referencing content by locator rather than embedding it. The canonical form, because an embedded image dominates the octet budget.

INLINE_ENCODED.description: A portrait row embedding transport-encoded image bytes inline.

PHOTO_URI.description:
Locator of the portrait content under URI_REFERENCE, verbatim as emitted.
Empty under every other policy.

PHOTO_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Media type of the portrait content verbatim, when one is carried.

CONFORMANCE.description: Emission facts and the digest two implementations compare.

PRODUCER_ID.description:
Reverse-DNS identifier of the component that produced the card, so two
projectors are distinguishable when their bytes differ.

PRODUCER_VERSION.description: Build or release identifier of that component verbatim.

GENERATED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp at which the card was projected.

EXPIRES_AT.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond timestamp after which a consumer re-projects
from the profile rather than serving this card. Empty means no expiry.

TAGS.description: `namespace:value` facets, sorted and deduplicated. See TAG GRAMMAR above.

NOTES.description: Publisher note about this card; never a substitute for a field.

RFB.description:
RF Band Specification

UNITS ARE NORMATIVE. Every frequency field in this table is MHz. Sources
that publish Hz (as open transmitter databases commonly do) MUST divide by
1e6 before encoding; sources
that publish kHz MUST divide by 1e3. BAUD is baud (symbols per second),
never kilobaud. Encoding a Hz value into a MHz field is a defect, not a
convention.

One RFB record carries exactly one LINK_DIRECTION. A transceiver or
transponder is therefore represented as TWO RFB records — one UPLINK and
one DOWNLINK — sharing ID_TRANSMITTER, each carrying its own MODE,
FREQ_MIN, FREQ_MAX and CENTER_FREQ.
